texts: **Seven Killings in a Temple or Prosperous position in the Life palace** — the main stars in your Life palace are all Temple or Prosperous. A star in a Temple or Prosperous position is at its best. But the Complete Book says “when the stars in the Life palace are Temple or Prosperous, but malefic stars guard or shine on the trine and opposite palaces, the pattern is broken” (Complete Book, volume 3, Essentials of Discussing Stars), so besides Temple or Prosperous you must also check whether malefic stars guard or shine on the trine and opposite palaces; it cannot simply be assumed to be an innate advantage.
**Key inferences** (the reasoning engine, traceable to its sources):

**Double Prosperity facing the palace** — Transformation to Prosperity and Wealth Keeper both shine on the palace's trine and opposite palaces of your Life palace. Wealth Keeper is a prosperity star, and Transformation to Prosperity is prosperity too; the Complete Book, in the Life section, says “Prosperity meeting Wealth Keeper means wealth and rank”. But two prosperities do not add up to double the money: whichever palace the prosperity falls in, whose money it is must be read separately. Falling in the Life or Wealth palace it is your own money; falling in the Career palace it is money managed by a position and does not belong to you; falling in the Parents palace it is your parents' money. After that, check for Earth Void and Earth Robbery: the Complete Book, in “Determining Poverty and Lowliness Patterns”, has the line “Double Canopy means Wealth Keeper or Transformation to Prosperity sitting in the Life palace and meeting Void and Robbery”.

**Earth Robbery and Ram Blade sitting in the Life palace** — the Life palace holds 2 malefic stars sharing the palace. When a palace has malefic stars and benefic stars also arrive, the malefic force is greatly reduced; if there is no benefic star at all, then even a single minor malefic star such as Earth Robbery or Heavenly Void can endanger life. Malefic stars in a Fallen position are bad on top of bad; malefic stars in a Temple position can instead turn auspicious. Whether the Life palace has a benefic star sharing it, and whether these malefic stars are Temple or Fallen, decide how heavy or light the effect is.

**Life palace with no main star** — your Life palace has no main star. The Complete Book, Essentials of Discussing Stars, says “if the Life palace has no main star and the Wealth and Career palaces are flanked by benefic stars, then wealth and rank are complete, or one may be the child of a concubine or of a secondary wife.” It also says “if malefic stars clash from the trine and opposite palaces, one may live by relying on two families, and only by leaving the ancestral home can one keep one's work and found a household and career.” The method is to go on checking whether the Wealth and Career palaces are shone on by benefic stars, and whether malefic stars clash from the trine and opposite palaces; the stars of the opposite Travel palace shining across can be used for reference, but they are not moved into the Life palace to be taken as your own stars.

**Harmony and Moon Fallen in the Life palace** — the main star of the Life palace is Fallen. A star in a Favourable position is only average, and in the Fallen position it is at its weakest. When a main star is Fallen, you must check whether benefic stars come to join it in the same palace and how the trine and opposite palaces and the Decade are running, all at the same time; you cannot declare a bad destiny in one sentence, nor claim the opposite and call it a great destiny.

**Harmony transforming to Taboo in the Life palace** — Taboo sits in the Life palace. Taboo governs calamity and killing and thoughts that cannot be worked through; it also governs sudden disasters, lawsuits and disputes, and loss of wealth. Which matter it specifically corresponds to must be read from the star Harmony and the ten-year Decade you are in.

**Harmony transforming to Taboo in the Travel palace clashing with the Life palace** — Taboo clashes into the Life palace from the Travel palace. When Taboo clashes with the Life palace and the Life palace has no benefic star, it is called “Half-Void Broken Wing”: there is a milestone at age 40, and a harsh period will certainly occur before age 40. This speaks of a harsh period of your own, not a small setback when you go out. If the Life palace has a benefic star guarding it together, it is not read this way; which matter it specifically corresponds to must be read from the star Harmony and the ten-year Decade you are in. Ages are approximate; if the corresponding event has already happened early, the same combination of stars is not used again to predict later ages.

**Ram Blade meeting the Assistants in the Travel palace** — your Travel palace has Ram Blade sharing the palace with Left Assistant or Right Assistant. The Complete Book says that Left Assistant in the Travel palace “brings the support of a noble person and good fortune when you are active, but meeting Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star leaves your people short and invites gossip and trouble”; Right Assistant in the Travel palace “meets noble people and prospers when going out, should not sit still and stay put, and meeting Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery leads to disputes with people outside”. If both Left Assistant and Right Assistant are with Ram Blade in the Travel palace, then I fear you can only go and help others do their work.

Transformation to Prosperity is the same, and usually has to meet Heavenly Horse; meeting Heavenly Horse forms a special pattern called Prosperity and Horse galloping together. Money that arrives this way must meet Heavenly Horse, which means it is earned with great effort, but once Prosperity and Horse galloping together is met, very large sums often flow in. The Complete Book, in the Heavenly Horse section, says “if it shares the palace with Wealth Keeper it is called Prosperity and Horse galloping together”; if the two stars do not share a palace it only counts as shining on; the note in volume 3 says: “it dislikes meeting malefic stars, Ram Blade, Fire Star, Road Block and Void, and mostly signifies toil and hardship.”

In partnerships, the partners get real work done and have enough drive to act, but both sides are hard-edged, so clashes are hard to avoid. Transformation to Prosperity (money coming in) means your siblings go into business together and earn money.

Volume two of the “Complete Book” discusses Martial in the Spouse palace: “Martial brings mutual clashes, so marry late; a couple of the same age is also a fair match; with benefic stars you gain property through your wife, with ill stars, marrying a wife loses your estate.” This means affection in this palace easily becomes a tug-of-war between the two sides and is hard to bring into harmony, which suits marrying late; two people of similar age are also a good match; with benefic stars sharing the palace you gain property through your spouse; with malefic stars clashing from the opposite palace, you conversely lose wealth because of your spouse. With Martial seated in the Spouse palace, the most important thing is the three words “marry late”, that is, marrying a little later is better: if you marry early, both of you are still hard-edged and the time to wear down your differences is long; if you start a family later, each of you is mature and can hold the marriage steady in return.

Volume two of the “Complete Book” says of Martial in the Children palace “governs one child”, meaning only one child. With Martial seated in the Children palace, the number of children is small, and the children are firm in temperament, self-governing and independent, mostly standing on their own early and not clinging to their parents; the relationship with the parents is practical and not very warm, and they express affection through actions rather than words; they usually have talent in managing money or in technical work.

Volume two of the “Complete Book” says of Martial in the Children palace “governs one child”, meaning only one child. With Martial seated in the Children palace, the number of children leans toward few, and the children are firm in temperament, independent and self-governing, mostly standing on their own early and not clinging to their parents; the relationship with the parents leans toward the practical and is not very warm, and they express affection through actions rather than words; they usually have talent in managing money or in technical work. Transformation to Prosperity (bringing in wealth) means your children build a successful career, and their wealth luck runs prosperous.

Volume two of the “Complete Book” discusses Martial in the Parents palace: “Martial brings an early clash; give up the ancestral estate and there is no punishment; with the Greedy Wolf there is punishment and clash; with the Seven Killings there is punishment”. This means the bond with your parents is thin in childhood; if you do not take over the ancestral estate and go out to set up your own household, you escape this obstacle; sharing the palace with the Greedy Wolf makes the relationship clash more; sharing it with the Seven Killings also brings obstacles. With Martial seated in the Parents palace, you often leave home early as a child, or spend little time together. Your parents are firm and practical, their way of raising children values real ability, they are not very warm or close but do not let their child lack for material things; relations with superiors follow the same pattern: few words, reliable, straightforward.

Volume two of the “Complete Book” discusses Martial in the Parents palace: “Martial brings an early clash; give up the ancestral estate and there is no punishment; with the Greedy Wolf there is punishment and clash; with the Seven Killings there is punishment”. Transformation to Prosperity (money coming in) means your parents have substantial financial strength and your superiors value you.

Volume two of the “Complete Book” discusses Martial in the Property palace: “Martial alone in a Prosperous position receives a great estate from forefathers; in a Fallen position, you must step back and only later succeed; with the Army Breaker and Great Loss the family property is shattered, and what you have does not last”. This means that Martial alone in a Prosperous position receives a large inheritance from your ancestors; falling into the Fallen position (weak), you must abandon the old and rebuild from scratch before you succeed; sharing the palace with the Army Breaker and Great Loss, the family property easily scatters, and what you have is not kept for long. Sharing the palace with the Minister means you break first and gain afterwards; sharing it with the Treasury means you keep the estate that already exists; sharing it with the Greedy Wolf means you build up your property late. If Martial meets the Earth Void and Earth Robbery, there are advances and retreats. Master Hi Di says Martial takes “the Wealth and Property palaces as its special charge”, so these sharing and malefic conditions must be read together. Martial is by nature a wealth star (governing money), and real estate is the most solid asset for this kind of life pattern; the home is furnished simply and practically, valuing function over decoration. Transformation to Power (holding authority) means the power to handle your property is in your own hands.

Volume two of the “Complete Book” discusses Martial in the Fortune palace: “Martial toils in mind and body; entering the Temple, it enjoys blessings in peace; sharing a palace with the Army Breaker, it dashes east and west and has no stillness”. This means that people of this type mostly go looking for work themselves and cannot sit still; entering the Temple (Temple = this star is strong), they enjoy blessings in peace; sharing a palace with the Army Breaker, they run east and west and cannot be calm. When it shares the palace with the Minister, the Martial entry in the “Complete Book” says “with the Minister, a peaceful and healthy old age”, meaning the body is healthy and well in old age; when it shares the palace with the Treasury, the Treasury entry says “with Martial, youth is harder, and from middle age on you enjoy peace and blessings”, meaning youth is harder, and only from middle age on do you enjoy peace and blessings. Inner satisfaction comes from real achievement and accumulation; airy spiritual pursuits do not move this kind of person, who feels at ease only when the ledger has numbers in it. Transformation to Power (holding authority) means you are most satisfied when you are in charge of things.

Inner satisfaction comes from real achievement and accumulation; airy spiritual pursuits do not move this kind of person, who feels at ease only when the ledger has numbers in it. Transformation to Prosperity (money coming in) means your spirit is well supplied and your sense of achievement is strong.

Volume two of the “Complete Book” discusses Martial in the Wealth palace: “Martial is abundant; with a beneficial transformation you have a fortune of vast sums, without one you make money in bustling places”, meaning that with Martial seated in the Wealth palace your hands are always full, and with a beneficial transformation you accumulate a large fortune; without one you can still earn money in busy streets and markets. The end of that entry also says “meeting the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star, it does not gather; it greatly fears the Void and the Robbery”, meaning that meeting the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star, money cannot be kept, and what it fears most are the Earth Void and Earth Robbery. Sharing the palace with the Army Breaker it is “coming from the east and going to the west, with nothing first and something later”, meaning running east and west, with nothing at first and only later gaining, hard work in youth and success afterwards. What it fears most are the Earth Void and Earth Robbery; when Martial meets them, even large earnings cannot be kept. Transformation to Power (holding authority) means you rely on your ability to keep financial control in your own hands. Martial's way of earning is to save little by little and advance steadily, not good at speculation, extremely good at accumulating.

Transformation to Prosperity (money coming in) means your sources of money grow even more abundant. Martial's way of earning is to save little by little and advance steadily, not good at speculation, extremely good at accumulating.

Volume two of the “Complete Book” discusses Martial in the Travel palace: “Martial earns little when things are hurried and bustling, and should not keep still; with the Greedy Wolf you become a great merchant; with the Seven Killings or Army Breaker, body and mind cannot keep still; meeting the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star, you draw gossip and trouble abroad”. This means Martial must earn its money amid the hustle and bustle, and staying quietly in one place keeps it from showing its strength; sharing the palace with the Greedy Wolf you can do big business; sharing it with the Seven Killings or Army Breaker, both body and mind are unsettled; meeting the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star, you easily draw gossip and trouble when away from home. The rhapsody also has a line, “Martial in the Travel palace favours the marketplace”, saying that people with this in this palace suit markets and trade. Away from home you stand firm on real ability, without detours, and suit finance, engineering, the military and police, and commerce. Transformation to Power (holding authority) means you hold real power when away from home. If the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star are added, there is plenty of gossip and trouble abroad, and you should leave yourself a way out when doing things; meeting the Earth Void and Earth Robbery, money comes and goes and cannot be saved.

Volume two of the “Complete Book” says “Martial in a Prosperous palace has no lack of people, and one shout brings a hundred answers”, meaning that with Martial in a Prosperous position there is no shortage of manpower, and a call is answered at once; it then divides into three kinds by the star sharing the palace: “with the Minister, capable helpers; with the Seven Killings, they turn on their master; with the Greedy Wolf, there is a lack of strength”. This means that sharing the palace with the Minister, your subordinates are capable; sharing it with the Seven Killings, they may turn and bite you; sharing it with the Greedy Wolf, you cannot put their strength to use. With Martial in a Prosperous position, your subordinates follow your command. Friends are practical, you get along frankly, benefit and cooperation come first, and there are few soulmates; subordinates are able and carry things out forcefully, with no need to say much. If Transformation to Power (holding authority) falls in this palace, the power belongs to the friends and subordinates, whose position is strong, and this share of power does not count as yours.

Transformation to Prosperity (money coming in) means you have a source of funds through friends and earn money through partnerships.

The “Rhapsody on Form and Nature” in the “Complete Book” has a line, “Prosperity meeting the Beam's shelter: you hold your own wealth yet it benefits others”, meaning that when Heavenly Beam meets Prosperity, the money in your hands is often used to help others. So Heavenly Beam's money is mostly tied to helping people and valuing loyalty.

The poem “on judging those who are rich and well off” in the “Complete Book” says “The Moon entering the Temple has radiance; wealth entering the home of wealth is more wondrous still; if ill stars that break and drain do not offend, it is surely a rich family with gold in heaps and jade in rows”. In plain words: the Moon in a good position with full light, and seated in the Wealth palace at just the right time, is especially rare; as long as it does not meet ill stars of the breaking and draining kind, it is a rich family with gold in heaps and jade in rows. This pattern refers to the Moon seated in the Wealth palace and also entering the Temple, without meeting ill stars that break and drain. The Moon's money is gathered like a small stream flowing long, and it suits long-term financial planning; real estate and fixed assets form a fairly solid foundation of family property.

Volume one of the “Complete Book” says Harmony “does not fear the Seven Killings encroaching, nor does it fear the killing stars all entangling it”, and the entry for Harmony in the Fortune palace in volume two also has no saying that adding malefic stars makes it worse.

Volume one of the “Complete Book” says Harmony “does not fear the Seven Killings encroaching, nor does it fear the killing stars all entangling it”, and the entry for Harmony in the Fortune palace in volume two also has no saying that adding malefic stars makes it worse. Transformation to Taboo (obstruction) affects inner enjoyment, and you easily feel empty; it is best to take the initiative to find something you can do over the long term to put your mind into, turning “bored” into “there is something I can do”, that is, finding yourself a concrete task to do.

Volume three of the “Complete Book” says “Great Gate and Sun setting the Life palace at the Tiger, and at the Monkey, you first win fame and then enjoy rank and wealth”, and also says “Great Gate and Sun with the Life palace in the Tiger position enjoy rank and fame”; Great Gate and Sun count as the proper pattern only when both stars are bright, and if they are Fallen or Neutral and not bright, it does not count. Volume three also says “Great Gate and Sun setting the Life palace at the Monkey is also excellent”, so both the Tiger and Monkey palaces can be used. For a woman's chart: a woman with the Great Gate and Sun pattern leans toward becoming a secondary wife, and when judging a woman's chart in practice you must also look at the Spouse palace, the Fortune palace and the home.

Volume three of the “Complete Book” says “Great Gate and Sun setting the Life palace at the Tiger, and at the Monkey, you first win fame and then enjoy rank and wealth”, and also says “Great Gate and Sun with the Life palace in the Tiger position enjoy rank and fame”; Great Gate and Sun count as the proper pattern only when both stars are bright, and if they are Fallen or Neutral and not bright, it does not count. Volume three also says “Great Gate and Sun setting the Life palace at the Monkey is also excellent”, so both the Tiger and Monkey palaces can be used. For a man's chart: a man with the Great Gate and Sun pattern becomes greatly wealthy and noble, speaks well, and is eloquent.

Volume three of the “Complete Book” says “Emperor and Army Breaker in the Life palace at the Dragon, Dog, Ox or Goat, with benefic stars added, can look forward to wealth and rank”; only with benefic stars added can you speak of wealth and rank. This person loves to spend, pursues material things, and is willing to part with money. The temperament swings widely, and friends' opinions of them split into two extremes.

The “Complete Book” is very heavy here: “When the Greedy Wolf and Integrity share a palace, men are mostly dissolute and women mostly lewd”. Integrity and Greedy Wolf seated in the Life palace (both Fallen at the Snake and Pig): the temperament is unsettled, fond of gambling and amusement; when Integrity and Greedy Wolf fall into the Fallen position in the Life palace, you are sure to get tangled up with drink, sex, money and temper, and in severe cases may die young, leaning toward congenital illness that is hard to cure and a tendency to self-harm; the greatest taboo is to indulge desire. You suit paths connected with social contact and aesthetics, but you must hold your desires in check, otherwise you easily spend and lose money over romantic matters.

The entry for the Strategist in the “Complete Book” reads “at the Tiger and Monkey palaces it is in a favourable position, sharing a palace with the Moon”, meaning the Strategist at the Tiger and Monkey has only just enough strength and is not at its strongest; the entry for the Moon reads “enters the Temple at the Rat, Ox and Tiger palaces”, “Fallen at the Horse palace, beneficial at the Goat and Monkey palaces”, so the Moon at the Tiger palace has strength, and at the Monkey palace is one step weaker.

The entry for the Strategist in the “Complete Book” reads “at the Tiger and Monkey palaces it is in a favourable position, sharing a palace with the Moon”, meaning the Strategist at the Tiger and Monkey has only just enough strength and is not at its strongest; the entry for the Moon reads “enters the Temple at the Rat, Ox and Tiger palaces”, “Fallen at the Horse palace, beneficial at the Goat and Monkey palaces”, so the Moon at the Tiger palace has strength, and at the Monkey palace is one step weaker. In a woman's chart, you are gentle, beautiful and intelligent.

The “Wives and Concubines” section of the “Complete Book” says of Integrity in the Spouse palace: “three times a bridegroom”, meaning marriage easily repeats and changes several times; sharing the palace with the Greedy Wolf is “an even greater clash”, saying that the two obstruct each other more heavily; add the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star and you easily end up living apart for long periods; only sharing the palace with the Treasury brings growing old together with white hair, and the other person being a little firm in temperament is, on the contrary, no problem.

The “Complete Book” mixes praise and criticism of the Emperor and Greedy Wolf at the Rabbit and Rooster. The Greedy Wolf entry says here it is “beneficial”, meaning good for it; it also says “sharing a palace with the Emperor and meeting the Fire Star, it is noble”, meaning that sitting together with the Emperor and also meeting the Fire Star raises its nobility, and people born in a Yin Wood, Yin Metal or Yin Earth year suit the pattern of wealth and rank (having money and standing). The Emperor entry also says “people born in a Yin Wood, Yin Metal, Yang Wood or Yang Metal year are noble but not lasting”, meaning those born in these years hold a high position but do not keep it long. Volume three also records “the Emperor at the Rabbit and Rooster, meeting the Robbery and the Void and the four malefic stars, is mostly a monk who has left the world”, meaning someone who easily sees through the world of dust and becomes a monk, but you judge it this way only when the Earth Void and Earth Robbery and the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star are all seen together. In romance, there are many Peach Blossom entanglements, and you must guard against drink and sex ruining things.

The “Complete Book” says “the Strategist and Heavenly Beam at the Dragon and Dog are no small supplement”, and the verse on Heavenly Beam also says “the two stars at the Dragon and Dog, blessings and longevity need no discussion”, and volume three also says “the Strategist and Beam meeting, good at discussing military affairs, at the Dog it is also a fine judgment”; the verse on the Strategist also has the saying “Heavenly Beam in the same position, surely a Taoist priest and a monk”, and the two sayings are set side by side.

The “Complete Book” says of the Treasury “mild in heart and nature, intelligent and handsome, widely learned and adaptable”, and also says “innately gentle, kind, upright and refined”, meaning: a gentle temperament, an intelligent and delicate person, widely learned and able to adapt as the occasion requires, with correct and measured conduct. Gentleness is the outside, adaptability is the inside, so do not take such a person for a kind-hearted soul with no views of their own. To put it more bluntly: a Treasury person is gentle and generous but full of calculation, and is not necessarily a good person. That calculation, used rightly, is called knowing moderation, used wrongly it becomes scheming. The real weakness is not in the head but in the feet: steadiness makes you the pillar that holds the collective firmly in place, but in situations that call for a quick turn, you easily lag half a beat.

The “Complete Book” says of Heavenly Beam “when the Grand Duke clashes it turns to blessing, and when the White Tiger arrives there is no disaster”, and volume three also says “Strategist and Beam guarding the Life palace, with benefic stars added, wealth and rank come auspiciously”. Add the Strategist's intelligence, and you suit best the helping professions such as medicine, education, religion and social welfare. Your way of dealing with people is rounded and thoughtful, but sometimes you worry too much about other people's affairs.

The “Complete Book” says Integrity in the Spouse palace means “three times a bridegroom”, so marriage does not easily settle in one go; sharing the palace with the Treasury means growing old together with white hair.

The “Complete Book” says that with the Army Breaker in the Spouse palace, husband and wife, men and women alike, easily see each other little and are apart often, and the marriage advances and retreats unpredictably.

The “Bone Marrow Rhapsody” of Dou Shu has two more lines worth consulting: “Literary Arts and Martial: people of much learning and much talent”, meaning that people of the Literary Arts and Martial type learn anything quickly and know many miscellaneous trades; “Martial in an idle palace has many skills”, meaning that when Martial falls in a palace that is not important, it goes toward one specialised craft, with skill in hand. In romance, you are not good with words and use actions to show love, and your partner may feel neglected for lack of the warmth of spoken words. The old books say Martial “clashes alone”, meaning lonely and hard to get along with others; in fact it does not truly obstruct anyone, but the character is firm and not good at expressing feeling, so relationships easily grow distant by degrees.

Volume two of the “Complete Book” of Zi Wei Dou Shu says of Martial “firm in nature and decisive, straight in heart and not malicious, small in build with a loud voice and a large capacity, with something unusual about the hair”, meaning a strong, decisive temperament that says what it thinks without being cunning or cruel, not tall, with a loud voice yet no small capacity, and the hair has something distinctive. On appearance, for a person with Martial in the Life palace: military officers rise from the five short features; in physiognomy, the five short features govern nobility and also wealth. If Martial is seated in the Life palace but the person is thin and tall, the pattern does not hold. You must check whether your own body shape fits before saying the pattern holds, and the chart alone cannot settle it. The “Complete Book” puts it as “small in build with a loud voice and a large capacity”. The temperament is decisive, with few words, valuing loyalty, doing more than saying. There is one more layer: Martial's hot temper is actually as fiery as the Sun's, but it flares and passes, and does not hold irritation overnight. In romance it leans toward solitude and is not good at tenderness, and suits finding a gentle, considerate partner to complement it.
One star manages the money and one star manages the review; you know how to do the accounts and also hold to principle, which suits finance and legal work.
Seven Killings + Right Assistant means subordinates obey orders and charge forward: your killing energy is accepted by the group and its effect is amplified.
Seven Killings + Earth Robbery means the killing energy is robbed: the results of your charge may be plucked by someone else.

Seven Killings + Earth Void means the killing energy turns to void: the Seven Killings no longer pushes people aggressively and instead becomes a clear and noble life pattern, suited to self-cultivation and research.
Seven Killings + Heavenly Halberd means a female benefactor dissolves your killing energy: it may be a female elder who teaches you to “overcome the hard with the soft”.
Seven Killings + Heavenly Leader means a male benefactor helps you charge forward: often a boss or male teacher who turns your drive into systematic ability.

Seven Killings + Left Assistant means the general star is given an aide: the Seven Killings that used to charge alone now has a deputy, and the career is steadier. You suit leading a team to push sales numbers, and acting as overall sales commander.

Seven Killings + Literary Talent means there is culture within the martial: you have both drive and strategy, and suit starting a business with a strategic direction and acting as a senior manager of the strategist type.
Seven Killings + Literary Arts means both martial and literary: eloquence and courage are both present, and you suit leading as a speaker and being a senior manager who inspires.
Seven Killings + Fire Star means fierce killing energy: the likelihood of bloodshed, injury and car accidents is high, so take special care when driving and signing agreements.
Seven Killings + Bell Star is, like the Fire Star, a matter of killing energy, but more restrained: anger built up over a long time may suddenly explode.

The Seven Killings is like a martial general leading troops, solitary and decisive, spending all life straining its strength; if it forms the Seven Killings Facing the Dipper pattern, you can rise in the military and police ranks of martial posts.

With the Seven Killings entering the Temple or Prosperous position, the energy of the general star opens fully, and will and power of execution are both at their best, suiting a charge into fiercely competitive fields; with the Seven Killings Facing the Dipper pattern, rank and wealth flourish still more, and a martial post or a business start-up both have a very high ceiling.
The Seven Killings in the Career palace is a military officer's star, and the career must come through running about and hard fighting.

A person with the Seven Killings seated in the Life palace is hot-tempered, suspicious, independent, dislikes being managed, and carries the bearing of a martial general. People with the Seven Killings in the Life palace often have large eyes, a point from physiognomy to be checked against the chart, which needs to be compared directly. The star's character: the Seven Killings person is suspicious, and at the slightest stir thinks the worst in order to guard against it, being both hot-tempered and hard, which is very tiring for those who live with them; if you marry such a person, life together easily brings worry.

With the Seven Killings Temple or Prosperous in the Spouse palace or its trine palaces, your spouse is also strong and decisive, the two of you are partners of equal strength and talent, and in the marriage competition and adjustment go side by side, but when two strong people join hands the sense of achievement is very high.

With the Seven Killings Temple or Prosperous in the Career palace, the “Complete Book” says “the Seven Killings, Temple or Prosperous: a martial post towering high, power and rank not small, not suited to scholars”.

The Seven Killings is the sixth star of the Southern Dipper, its energy transformation is “general”, which is to say the “general star”, meaning it is like a general leading troops: it stands for solitude, decisiveness, daring to take risks, and willingness to gamble. The Seven Killings and Army Breaker govern loss and toil; when the Yearly period reaches these two stars, you are busy and worn out, alone and working desperately, and also lose money, with money in and out and wealth hard to gather. This refers to the few Yearly periods that reach the Seven Killings, and does not fix a whole life for the Seven Killings in the Life palace.

The Seven Killings' best pattern is “**Seven Killings Facing the Dipper**”: the Seven Killings seated in the Rat or Horse, or the Tiger or Monkey, with the Treasury shining across from the opposite palace (the palace directly opposite) (at the Tiger and Monkey palaces, the Emperor and Treasury share the palace). This pattern is called “rank and wealth flourishing”, meaning both post and income are respectable, and you easily rise in martial ranks such as the military and police. This is a general star entering the Life palace, and a person with this pattern has authority that shakes the frontier, equal to the Emperor and Treasury seated in the palace, with rank and wealth flourishing all life, rank meaning social standing and wealth meaning money. But it must also be noted: a good pattern in the natal chart is only a good foundation, and when the Decade (the ten-year course) or the Yearly (a major phase of fortune, the fortune of that year) goes badly, trouble still happens, so you cannot look only at the good pattern.

The Seven Killings does not carry the Four Transformations on its own. The Career palace likes best to have the Power star (the star of holding authority) enter it; to be an official you must have power, otherwise what is the use of a small post; when the Emperor shares a palace with the Seven Killings, these two stars also stand for power.

The Seven Killings' strength is a double-edged sword: used in a career it is the power to break new ground, used at home it is hard to live with. In romance you are prone to loneliness, and a marriage needs a very long time of adjustment; the lesson of this life is to be decisive yet leave a little gentleness, and to be independent yet allow yourself to lean on others.

When the Seven Killings falls in the Body palace, whichever palace that is, so long as the Seven Killings is in the Body palace, it is called the Seven Killings in the Body palace; with the Seven Killings in the Body palace, there are many failures and few successes in life, and this life pattern is very tiring.

Seven Killings: the general star, solitary, decisive and daring, suited to the military, police and start-ups; with the Seven Killings Facing the Dipper pattern, it is a martial post of great nobility.
Hard work before thirty and success only after thirty, a typical case of a great vessel that matures late.

The trine palaces gather [Seven Killings, Army Breaker]. Your natal Four Transformations are fixed and do not change; whether they turn out good or bad depends on how the Decade and Yearly periods set them in motion.

The trine palaces gather [Harmony, Strategist, Moon]. Your natal Four Transformations are fixed and do not change; whether they turn out good or bad depends on how the Decade and Yearly periods set them in motion.

The trine palaces gather [Harmony, Strategist, Great Gate]. Your natal Four Transformations are fixed and do not change; whether they turn out good or bad depends on how the Decade and Yearly periods set them in motion.

Your subordinates are capable but hard to manage; keep your friends few but excellent, and do not hand over money and signing authority lightly.

You do not fear competition and do not fear difficulty; the harsher the environment, the more it draws out the Seven Killings' hidden potential. The Seven Killings' career comes by gambling, not by waiting in comfort and ease, and this is the core spirit of working with this kind of life pattern.

However, the books attach conditions. The Emperor must meet the Left Assistant, Right Assistant, Literary Talent, Literary Arts, Heavenly Leader and Heavenly Halberd to reach the rank of being enfeoffed as marquis or earl, that is, the truly high level; and there is also the line “add the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star and it is ordinary”, and for the Treasury it is “seeing the Void and the Robbery, ordinary”, meaning that meeting the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star, or the Earth Void and Earth Robbery, the achievement stays at an ordinary level. Your career rises steadily on foundations and rank.

However, when looking at the Health palace you must look at the whole chart, and you cannot look at a single palace and say what the Great Gate or the Sun in the Health palace stands for; doing that is not accurate. As for which organ needs attention: take the palace where malefic stars gather most and are worst across the whole chart, and match the organ to that palace's earthly branch (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig Triple Burner); if two palaces are both bad, look at both places. The Great Gate belongs to Water, so judging illness of the stomach, intestines and mouth from it is a way we do not follow. You must also look together with the Life palace and the ten-year Decade currently running. Have regular check-ups and follow your doctor's advice.

The Emperor and Army Breaker at the Ox palace enter the Temple (Temple = this star is strong here), a higher-grade pattern; the Goat palace is weaker. Whether you can build anything depends entirely on the trine palaces: if there is not one supporting star, only the breaking remains and nothing can be built.

When both of you are strong, quarrels are hard to avoid. But precisely because neither is behind the other, you respect each other in return; do not fight over whose word decides, but first say the matter clearly. The two of you live together on the solemn side, passion is not the main thread, as if being together makes both of you more dignified, so intimacy must be arranged by you taking the initiative: set aside a fixed time each week for just the two of you, without talking about work or the children.

The two of you suit each other and love each other, and your spouse's circumstances are not lacking; if malefic stars are met, marry a little later, and marrying late is, on the contrary, long-lasting.

The two stars share a palace only at the Ox and Goat palaces, both of which belong to the Four Tombs, positions of storing and accumulating. The “Complete Book” says “the Greedy Wolf meeting the Bell Star and Fire Star at the Four Tombs makes a wealthy family, a marquis, earl or nobleman”, meaning the Greedy Wolf at the Four Tombs meeting the Bell Star and Fire Star accumulates a great fortune at home and also has high standing; when it meets the Fire Star and Bell Star it forms the Fire Star with Greedy Wolf pattern or the Bell Star with Greedy Wolf pattern, and money easily surges all at once. If the Life palace has no benefic stars and only the Body palace (another key position of the chart) is seated by these two stars, the old books conversely say you will be solitary and poor but pure.

The two stars share a palace only at the Ox and Goat palaces, both of which belong to the Four Tombs, positions of storing and accumulating. The “Complete Book” says “the Greedy Wolf meeting the Bell Star and Fire Star at the Four Tombs makes a wealthy family, a marquis, earl or nobleman”, meaning the Greedy Wolf at the Four Tombs meeting the Bell Star and Fire Star accumulates a great fortune at home and also has high standing; when it meets the Fire Star and Bell Star it forms the Fire Star with Greedy Wolf pattern or the Bell Star with Greedy Wolf pattern, and money easily surges all at once. If the Life palace has no benefic stars and only the Body palace (another key position of the chart) is seated by these two stars, the old books conversely say you will be solitary and poor but pure. When the Greedy Wolf is transformed to Prosperity (money coming in), you shift from the martial path into business. When Martial is transformed to Prosperity, funds flow in strongly and there is a lot of money in your career.

The two stars share a palace only at the Ox and Goat palaces, always one bright and one dim; the old texts say “the Sun and Moon guarding the Life palace are not as good as shining on it from afar”, meaning that crowding into one palace is not as good as being apart and shining across from another palace. At the Ox palace it counts as “ordinary, a middling pattern”, meaning average and slightly common; at the Goat palace the strength is greater. Both stars must be bright to be good, and if one is dim it is weakened. The old texts also say “Sun and Moon meeting in the Life palace at the Ox or Goat, with no transformation in the trine palaces, blessings are hard to bestow”, meaning that for a person whose Life palace is at the Ox or Goat, if the trine and opposite palaces have no benefic transformation to help, blessings cannot be thick. With Transformation to Prosperity (money coming in), Power (holding authority) and Fame (reputation), and also the Left Assistant, Right Assistant, Literary Talent and Literary Arts gathering in, you have name and standing; if malefic stars gather, you toil all life and achieve nothing.

The two stars share a palace only at the Ox and Goat palaces, always one bright and one dim; the old texts say “the Sun and Moon guarding the Life palace are not as good as shining on it from afar”, meaning that crowding into one palace is not as good as being apart and shining across from another palace. At the Ox palace it counts as “ordinary, a middling pattern”, meaning average and slightly common; at the Goat palace the strength is greater. Both stars must be bright to be good, and if one is dim it is weakened. If malefic stars gather, you toil all life and achieve nothing.
With the two martial stars seated in the Life palace, you easily take the road of real authority, but your family estate depends on yourself, and money comes and goes.

With the two stars that govern romance sharing a palace, your affinity with the opposite sex is especially strong, you have many talents and skills, and you should watch out for romantic entanglements.
You live with generosity and experience, modest and upright, but in your very bones you are solitary, like standing in high places, and do not often blend in with people.

In dealing with people you must learn to be rounded and smooth, turning a sharp way of expressing yourself into persuasive communication. Inside you have a very strong drive for truth and for argument, which suits the paths of philosophy, law and research. Master Hi Di also points out the Great Gate's flaw of “agreeing to your face and denying behind your back”, meaning one way in front and another way behind; so words must pass through the head once before they reach the mouth, and if you get past this hurdle, eloquence is an asset, otherwise it is a burden.

Take the initiative to give your mother a little warmth in words. A single sentence like “you've worked so hard, Mom” does more than buying her anything. With your father, don't compare who is harder-headed; come home to eat regularly, talk about things he understands, and judge his choices less. After marriage, with your parents-in-law be respectful on the surface, and if you have opinions, speak to your husband in private; don't, in front of him, list his parents' faults, which saves a great deal of trouble later.

Because of this sense of principle, you easily seem old beyond your years and conservative, and do not get along with people your own age; in romance you are used to playing the caregiver. This maturity is innate, and suits roles that need to be trusted, for example adviser, doctor or teacher. True loneliness requires falling into the Fallen position (weak) and also meeting the Fire Star, Bell Star, Ram Blade and Hindrance; ordinarily it is just that you do not like squeezing into crowds.

The classics have two other sayings for sharing a palace: sharing with the Strategist is “set in place, rich in old age”, so the family estate only becomes thick in old age; sharing with Harmony is “first retreat, then advance”, taking a step back first and only then moving forward.

The classics say the Emperor at the Snake or Pig palace seated with the Seven Killings, for people born in a Yin Wood or Yang Earth year, counts as the pattern of wealth and rank, with both money and standing. This means that when the Fire Star, Bell Star, Ram Blade and Hindrance all gather in, the Seven Killings sharing the palace mostly cannot be noble, easily overpowers people, and is also prone to solitude and injury. Even when a pattern forms, you must check the Decade and the Yearly periods (the fortune of that year): if a Yearly period meets malefic stars but the Emperor, Minister and Wealth Keeper shine across, it is lightened.

The classics say the Emperor at the Snake or Pig palace seated with the Seven Killings, for people born in a Yin Wood or Yang Earth year, counts as the pattern of wealth and rank, with both money and standing. For a man's chart there is also an old line: “Fire Star, Bell Star, Ram Blade and Hindrance coming together, the Seven Killings sharing the palace mostly is not noble, looks down on people, solitary, and prone to punishment and injury.” This means that when the Fire Star, Bell Star, Ram Blade and Hindrance all gather in, the Seven Killings sharing the palace mostly cannot be noble, easily overpowers people, and is also prone to solitude and injury. Even when a pattern forms, you must check the Decade and the Yearly periods (the fortune of that year): if a Yearly period meets malefic stars but the Emperor, Minister and Wealth Keeper shine across, it is lightened.

The classics also write of a side opposite to the outward appearance, the original words being “a person with large eyes and a hasty nature, joy and anger unpredictable, advancing and retreating in doubt when doing things”, which in plain words means: large eyes, hasty nature, feelings that change as fast as you say, and when a big matter truly needs deciding, weighing back and forth and never settling. The “Rhapsody on Form and Nature” compares the Seven Killings to Zilu, “catching a tiger bare-handed, wading a river without a boat”, meaning fighting a tiger with bare hands and wading across a river without a boat, courage rushing ahead and calculation coming afterward.

The classics have two more points about moderation. The second: if this pattern is clashed or broken by the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star, then a person with the Seven Killings seated in the Life palace has a tough will and likes taking risks, and suits the military, police, start-ups, and high-risk high-return industries; struggling on your own is the basic tone of this kind of life pattern.

The classics say the Great Gate in the Friends palace means “much resentment and opposition”, meaning the people around you often carry resentment and like to go against your wishes; volume two adds a line, “entering the Temple, at first it is not helpful, it invites gossip and trouble, and does not stay long”, meaning that even when the Great Gate enters the Temple (a star strong in this position), friends and subordinates cannot help at first, and also invite gossip and trouble, not staying attached for long. Many in your circle of friends speak well, so there are also many disputes, and drifting apart after just a few words is common.

The classics say the Great Gate in the Siblings palace means “flesh and blood like two stars that never meet”, meaning that blood siblings are like two stars that never appear together, unable to gather. Volume two also says it plainly: “Temple or Prosperous, two persons; in a Fallen position, half-siblings, and they should live apart”, meaning that when the Great Gate enters the Temple (a star strong in this position) there are about two siblings, and when it falls into the Fallen position (weak) there are siblings by a different mother (the original words “half-siblings”), and it is also best to live separately. If the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery are added, the old texts judge it as “solitary and clashing”. You do not have many siblings, your thinking is hard to unify, and living apart early actually brings fewer clashes; among siblings there is much quarrelling, and one ill-fitting remark turns into a misunderstanding. Partnerships must be handled with great care: the rules, the way money is divided and the mechanism for withdrawing should all be put in black and white beforehand.

The classics say the Great Gate in the Spouse palace means “better to be older”, meaning a spouse a few years older than you suits better; volume one also says “governs being separated by a layer”, meaning there is always a layer between the two of you, and conversation does not mesh; volume two writes more directly “certain clash, lacking harmony”, meaning affection easily lacks harmony, and with malefic stars added it “governs separation in life”, meaning you easily end up living apart for long periods. So with the Great Gate seated in the Spouse palace, there is a lot of arguing in words, and what you need most is patience and tolerance. Your spouse speaks well and has views of their own, and for that very reason you easily quarrel; the most common situation of the Great Gate in the Spouse palace is “saying too much and hurting feelings”.

The classics say the Great Gate in the Children palace means “loss first, then a child appears: though there is one, it is as if there were none”, and volume two writes “hard first, easy afterward”, meaning that children come rather late, the process has setbacks, and the bond between parents and children is also light; with the Great Gate entering the Temple (a star strong in this position), it is hard first and smooth afterward. With the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star added, the Great Gate entry in the “Complete Book” says “few children”. Your children speak well, like to argue and have quick minds, and “talking back to their parents from a young age” is common, meaning that even as a tiny child they can answer back to adults; but parents and children clash in words a lot, and harsh words easily leave scars in a child's heart.

The classics say the Great Gate in the Career palace means “entering the Temple, a martial post of power and rank; scholars do not last”, meaning that when the Great Gate enters the Temple (a star strong in this position) you take a road with real authority such as law enforcement or a disciplined force, where you can have power and standing, while a position resting purely on writing in turn does not last; volume one also notes “in the Career palace it governs drawing punishment and the rod”, meaning that in your career you easily draw blame, punishment and lawsuits, and a remark out of place easily brings disaster. With the Great Gate in the Temple you speak well and know how to lecture, and could be a school principal. So the Great Gate's career takes the “mouth” as its root, meaning living by speech: lawyer, teacher, media announcer, fortune-teller, negotiation specialist and diplomat are all stages for it, but beneath it there must be professional knowledge and real authority to hold it up.

The classics say the Great Gate in the Parents palace means “meeting abandonment”, meaning that in childhood you easily leave your parents; volume two writes “in a Fallen position, harm and clash, leaving the ancestral home to be an adopted child”, meaning that when the Great Gate falls into the Fallen position (a star weak in this position), the bond between parents and children is thin, in childhood you may leave home, be given away to be adopted, or go far from your hometown, spending little time with your parents. With your parents or superiors, there are many quarrels and much gossip, communication easily breeds misunderstanding, and “I didn't mean that” is a common line. Sharing the palace with the Sun, the old texts say “seldom in harmony”, sharing with the Strategist you must pay homage to parents anew, sharing with Harmony “perhaps leaving the ancestral home without punishment”, and with the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added, “your parents are not complete”.

The classics say the Great Gate in the Property palace means “scattering the ancestral estate”, meaning the ancestors' family property will be lost; volume two says it in more detail: “Temple or Prosperous, a sudden windfall to buy property; in a Fallen position, no share, and trouble over the family fields”, meaning that when the Great Gate enters the Temple (a star strong in this position) you can still buy assets and even get an unexpected sum, while in the Fallen position (weak) you are not given a share of the land and houses, and you also draw gossip and trouble over houses and fields. With the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added, the classics say “no property at all”. Property contracts and ownership are important, and it is best to record every clause clearly.

The classics say the Great Gate in the Fortune palace means “a slightly lighter misfortune”, meaning that although it is the same dark star (governing quarrels and gossip), falling in the Fortune palace it is lighter than falling in the palaces of relatives; but volume two still writes “the Great Gate toils and is uneasy”, meaning worry and strain, which is a drain on mental energy, not a disaster coming from outside. With the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added, volume two says “a lifetime of many worries”, meaning a whole life of much anxiety. In spirit you think a lot and worry a lot, your heart is heavy with quarrelsome energy, and you easily analyse one matter over and over; “one sentence going round the head for a lap” is an everyday thing, and it is very hard to truly relax.

The classics say the Great Gate in the Wealth palace means “making a fortune and a career from empty hands; earn money in lively places”, meaning you do not rely on what your forefathers left but build your career from nothing, and money must be earned where crowds are busy; the classics also warn “a person of high spirits and a headstrong nature easily goes to ruin”, meaning that a person of high ambition and pride who speaks too far easily suffers a sudden loss of money. Volume one also says the Great Gate in the Wealth palace “has a mind to contend”, meaning money comes through contention, and you also easily quarrel with people over money.

The classics say the Great Gate in the Travel palace means “abroad, toiling in mind and uneasy, with people there is not enough, much gossip and trouble”, meaning that in another place your heart cannot settle, living with people always lacks a breath, and gossip follows behind, so when away from home you should be especially restrained in speech. But the Great Gate is also very good at making a living through eloquence in faraway places, and work such as law, education, media, sales and consulting have even more opportunity when you go elsewhere.

When buying a home, first choose a good location. The city centre, near a metro station, next to a good school: getting one of these is enough, and it is the root of your family wealth. In second-tier cities and below, buying a home purely to profit from price differences calls for caution; your money comes from good assets slowly rising in value, not from short-term flipping. Before buying, lay out and say clearly to your wife whose name goes on the title and who manages the money at home. Decorating in a steady, proper way is enough; being too showy brings gossip in return.

Buy a home at your own pace. First find a comfortable place to live and settle your life, and only then talk about a second one; do not stretch yourself too tight chasing the market. When signing a purchase contract, read every word, and write ownership, floor area and handover date clearly; do not mind the trouble. Decorate toward softness and warmth: warm colours, good light, and the bedroom on the quiet side. When you sleep well, you are a different person the next day, and this is the root of how you nourish your health.

When buying a home and signing the contract, read every word. Whose name is on the title, the floor area and the handover date should all be written clearly in black and white; do not mind the trouble. In the house you must keep a corner that belongs only to you: a reading room, a balcony, a yoga mat will all do, and when you are in a poor state, go and stay there, which restores you faster than finding someone to complain to. Decorate toward softness, with warm colours and good light, and add some greenery and little things you like; when you live comfortably, you are steady.
Your career is respectable and well supplied, and you suit holding real authority and key positions.
Your career is small first and large later, with a hard start and a rise only after middle age.
With the Strategist and Moon in the Career palace, you suit civil service and clerical posts, standing firm on a stable position; do not force a heavy-handed push into new ground.
With the Emperor and Treasury in the Career palace, the “Complete Book” says “the Career palace meeting the Emperor and Treasury: rich and also noble”.
With the Emperor and Greedy Wolf in the Career palace, you do well in both civil and military roles, and on meeting the Fire Star and Bell Star you hold even more real authority.
Your career depends on your mouth for a living; the Rabbit palace goes well, while the Rooster palace starts beautifully but is hard to sustain.
Your career depends on reputation, suits civil service and media, and does not suit staying quietly behind the scenes.

With the Seven Killings in the Friends palace, your friends are few but excellent, and in your circle are mostly substantial people who are also strong and independent; “being able to fight shoulder to shoulder” matters more than “drinking buddies or dinner companions”. The warning of the classics for this palace is quite heavy: the Seven Killings in the Friends palace (the palace of friends) means “servants who are hard and overbearing toward their master, and many who steal from the household”, which in plain words means those below you are tough, can overpower you as their master, and may even take money from the house; sharing the palace with Martial it also “turns against its master”, meaning you are betrayed by your own people; with the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added, you cannot even recruit anyone. Taken together: your subordinates are capable but not easy to command, easily turn the guest into the host, and in money matters also make you suffer hidden losses. When employing people you must set rules, and keep money and signing authority in your own hands; do not take “valuing loyalty” as a reason not to guard yourself.
With Harmony in the Friends palace, the old texts say “capable and flourishing helpers”, and your subordinates are capable.

With Harmony in the Friends palace, your friends are mild-tempered and your dealings with them are light and cheerful; subordinates in particular are Harmony's strong point. The classics say Harmony in the Friends palace is “capable and flourishing helpers”, meaning those below you are capable and help get things done; sharing the palace with Heavenly Beam, someone is willing to keep the house and the business for you, sharing with the Moon, subordinates are capable, and sharing with the Great Gate, it is hard first and easy afterward. With Harmony falling in this palace, speaking of friends, this side of subordinates is harmonious.

With the Treasury in the Friends palace, the “Complete Book” says “the Treasury, capable: one shout brings a hundred answers”, meaning subordinates are capable, and the moment you open your mouth a whole crowd responds; it also says that with the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added, “mostly they turn against their master and run away”, meaning subordinates easily leave behind your back. Whether they are capable depends entirely on whether malefic stars are present. Your circle of friends is not large but of high quality, your subordinates are solid, their ability to carry things out is assured, and it is a very well-running team. But Master Hi Di places this friends palace in the Treasury's “fallen and weak” position, meaning the Treasury's strength here is slightly weak, so even with capable subordinates, do not stake your whole enterprise on people, and money dealings are best recorded clearly in the books.

With the Treasury in the Friends palace, the old texts say “the Treasury, capable: one shout brings a hundred answers”, and the moment you open your mouth a whole group responds; the same books also place the Friends palace in the Treasury's fallen and weak position, so money dealings must be recorded clearly in the books.
With the Strategist in the Friends palace, you may have many friends, but you must judge people accurately.

With the Strategist in the Friends palace, your friends and subordinates are clever and quick, with wide connections, but they move around a lot. The old texts distinguish this very clearly: when the Strategist enters the Temple (a star strong here), subordinates really help get things done; when it falls into the Fallen position (weak) or meets Road Block (a star falling into an empty place), the old texts write “resent their master”, meaning outwardly harmonious but inwardly resenting the person at the head, which is you; sharing the palace with Heavenly Beam, you only find usable people in old age, sharing with the Moon, the helpers are not capable; if the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery are added, you basically cannot count on others and have to rely on yourself for everything. So you can make friends widely, but you must judge people accurately, since truly lasting and trustworthy soulmates are not many by nature.

With Heavenly Beam in the Friends palace, the “Complete Book” says “Heavenly Beam: many servants, making the master prosper”, meaning there are many subordinates who can make you, the master, prosper; sharing the palace with Harmony, someone helps keep the house, sharing with the Strategist, they are not of one mind. Your friends and subordinates are mostly experienced people who take responsibility, willing to mind the counter for you, and at key moments someone really steps up. Volume one also says that Heavenly Beam “in the Friends, Health and Appearance palaces is judged as abundant”, meaning Heavenly Beam seated in the Friends, Health and Appearance palaces is judged as thick and in surplus, so this palace in turn stands for plentiful personnel.
With the Minister in the Friends palace, the old texts say “chosen only late in the years”, and capable subordinates come only in old age.

With the Minister in the Friends palace, your friends are loyal and reliable, the quality of your circle is steady, and the people you befriend are mostly of the “not dazzling but trustworthy” kind. The old texts say the Minister in the Friends palace is “chosen only late in the years”, meaning that truly capable subordinates and helpers mostly come together only in old age; lacking people in youth is common, and there is no need to rush to doubt yourself. Among friends, helping each other sincerely comes first; your partners are steady administrative companions, who also lack leading force and need you to be the brain. With the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added, your subordinates cannot be put to use, and may even leave you, so look closely before handing over work. Meeting the Earth Void and Earth Robbery, written documents in partnerships go wrong, and seals and contracts need careful checking.
With the Sun in the Friends palace, your circle of friends is wide, and among your acquaintances are quite a few people with reputation and standing.

With the Sun in the Friends palace, your circle of friends is wide, and your acquaintances mostly have social standing and reputation; entering the Temple (Temple = this star is strong here), your friends and benefactors help get things done, relationships easily turn into real benefit, and subordinates are also willing to give their effort. Falling into the Fallen position (weak), the old texts say “in a Fallen palace there is no share, and even if there are people, they resent their master and will leave”, meaning you receive no support, and even if there are people they resent you and in the end cannot be kept. Whether Temple or Fallen, as long as the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star are added, the old texts say “servants turn against their master”, meaning subordinates or partners turn and bite you once.

With the Moon in the Friends palace, your friends are mostly gentle and refined, which especially suits female friends, your circle is rich in feeling, and you often have a soulmate to confide in; your subordinates are meticulous. The classics say that when the Moon enters the Temple (Temple = this star is strong in this position, Fallen = weak), subordinates are capable and manpower comes in an orderly crowd; falling into the Fallen position, the old texts say “in a Fallen position, nothing at all”, and you cannot recruit even one helper. Whether Temple or Fallen, with the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added, the old texts say “though there are some, they leave”, so even if people come you cannot keep them, and they change constantly like a revolving lantern.
With the Moon in the Friends palace, your friends are gentle and you can confide in them.
With Integrity in the Friends palace, your circle is mostly people with talents and skills who are rich in feeling, and you must see people clearly before employing them.
With Martial in the Friends palace, your friends are mostly made on the basis of benefit and cooperation.

With the Army Breaker in the Friends palace, the classics say “entering the Temple, capable; in a Fallen palace, it draws resentment and turns against its master”, which in plain words is: when the Army Breaker enters the Temple (= strong), your subordinates and friends are willing to put in effort for you; falling into the Fallen position (weak), you easily draw resentment and are betrayed. Volume one says it more heavily, “in the Friends palace, they complain, resent, and leave”, meaning those below you speak ill of you behind your back and finally leave outright. With the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added, it is “hard to recruit”, people are hard to find, and even if found they cannot be kept. What friends bring you is mostly change and breakthroughs, not steady support; they show you a new road, but do not necessarily walk slowly along it with you.
With the Army Breaker in the Friends palace, your circle of friends changes a lot, people coming and going.

With the Emperor in the Friends palace, your subordinates form ranks and are willing to give their effort, and the old texts say “forming ranks and capable, making the master prosper and generate wealth”.

With the Greedy Wolf in the Friends palace, your circle of friends is very wide, and the people around you are mostly of many talents and skills with lively desires, with “night-time friends” and “friends from the arts world” existing together, meaning there are both people who like to play and people who create; that kind of pleasure-seeking circle influences you not a little, and you must learn to sift, since not every “enthusiasm” deserves a reply.

With the Greedy Wolf in the Friends palace, you have many friends but mixed ones, and the old texts say “at first it is hard to recruit, and servants ruin the master”, so when employing people, hand over authority slowly.

With the Emperor in the Friends palace (also called the friends palace), the old texts' judgment is “forming ranks and capable, making the master prosper and generate wealth”, meaning those below you come in crowds and can really be put to use, and this group even makes you prosper and earns money on your behalf, a rare path of gaining wealth for the Emperor; sharing the palace with the Minister is capable in the same way. With the Ram Blade, Fire Star, Bell Star and Hindrance added, you cannot direct people, and with many people you still cannot push things through; with the Earth Void and Earth Robbery added, you draw even more blame and complaints, and people you trained turn their backs and leave. Among your friends are many people with status, dealings lean toward the formal, and you must know how to delegate and respect the other side, since keeping a haughty attitude easily loses people's hearts. Volume one also places the Friends palace among the Emperor's four Fallen palaces, the original words being “if it falls in the Health, Siblings, Friends or Appearance palaces, the four Fallen palaces, it governs a person who toils and achieves nothing, and although helped, it is no blessing”, meaning that falling here, even if people help you, it does not count as a blessing. Volume two says capable, volume one says Fallen palace, and the two sayings exist side by side.
You are steady, pure of heart, upright and generous, yet your personality is very strong.

Once your child enters middle school, start practising letting go. For things the child can decide, hand over more each year than the year before, manage less of exactly how it is done, and say more clearly where the boundaries lie. When you talk, turn commands into questions; “how do you plan to do it” works far better than “how should you do it”. If you really do argue, take a step back first and wait until both sides are calm before talking. The most precious things you can give your child are resources and understanding, not choosing the road for them in advance.

From a young age, build the habit of recording your menstrual periods. On days you feel unwell, and whether the flow is heavy or light, write a line, so that when you see a doctor you can explain clearly. Do not skimp on yearly health check-ups, and have the women's health items checked regularly as your doctor advises. Eat mainly warming, nourishing food, avoid cold and chilling things, and take care to keep warm before and after your period. Choose gentle exercise: yoga, tai chi and swimming are all good. If you plan a pregnancy, look after your body for half a year beforehand; if after giving birth your spirits sink, do not force yourself to endure it, tell your family, and when needed find a professional to help; if problems arise, see a doctor promptly and follow the doctor's advice.

They really do give you mostly understanding and ideas, but do not take “only discussing spirit, not real matters” as the conclusion; that phrase speaks of supporting only in spirit and not doing real work, while the tone of the old texts is in fact that these people can make you prosper and truly help get things done. Judging people is what matters: when Heavenly Beam shares a palace with the Strategist, these people are not of one mind, so be careful before using them.
You know how to enjoy yourself and have mixed interests, yet your heart will not settle; you are prone to vanity, and only by knowing moderation do you have good fortune.

But the “Bone Marrow Rhapsody” also leaves a reminder: “Heavenly Beam and Heavenly Horse in the Fallen position: drifting without doubt”, meaning that when Heavenly Beam falls into the Fallen position (weak) and also meets the Heavenly Horse, going out means running about everywhere with no fixed place to live; it is not the setup of a person with benefactors.

But the “Bone Marrow Rhapsody” also leaves a reminder: “Heavenly Beam and Heavenly Horse in the Fallen position: drifting without doubt”, meaning that when Heavenly Beam falls into the Fallen position (weak) and also meets the Heavenly Horse, going out means running about everywhere with no fixed place to live; it is not the setup of a person with benefactors. Transformation to Fame (reputation) means that away from home, people notice you through your learning and reputation.

But if the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star are added, someone near you will betray you; and meeting the Earth Void and Earth Robbery too, they will even leave because they resent you. With Transformation to Taboo (obstruction), relationships are out of harmony and cooperation is loose; with Taboo in the Friends palace, going into business with people or standing guarantor for people ends in failure for sure; you still have to choose people, since a good temperament does not mean someone can work with you.

But the Army Breaker by nature breaks first and rebuilds afterward, and in finances opens wide and closes wide. The old texts say plainly of this kind of life pattern “breaks the ancestors and breaks the family, toiling hard”, meaning you cannot keep the estate left from earlier generations and must also work hard to manage things yourself, so you mostly cannot count on the ancestral property and must build your career from empty hands; volume one also says that the Army Breaker with Martial in the palace that manages money means “money enters the hand and turns to nothing”, meaning that money entering your hand also becomes empty, coming in but not staying.

But the Army Breaker by nature breaks first and rebuilds afterward, and in finances opens wide and closes wide. The old texts say plainly of this kind of life pattern “breaks the ancestors and breaks the family, toiling hard”, meaning you cannot keep the estate left from earlier generations and must also work hard to manage things yourself, so you mostly cannot count on the ancestral property and must build your career from empty hands; volume one also says that the Army Breaker with Martial in the palace that manages money means “money enters the hand and turns to nothing”, meaning that money entering your hand also becomes empty, coming in but not staying. For a woman's chart: a general star falling in a woman's life pattern is not favoured, because such a person has too heavy a desire for power.

But when it falls in the Fallen position (weak), it must be read separately: the classics say “Heavenly Beam in a Fallen position, meeting the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star, is solitary and clashing, leaves the ancestral home to live as a son-in-law, or changes its name and is entrusted to others”, meaning that when Heavenly Beam falls into the Fallen position and the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star are added, the person is solitary, the bond with relatives is thin, and they easily leave the home they came from, live as a son-in-law in the wife's family, or change their name and be entrusted to another family to be raised; leaving home in childhood and living in someone else's house are, on the contrary, common.

But when it falls in the Fallen position (weak), it must be read separately: the classics say “Heavenly Beam in a Fallen position, meeting the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star, is solitary and clashing, leaves the ancestral home to live as a son-in-law, or changes its name and is entrusted to others”, meaning that when Heavenly Beam falls into the Fallen position and the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star are added, the person is solitary, the bond with relatives is thin, and they easily leave the home they came from, live as a son-in-law in the wife's family, or change their name and be entrusted to another family to be raised; leaving home in childhood and living in someone else's house are, on the contrary, common. Transformation to Fame (reputation) means your parents are respected by others for their learning and virtue.
In where you live, you value mood and a sense of design, and like a house with a story.

The moment you step out of the house, you easily meet someone who gives you a hand. Leaving familiar places is actually smoother than staying put, and those who help you are mostly older and senior. Marrying far away brings you extra benefit: you are mature, neither arrogant nor humble, and quickly stand firm in your husband's family, even becoming a pillar there. The price is the distance from your parents: you are deeply attached to them, and living far away, your heart is always uneasy.

The moment you step out of the house, you easily meet someone who gives you a hand. Leaving familiar places is actually smoother than staying put, and those who help you are mostly older and senior. Marrying far away brings you extra benefit: you are mature, neither arrogant nor humble, and quickly stand firm in your husband's family, even becoming a pillar there. The price is the distance from your parents: you are deeply attached to them, and living far away, your heart is always uneasy. Transformation to Fame (reputation) means that in another place you make professional achievements.

The moment you leave your hometown, you easily meet someone who gives you a hand. Leaving your hometown is actually smoother than staying put, and those who help you are mostly older and senior. Transformation to Fame (reputation) means that in another place you make professional achievements. One thing to watch: in another place you especially easily become the person everyone turns to when they have a problem, you do not refuse when they come, and in the end you wear yourself out.

The moment you leave your hometown, you easily meet someone who gives you a hand. Leaving your hometown is actually smoother than staying put, and those who help you are mostly older and senior.
