One thing to watch: in another place you especially easily become the person everyone turns to when they have a problem, you do not refuse when they come, and in the end you wear yourself out.

You have always been described as strong-willed and imposing. This is not meant badly; it says that your independence and decisiveness exceed the ordinary. You learned to carry things alone earlier than women your age, and you dare to decide more than quite a few of the men around you. You do not act coy, and do not like people who do; your view of love is straightforward, either you love deeply or you do not love, with no murky middle ground. This makes many men both admire you and fear you a little, admiring your independence and fearing your forcefulness. A nine-to-five life suffocates you, and you suit a position where you can decide for yourself.

The greatest burden of your life is wanting to hold everything in your hands. But life by nature cannot be held. A suggestion: after middle age, find something repetitive with a rhythm, such as tai chi, sitting meditation or slow yoga, three times a week, to pull your mind away from calculation. When you have thought through the risk to an acceptable level, stop; do not keep imagining the worst case again and again. Set a bottom line for money, and as long as this line does not break, do not count the rest.

You are not a talkative person; where someone else says a word about something, you finish in three sentences. It is not coldness: in your head, acting always comes before opening your mouth, and if a thing can be solved, you do not grind it away with talk. Your way of loving someone is to give a sense of security, steady income, and to say what you will do and do it, not sweet words, so in romance you are often called wooden or stiff; in truth you care very much inside, but you just cannot say it. In temper you flare quickly and pass quickly, and do not hold anger overnight. What you cannot stand most is vagueness; you feel at ease only when things are clear in black and white.

You are unwilling to live by the script others have written in advance for women. From a young age you have wanted to live as yourself. You dare to break rules, overturn prejudices and make choices others do not dare, which gives you special drive in your career and in starting businesses, and your life also rises and falls more than other people's. You do not fit in with groups very well, and you do not calculate benefits so closely either. Army Breaker people are usually thin, a point from physiognomy to be checked against the chart, which needs to be compared directly. Stability, repetition and being boxed in are three things you cannot stand, and nine-to-five is a torture to you.

You do not need to grind down your own strength. What needs changing is the script: a person like you cannot live the life of the traditional good wife, so find someone who is your equal, with each of you having your own stage. When choosing a partner look at only one thing: whether he is uncomfortable with you being strong, and if he is, don't force it. When you are truly together, say clearly which matters each of you decides alone and which you decide together.

Your greatest help in your career is relationships. Colleagues are glad to cooperate, your benefactors are mostly gentle elders, or someone in your circle introduces you on your behalf, work in general goes fairly smoothly, and you can keep things going fairly well without taking too many risks. Services, health care, education, art and design, restaurants and hotels, industries that deal with people and require patience suit you best. In a team you are the lubricant, coordinating relationships is your strength, but pushing the schedule and making decisions is not. It is not that you can only do light work; the question is whether anyone pushes you to the front.

You are both inclined toward the conservative. Your days are peaceful with few big conflicts, and the problem is that it easily becomes so flat it turns bland. A suggestion: do not wait for him to set the pace; each month, take the initiative to arrange one thing for the two of you, going out for a meal, watching a film, a weekend trip, to break the inertia. If something bothers you, say so that same day and do not store it up; once you store it up, it lasts years. Putting trustworthiness first when choosing someone is right, but also notice: can you relax when you are with him?

You are both inclined toward the conservative. Your days are peaceful with very few quarrels, and the problem is that it easily becomes so flat it turns bland. A suggestion: do not wait for her to lead; each month, take the initiative to arrange one thing for the two of you: going out for a meal, watching a film, a short trip, to break the inertia. If you are not good at talking, make up for it with actions: keep her matters in mind, and prepare for important days a day ahead. If you disagree, say so clearly that same day and do not store it up; once you store it up, it lasts years.

You are both rich in feeling and strongly in tune. But when you both flare up together, negative emotions amplify each other. Set one rule: when emotions rise, each of you stays apart for half an hour, whoever calms down first speaks first, and you do not discuss serious matters while angry. Say the details you care about out loud, and do not wait for him to guess; if you do not say them, he truly does not know. When you are upset, say that you need him to be with you for a while, which works far better than a cold face waiting for him to notice.

Your family has been a reasonable one from childhood. Among the siblings, any topic can be debated. There are not many of you, and your thinking is hard to bring to one place, so each living their own life actually brings fewer clashes.

The two of you live together on the formal side. Passion is not the main thread, as if you are simply together in a more dignified way, so intimacy must be arranged by you taking the initiative: set aside one evening each week to eat out alone together or take a walk, without discussing work or either family. When you quarrel, do not rush to decide who is right and who is wrong; first say clearly what each of you can decide, and talking through this boundary before the wedding saves far more trouble than working it out after the wedding. Do not rush to settle; marrying a little later is, on the contrary, steadier.

Your physical strength is fairly good and your energy is abundant, but your fire energy is abundant too, and when you get busy you easily run dry. As for which part of your body needs attention, look at the palace where malefic stars gather most in the whole chart, and match the organ to that palace's earthly branch (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig Triple Burner), not by the Five Elements of the Sun in the Health palace. You use your eyes a lot, and your eyes need extra care. During pregnancy and childbirth, you mostly do not want to rest, the pressure is great, and the burden on your body needs special attention.

Your physical foundation is good and your energy is abundant. But you are also the one most easily drained, you do not know when to stop once busy, and when emotions rise, your fire energy is large too. As for which part of your body needs attention, look at the palace where malefic stars gather most in the whole chart, and match the organ to that palace's earthly branch (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig Triple Burner), not by the Five Elements of the Sun in the Health palace. You use your eyes a lot and are often in front of strong light and screens, so your eyes need extra care; if your social calendar is packed too tight, your resistance falls along with it.

You work more decisively than most people, and decisions come quickly to you. Acting coy is, for you, almost another language; it is not that you do not want to learn it, but that you cannot pick it up. From a young age you understood that your own ability is more reliable than leaning on anyone, which makes you especially steady in career and money. The price is that in close relationships you easily push people away: you do not need to be looked after, and the other person does not know where to approach you from. In temper you flare quickly and pass quickly, and do not hold anger overnight; the people beside you have not yet recovered their breath while you turned the page long ago.

You work carefully and thoughtfully. You look after the places others do not notice, and whether at the office or at home, you are the one who holds the situation up. But much of the work is yours, and in the end the glory in front of the stage often falls on others. Your gentle, cooperative manner is only your outward appearance; your inner ambition is no less than any man's, so don't regard yourself only as a supporting role. In romance you are loyal and steady, and once you have settled on someone you put your all into nurturing it; but if you accommodate too much, your own views gradually disappear and your grievances pile up.

You live by the proper path and your mind is also nimble, you just do not like to show it. You are not dawdling, you simply do not contend: you do not like to put yourself forward, but everything that reaches your hands you arrange in good order; you do not like arguing with people, yet inside you are actually very clear. Your steadiness gives your partner a sense of security, and the household runs smoothly. But this steadiness is easily underestimated, and people only see that you are gentle, not the intelligence in your heart. You suit best being the mainstay of the household, but that does not mean you can only manage domestic matters; in today's world you can fully have a career of your own, only at a slower, steadier pace than others.

Going out is not just about holding your ground. You also easily meet people willing to give you a hand, and your road opens wider than if you stayed in one place. Best suited are finance, banking, insurance and cross-regional transfers in traditional industries, standing firm on accumulating bit by bit, and not hoping for a change of fortune overnight.

When you go out, you easily meet people willing to help you. It is not that you do not suit going far. Your development in other places is mainly steady accumulation, and does not follow the path of changing your fortune overnight. When you arrive somewhere new, give priority to places with a stable foundation or with professional expertise to rely on, and do not rest your own footing on someone else's prospects.

Going out, you are the type who has people to help. In a new place you easily meet people willing to give you a hand, and many opportunities come through other people's introductions, not through your scrambling for them. Starting from zero in another place and slowly standing firm is workable for you, especially in restaurant chains, hotels, cultural tourism and the arts, and going into business with others to work in another place also suits you. With Transformation to Taboo (obstruction), you easily take detours when away from home; choose familiar places, keep a slightly slower pace, and do not push yourself.

Going out, you have more opportunity than at home. Money and roads are often made at banquet tables, in social gatherings, and in the give and take of human relationships, only you really do get tired. Going to other places and developing overseas is a plus for you, but alone in a strange city, the feeling of loneliness is also heavier than for others. In social venues and nightlife away from home you most easily meet the person who stirs you most, and a long-distance relationship is especially hard for you to bear.

Going out, your luck is not bad. There are always people willing to give you a hand and point out the road. But you are not the type to carry a bag to a strange place and build a career from nothing; your road is, after reaching another place, to enter a stable setting and slowly climb: a large company, a state agency, a professional organisation, with promotion in order is your proper path. Alone away from home for long, you easily feel lonely and in control of nothing.

Going out, your luck is not bad, and there are always people willing to give you a hand and point out the road. But you are not the type to carry a bag to a strange city and build a career from nothing; what suits you is, after reaching another place, to enter a stable setting and slowly stand firm. Marrying far away is a double-edged sword for you: you are courteous and steady, and fitting into your husband's family circle is not hard; but once your own family is not beside you, your good nature is easily taken for weakness, and in everything someone has a hold on you.

Going out, you will meet benefactors. Leave your locality; if you keep to the little circle in front of your door, you feel more stifled and more anxious the longer you stay. Big cities, the coast or overseas all suit you better than your home area for showing your abilities.

In another place your heart does not settle easily. Living with people always lacks a breath, and gossip follows behind. The good is that your ability to express yourself helps you stand firm quickly in a strange place, and education, consulting, media and cross-border business are directions that are especially popular; the bad is that in a strange land among strangers, your words are especially easily misunderstood.

In another place your heart does not settle again easily. Living with people always lacks a breath, and gossip follows behind. The good is that your eloquence helps you quickly build a professional image in a strange place, and chasing clients and expanding in other places is your strength; the bad is that in a strange land among strangers, your words are especially easily misunderstood.

You eat from the rice bowl of reputation. When many people know of you, opportunity arrives, and income rises with it. What suits you are the professions that stand in front of the stage: politics, public administration, media, public relations, teaching through speech, brand marketing; soldiers, police, judges and diplomats are also right roads, and both civil and military paths are open, only you fear being buried in the back where no one sees you. You are born knowing how to lead a team and how to express yourself, and when you speak of a direction, people are willing to follow; the weak points are details and backstage execution. Those who help you are usually weighty elders, and mostly act only at key moments.

You earn your meals through talent and individuality. You shine most easily where creativity, expression and personal style are needed: artistic creation, media, law, military and police administration, fashion and beauty, restaurants, and these trades all suit your road; wherever there is a stage, you perform best. You are someone who can bring a project back to life, with many ideas, and can push them through too, but when emotions rise you easily spoil things. You also easily become the focus of everyone's attention, which brings envy and gossip with it.

Between you and your siblings it is not what you would call close. You also do not like saying polite, intimate words, and from childhood each of you worked through your own world. After marriage, with relations such as sisters-in-law, you are born with a little distance, and that act of polite intimacy and deep sisterly feeling is something you cannot perform; better to be a bit cool than to pretend. The good is that you are not easily pulled into complicated clan relationships; the difficulty is that you easily contend over whose word decides with the female elders in the household.

There is a subtle tension between you and your siblings. If you have an older brother, he mostly does not do badly in his career, his bearing is no less than yours, and in a real difficulty he is truly reliable; living with such a brother, you often have to find a balance between respect and competition.

Between you and your siblings it is the kind where hearts are close but the people are far. Conversation fits well, but each lives in a different place, and you rarely meet, with much distance between you. If there is a strong-willed sibling at home, you mostly choose to yield a step and do not want to confront them directly. This is your strength and also a hidden danger: if you keep yielding, on big matters such as dividing the house or supporting your parents, your voice will not be heard. After marriage, living with sisters-in-law and your husband's sisters in his family, your sensitivity is a double-edged sword: you take in all of other people's feelings, and in the end it is you who are tired.

Your bond with your siblings is rather shallow. From childhood you saw little of each other, with much distance between you, and growing up each of you went your own way. However, not everyone is like that; some people have quite a few siblings and get along well with them, so you cannot say in general that there is no bond. After marriage, living with sisters-in-law in your husband's family, you are born carrying a distance, and you cannot stand that set of polite greetings, so you seem unenthusiastic. Your greatest hazard in partnerships is that the moment you walk in you demand to “redesign everything”, and your partners cannot keep up with your pace.

Your bond with your siblings is rather shallow. From childhood you saw little of each other, with much distance between you, and growing up each of you went your own way, not in touch on ordinary days and remembering each other only when something happens. This is not anyone being cold; it is simply the nature of people like you. However, not everyone is like that; some people have quite a few siblings and get along well with them, so you cannot say in general that there is no bond. In partnerships you suit best finding a partner who also likes breaking new ground, doing the kind of work together where even if it is broken it can be rebuilt, and you do not suit people who only want to mind the counter.

The bond between you and your child is especially deep. You can see through what your child is thinking in their heart, and the child also feels your warmth. Such a child usually matures early, understanding things to the point that it makes people sad, like a little adult at home. By the old reckoning, you have about two children. Heavenly Beam counts as a Yang star, and when the Children palace sees Heavenly Beam, there is a son. The greatest worry is the child carrying your emotions for you: when you are not steady inside, the child will instinctively grow up before their time to look after you.

Your bond with your parents is rather shallow. You often spent little time together; growing up, it was often that your parents were not beside you, or they were beside you but not close in heart. They are in your heart, it is just hard to be naturally close as others are. After marriage, living with your parents-in-law, what you can least stand is “pretending to be a good daughter-in-law”; that spirit of yours cannot be suppressed, and if you keep forcing the act, you collapse first.

Your bond with your parents is fairly shallow. You often spent little time together; while you were growing up your parents were frequently away, or present in person but not close in heart. They are in your heart, but it is hard for you to be naturally close to them the way others are. You cannot express it, and it is hard to be naturally affectionate the way other people are. Your father's influence on you is mostly of two kinds: either very strict control, or a long absence. Making peace with your father is a hurdle you must pass after middle age.

You like to be your own master and dislike being managed by others. Emotionally you have more ups and downs than most people, and relationships easily come together and drift apart without settling. Your standards for a partner also shift with your state of mind. There is a force in you that wants to remake your partner and hopes your husband will change along with you, which is often where conflict begins. Your feelings tend to advance one step and retreat another, so marrying too young is not necessarily stable, while settling a little later turns out to last.

Wherever you are, you are the focus. Your speaking skill is good, you can find a few words for anyone, and your network is already wide, which gives you a head start in business that others cannot match. But people only see your warm side; inside, you are actually quite firm: once you have made up your mind, nine oxen could not pull you back, and when you really act you show no mercy, and you can also flare up for a moment with no regard for the consequences. Your biggest opponent is yourself, wanting too much; in youth, drink and the card table are both easy snares. Your mind is quite sufficient, but your energy is scattered over too many places, so the height you could reach is not reached.

Away from home you will not be isolated with no one to help. You have a good temperament and are easy to get along with, and wherever you go you easily meet people willing to lend you a hand; you can even start from zero in another place. But you are not born to carry your luggage alone and charge into the world: in a completely unfamiliar environment for a long time, with nothing to lean on inside, you suffer emotionally far more than in familiar surroundings. With Taboo (obstruction), away from home you easily take detours; keep the schedule relaxed, and it is better if family goes with you.

Working away from home gives you more opportunities than staying at home, but it is also truly tiring. Your money often comes from the banquet table, socializing and the exchange of favours. Business trips and transfers are mostly good for you; a small move is often a step up. The other side must also be stated plainly: in other places, with banquets, nightlife and entertainment, there are especially many people who can stir your heart, and away from home you relax easily; together these are the things most likely to cause trouble.

In love you are not someone who is easily moved. Your standards are high, you look at people carefully, and you do not easily get too close to anyone; others mostly treat you with respect. Once you have made up your mind you are very steadfast and can hold on. The husband who suits you must have presence and depth, understand your talent and also tolerate your independence; the type who is attracted only by appearance will not go far with you. Marrying a little late gives better quality in return. This is the foundation brought by your birth year; which decade or which year brings a shock still depends on the luck cycles.

In love you are very direct. If you like someone you pursue them, if you do not you leave, with no beating around the bush, which sometimes makes the other person feel pressure. You value your private space highly, dislike clinging too tightly, and do not want to be anyone's burden. Your wife is mostly also a person with opinions, with her own career and ambition, who may work in jobs that need drive such as the military or police, starting a business, foreign trade or sports, and she does not put herself down because of marriage. The two of you admire each other and also easily compete over who wins; when neither is willing to bow first, the home easily turns quiet and cold.

In love you are loyal and steady. You take promises very seriously, and once you have settled on a person you do not easily let go. You are not good at actively pursuing someone; your connection mostly comes through relatives and friends making the match, or from a familiar setting, and it is rarely a meeting on the street that begins things. Your wife is mostly good-looking, gentle, sensible and understanding, orderly in her work and mature enough, and may work in administration, law, finance or a large organization; she is not showy but has opinions inside, and will thoroughly arrange the household and the matters behind your back. Both of you are steady, live an orderly life, and rarely have a major clash.

In love you are loyal and steady. You take promises very seriously, and once you have settled on a person you do not easily let go. You are not good at actively pursuing someone; your connection mostly comes through relatives and friends introducing you, or from a familiar circle. Your husband is mostly a little older than you, honest and reliable, orderly in his work, and may work in administration, law, finance or a large organization; he is not showy but has opinions inside, and the longer you are with him the more you see his good qualities, and he is also your real backing. Both of you lean toward steadiness, the days pass in order, and you seldom have big quarrels.

In love you have charm and easily attract attention. Whether your love life has many setbacks cannot be decided just by seeing Integrity; you must look at whether Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star are added in the Spouse palace. Marrying a little later, and deciding only after seeing clearly, is more beneficial for you. When you commit you are very passionate, and when you want to leave you are decisive, not lingering in a hopeless relationship, but impulsive decisions afterwards often bring regret. Your wife is mostly distinctive: skilled in crafts, striking in appearance, and may work in the arts, media, law, the military or police, or work related to aesthetics, and she stands out in a crowd. She can indirectly help you with connections and image; both of you have strong opinions, and when you quarrel the temper runs high too.

In love you are frank and practical. You are not good at romantic words, but you show love through actions: helping your partner solve troubles and holding up the foundation of life. Once you have settled on a person you do not easily let go, but you are so reasonable that your partner may not feel the warmth. Your partner is firm in temperament, has opinions, knows how to take on responsibility, and is not someone who lives by leaning on others; they may work in finance, industry, the military or police, surgery or management. Both of you are people of action, the division of duties at home is usually very clear, and your partner usually also genuinely helps you with money and connections.

In love you are free and unrestrained. You dislike being tied down, you change easily when young, and a relationship fixed too early is often not stable. Your feelings easily come together and drift apart without settling, advancing one step and retreating another; settling down late turns out to be steadier, and several rounds of union and parting cannot be judged from this one star alone. Only when your own rhythm settles do you truly understand what kind of person you need. The wife in your chart has personality and a quite proper mind of her own, does not lean on others, and may work in technology, travel, foreign trade, the arts or run her own business; she may also be a little older than you with a steadier temperament, and she is often the one who pushes you through a change of direction.

In love you are serious. You do not begin a relationship easily, but once you nod you defend it with all your strength; you are the kind of partner who puts people at ease, with money secured and everything reliable. Your wife is mostly also steady, with savings and plans, not frivolous or showy, and may work in a state agency, a bank or a large organization; she says little but has her own mind, and the longer you are with her the more reassured you feel. In your career she is your backing, laying a base for you with her own resources and connections; she does not charge ahead on your behalf, but she helps you hold the main base.

In love you are serious. You do not begin easily, but once you nod you put all your strength into keeping this relationship, and you are the kind of partner who brings a sense of security. Your husband is mostly also steady, with savings and plans, and may work in a state agency, a bank or a large organization; he says little but has his own mind, and the longer you are with him the more reassured you feel. In your career he is your backing, laying a base for you with his own resources and connections; he does not charge ahead on your behalf but helps you hold the main base. There is one more layer: how far your marriage goes depends not only on who the other person is, but even more on whether your own heart is at peace.

In love you know how to express yourself. You can state your feelings and needs clearly, which is an advantage; but when words are too blunt and too many, communication turns into quarrelling, and verbal disputes and gossip are the biggest test of your love life. In truth you are very sincere, but your mouth is faster than your heart, and after hurting someone you regret it yourself. Your wife is a good talker with opinions, and does not give way just because you speak bluntly; she may work as a lawyer, in education, media or sales, and the two of you trading words is an everyday matter. There is often a layer of distance between you where what is said does not fit together, and living together easily brings friction; the old books say Great Gate in the Spouse palace should be paired with an older wife, and someone a little older than you suits better in return. This is for reference, not a hard condition.

In love you know how to express yourself. You can state your feelings and needs clearly, which is an advantage; but when words are too blunt and too many they easily turn into quarrelling. In truth you are very sincere, but your mouth is faster than your heart, and after hurting someone you regret it yourself. Your husband is a good talker with opinions, and does not give way just because you speak bluntly; he may work as a lawyer, in education, media or sales, and the two of you trading words is an everyday matter. There is often a layer of distance between you where what is said does not fit together, and living together easily brings friction; the old books say Great Gate in the Spouse palace should be paired with an older partner, and a partner a little older than you suits better. This is for reference, not a hard condition. Whether your own heart feels at ease has the greatest effect on whether this relationship is stable.

You read your partner's emotions very sensitively. You are attentive and meticulous, but your analytical mind often makes you think too much and worry too much, which in turn blocks natural closeness. You are loyal in love, but your curiosity is strong and you are easily drawn by new possibilities, so you must deliberately bring your mind back to the person in front of you. Your wife is mostly clever and quick-minded, and may work in jobs that use the mind such as consulting, planning, education or technology; she talks with you without running out of things to say, and often offers opinions to you on important matters. Both of you like to think, and it easily becomes a case where everyone analyzes and no one acts.

You read your partner's emotions very sensitively. You are attentive and meticulous, but your analytical mind often makes you think too much and worry too much, which in turn blocks natural closeness. You are loyal in love, but your curiosity is strong and you are easily drawn by new possibilities, so you must deliberately bring your mind back to the person in front of you. Your husband is mostly clever and quick-minded, and may work in jobs that use the mind such as consulting, planning, education or technology; he talks with you without running out of things to say, and often offers opinions and brings you opportunities on important matters. Both of you like to think, and it easily becomes a case where everyone analyzes and no one acts.

In love you want to take the lead and hope your partner will revolve around you. Your husband is mostly no ordinary person: he has status and a position, his word carries weight within his own circle, he holds up face wherever he stands, and you gain standing through him. He can truly help your career, opening up connections for you, and can also be the steadiest pillar in your heart. Your love life starts rather late, and marrying a little later makes it more likely to last. You are both strong, so quarrels are unavoidable, but precisely because neither is weaker than the other, you respect each other in return.

In love you are gentle and considerate. You favour harmony in everything, and to avoid arguments you are willing to step back first; people around you feel relaxed and free of pressure. You do not place too much weight on your partner's circumstances; you care more about whether the two of you share a rhythm in living together. Your husband is mostly mild in temperament and knows how to enjoy life; he may work in services, the arts, design, restaurants, or work connected with aesthetics, and making a home comfortable is his strength. He does not necessarily charge ahead for you outside, but when you are tired he gives you the strength to recover. Neither of you likes quarrelling; the problem is instead that it is too peaceful, and after a long time interest easily fades.

In love you are gentle and considerate. You are willing to step back first to avoid arguments, and people around you feel at ease and free of pressure. You do not place too much weight on your partner's wealth; you care more about whether the two of you suit each other and whether your days together are warm. Your wife is mostly mild in temperament and knows how to tend a life; she may work in services, design, restaurants, or work connected with the aesthetics of daily life, arranging a home so that people do not want to leave. She does not necessarily help you build a career outside, but when you are tired and come home you recover. Neither of you likes quarrelling; the problem is instead that life is too easy, and after a long time the warmth easily cools.

In love you are warm and generous. You are willing to give actively and will offer your best circumstances and connections to your partner. The problem is mostly not too little love but too little time together: the Sun in the Spouse palace speaks first of your partner, who is set on a career and has many outside matters, so the two of you easily fail to look after each other's feelings. You do not change your heart easily, but with so many outside matters it can easily leave her feeling set aside. Outside you put on a show and keep up appearances, but at home you need to take off this armour and, together with her, become your true self again. When the Sun is Temple or Prosperous (strong), your wife can mostly add points to your career and also bring connections.

In love you value feeling and like a way of living together that has vitality and fun. You enjoy the heartbeat and novelty of romance, but once a relationship settles, the enthusiasm easily fades, and you must nurture it deliberately to go far. There is no need to rush into early marriage; settling down after you understand what you want will be more relaxed. Your wife is mostly also someone who can talk and knows how to play, has talents, and brings the whole gathering to life at the dinner table; her circle of connections also often brings you unexpected opportunities.

You are outgoing, warm and fair. Your popularity has always been good, and among your friends you are the one everyone trusts most. For a woman with the Sun in the Life palace, the Complete Book judges separately by the Sun's brightness and whether malefic stars are present. The situation of your father and husband is read separately from the Sun and the Decade at the Parents palace and the Spouse palace, and is not judged directly from the Sun in the Life palace.

You are perhaps the kind of person who makes the fewest enemies. You have a good temperament, do not compete or grab, and can talk with anyone. This popularity is real capital: many things you cannot finish yourself get finished when someone pulls you in to do them together. It is not that you have no ideas; you just are not willing to bring them out to compete with others. The trouble is here too: you lack the determination that you must accomplish something. In youth, "I can live without pushing too hard" is very comfortable, but when the people around you go forward one by one, your heart will start to beat anxiously. Elders love you, friends help you, and family worries for you; this goodness can also tie you down.

You are not born a small bird who tucks herself away. But from childhood on, those around you have quietly told you "a girl should hold back a bit". Your presence is not an act, your gaze carries weight, and in any place you are recognized at once. This force is capital at the workplace, but in a two-person relationship it becomes pressure. It is not that you do not want to be gentle; it is just hard to turn gentleness into submission. You cannot put yourself beneath others. This is not a bad temperament; it is that you are used to standing in the position of the master. So in love you keep hitting the same wall: the men who attract you are mostly strong too, and after a while you compete with each other; when you look for someone mild, you find him unable to hold you up.

You are born able to analyze and able to express. Your mind is meticulous and your eye accurate; you can explain a complex matter clearly in a few sentences, and when you open your mouth you hit the point. You stand out most on occasions that call for persuading people, debating and making judgments. Your weakness is suspicion: you weigh other people's motives over and over, and once your guard rises, even people who could have been confided in are kept outside. You also tend to think too much, study many things without mastering them, and you are not really sociable with others. If you speak too bluntly, listeners feel pressure, and one barbed sentence can cause trouble that was not there before.

You are born outgoing, warm and generous. Whatever group you step into, you can lift the atmosphere. Your greatest ability is influence: what you say and do carries its own power to spread, others easily trust you and are willing to follow you, and you stand out even more in public settings. Your weakness is caring too much how others see you; reputation weighs on you almost as heavily as life, and any matter that damages your image makes you anxious, and the effort of holding this image up alone consumes a good deal of energy. You have many friends and are not picky about status, but your connections are wide without being deep, and few people truly enter your heart; outwardly you look brilliant, yet alone you easily doubt yourself.

You are born a changeable person. Rebellious, creative, you instinctively hate old routines. Where others see a dead end, you find a gap; while others still hold to the status quo, you are already thinking of the next step. Your weakness is not staying steady: just as something begins to flourish, you want to go open a new stall. Your temperament is somewhat solitary, you do not put much weight on money, and your build is slim. Your bond with family and elders is fairly shallow, your circle of friends changes quickly, and those who truly stay are the people drawn by your talent. When the pressure is great, your instinct is to withdraw and leave.

You are born a smasher of the old, not out of ill will, but because you are restless with the status quo. A steady job, after three years you want to change; a process you have used for a while, one look and you want to fix it; an old custom laid out before you, your first reaction is "why must it be this way". This makes you hard to match at pioneering, and almost unable to manage keeping a stall running. Your temperament is somewhat solitary, you do not often swallow grievances for the sake of getting along, and you do not put profit first. Your mind jumps fast; when others think three steps, you think ten, and the steps in between often break.

You are born the spiritual pillar of those around you. When a friend is heartbroken she comes to you to cry, when a colleague works overtime you bring her a late meal, and when a relative has trouble you are the first to arrive. You live steadily, with a clean heart; you look mild and easy to talk to, but on matters of principle you do not give way at all, and your strength to shoulder things is second to none. Everyone treats you as someone who can give advice, and when in difficulty they think of you first. The price is that you often put yourself last: everyone assumes you can bear it, you are used to not voicing discomfort, and over time even you forget that you are allowed to say you are tired.

You are born with a leading presence. Outwardly steady and generous, in any place you are easily seen first, and the first impression is of someone kind and upright. Your greatest strength is seeing the big picture, and you can also win people over by presence. Your shortcoming is a rigid temperament and clinging to your own reasoning; once you have set your mind it is very hard to heed others, and sometimes you miss better choices because of it. You care a lot about face, and being contradicted in front of a crowd is especially hard for you; inside you are far more sensitive than you appear. In dealing with others you are used to sitting in the upper position, so people respect you more than they are close to you, and when pressure comes you also like to carry it alone.

You are born with a strong presence, and wherever you stand you easily become the one who is watched. You judge people accurately and also see the big picture; you conduct yourself and your affairs properly and are hard to deceive. Your shortcomings are subjectivity, clinging to your own reasoning, and a particularly strong self-respect. You choose friends very carefully, preferring few to settling, and in dealing with others you are used to sitting in the upper position, so people respect you more than they are close to you. Your career is usually smoother than your love life; used at work, this force mostly takes you to a position leading a team, but used in intimate relationships it easily becomes pressure, because it is very hard for you to accept your husband talking back to you.

You are born fond of charging ahead and fond of change. From the heart you hate fixed old routines and are always looking for a breakthrough. Your independence is extremely strong, and with family there is a distance that comes and goes; your thoughts are not easily seen through by others, which is both protection and separation. Your temperament is somewhat solitary, your build slight, and you do not put much weight on money. Your talent needs time to settle: the early road has many changes and is not very steady, but once you find a direction that truly belongs to you, you can make something very bright.

You are naturally content, and joy comes to you easily. A good meal, a full night's sleep, a day out with friends, and your spirits are back; you do not need big ups and downs to prove you are living well. This is a very steady kind of happiness. With Taboo (obstruction), you easily fall into a kind of anxiety, always worrying that the present peace is about to be lost, and seeing it all gone at the slightest hitch. The real hurdle comes in middle age: for days held up by enjoyment alone, a question arises after a long time: what have I actually accomplished?

You are naturally content, and joy comes to you easily. A good meal, a full night's sleep, a day out with friends, and your spirits are back; you do not need big ups and downs to prove you are living well. This is a very steady kind of happiness. The real hurdle comes in middle age: for days held up by enjoyment alone, a question arises after a long time: what have I actually accomplished?

You are born refined and gentle. Your bearing is mild, and you have an air of decency that is hard to put into words; you look good whether or not you are dressed up. Your feelings are delicate, you have an innate eye for beauty, you have some requirements for your dwelling and belongings, and you are willing to put thought into the quality of life. Your money has an affinity with property; you can hold on to it and take the steady road. The difficulty lies in emotions: like the moon that is sometimes full and sometimes waning, when it is good everything goes well, when it is low everything feels dull, and one remark from someone else can stay in your heart for a long time.

You are born with abundant vitality; you can stay up late and play hard. The trouble is here too: you burn out faster than others, and you do not even treat it as an issue. Which part of the body needs attention depends on which palace in the whole chart has the most malefic stars gathered; use the earthly branch of that palace to match the organ (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig triple burner), and do not match by the element of the Greedy Wolf star in the Health palace. Late nights, drinking, and bottled-up emotions with no outlet drain the whole person. Quite a few people also find heavy menstrual flow, with a particularly hot temper on those days, which is connected with suppressing emotions.

You are born with ample vitality; you can stay up late, play hard and keep working nonstop. The problem is here too: you run out of strength faster than others, and you do not easily notice it yourself. Which part of the body needs attention depends on which palace in the whole chart has the most malefic stars gathered; use the earthly branch of that palace to match the organ (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig triple burner), and do not match by the element of the Greedy Wolf star in the Health palace. Prolonged late nights, drinking and playing too hard drain the whole person. When what you want is not obtained, that restlessness turns directly into insomnia and loss of appetite.

You are born suited to carry things forward steadily. You are honest and kind, you work by the rules, and you do what you say. The more a task calls for meticulousness, following procedure and long-term perseverance, the better you do it. You are not a good-natured person without a temper; when you see someone acting improperly, the anger in your heart cannot be held down. Your weakness is being too kind: in places where interests are contested you easily lose out, you do not know how to speak up for yourself, and often your ability is very strong but, because you dislike showing it, you are overlooked; being undervalued for a long time builds a deep grievance inside.

Your family is livelier than an ordinary family, and also more complicated. Your parents are mostly capable people with wide paths, who may work in sales, the arts, entertainment, or trades that deal with people, and their own love lives are often not simple either. Your bond with your parents is rather faint; leaving home early, studying and working in another place, or being raised by other elders would not be strange.

Your family is livelier than an ordinary family, and also a little more complicated. Your parents are mostly capable people with wide paths, who may work in sales, the arts, entertainment, or trades that deal with people, and their own love lives are often not simple either. Your bond with your parents is rather faint; leaving home early, studying and working in another place, or being raised by other elders would not be strange.

You have an innate fussiness about your home. From how the living room is arranged to how the tables and chairs are placed, you demand a presentable look. Compared with striving out there, you want to make your home comfortable and something you can show off, a home where you can truly rest. As for the family estate, with the Minister Temple or Prosperous there is a share for you. For decoration you like a classic style that lasts, wooden furniture, warm tones, and everything tidy and in order.

You have high requirements for your home. Location, taste, whether it is comfortable to live in, whether you can invite people over to sit and chat, everything must be well thought out, and this is also where you spend money most freely. In property matters, the place you buy yourself is the most prosperous. Living with your in-laws is mostly not a good fit; your style and way of spending money are easily seen by the older generation as not knowing how to manage a household.

You are especially sensitive to emotions, to beauty and to atmosphere. You catch subtle feelings that others miss, and you can live days with flavour. In earning money you take the road of slowly accumulating: stable income, a fixed salary, property, things you can see suit you better than one big windfall. The trouble is that you are too easily influenced by others; a casual remark from someone can make you turn it over for a whole session, wasting your energy. You treat people gently and know how to care for them, often worrying about others and forgetting yourself. Your mother and your wife are the two people with the greatest weight in your life.

Your standards in love are high, especially on the spiritual side. The person must be someone you can talk with and lean on; having only good circumstances is not enough, and it is not easy to enter your heart. In relationships you are used to being the caretaker and advice-giver, like both an elder sister and a teacher, and the result is that the two of you are not equal, and your partner will gradually feel stifled. The husband who suits you is someone with deeper experience than you, who has seen something of the world; he can support you spiritually, and only then are you willing to take off your armour.

You have a constitution with a sensitive nervous system. When your mind has been spinning for too long, the body is the first place that cannot bear it. The most likely problem is sleep: when your heart holds a pile of matters you cannot put down, you usually cannot sleep well first, and you tire easily and get headaches easily. Worrying and going over things endlessly is what you most need to watch; when your mood is tense, your body tenses along with it. Which part of the body needs more attention depends on which palace in the whole chart has the most malefic stars gathered, then use the earthly branch of that palace to match the organ (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig triple burner); do not look it up by the element of the Strategist star in the Health palace.

You have a constitution with a sensitive nervous system. When your mind has been spinning for too long, the body is the first place that cannot bear it. The most likely problem is sleep: when your heart holds matters you cannot put down, you first of all cannot sleep well, and you tire easily and get headaches easily. Which part of the body needs more attention depends on which palace in the whole chart has the most malefic stars gathered, then use the earthly branch of that palace to match the organ (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig triple burner); do not look it up by the element of the Strategist star in the Health palace. Mind and body are linked: in a period of great pressure, with anger held in, the menstrual cycle easily becomes irregular, and the temper before the period is even hotter. During pregnancy and the few years before menopause, emotions will rise and fall more noticeably; knowing this in advance and preparing yourself mentally means you will not be bewildered.

Your greatest help at work is popularity. Colleagues are willing to cooperate, opportunities often come through acquaintances, and overall things go fairly smoothly; even without pushing too hard you keep up quite well. Fields that work with people and need patience, such as services, medical care and health, education, art and design, and food and hospitality, suit you best. In a team you are the one who smooths relationships, but pushing the schedule and closing decisions are not your strengths. You do not care much about higher or lower rank or who comes first; work and family stretch a great deal, and the risk lies there too: once life is comfortable you easily mark time, and credit often gets taken by others because you do not know how to speak up.

Your foundation is not bad. Which part of the body needs more attention depends on which palace in the whole chart has the most malefic stars gathered, then use the earthly branch of that palace to match the organ (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig triple burner); do not look it up by the element of the Harmony star in the Health palace; weight and blood sugar need monitoring. What really pulls you back is a life that is too comfortable: if you can sit you do not stand, if you can lie down you do not sit. You are also not good at voicing discomfort and are used to eating something nice to distract yourself, so emotions get suppressed and do not clear, and the body is affected too.

Your foundation is not bad, with few serious illnesses. Which part of the body needs more attention depends on which palace in the whole chart has the most malefic stars gathered, then use the earthly branch of that palace to match the organ (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig triple burner); do not look it up by the element of the Harmony star in the Health palace. What really pulls you back is a lifestyle that is too comfortable: if you can sit you do not stand, if you can lie down you do not sit, you get too little exercise all year round, and weight and blood sugar need monitoring. You are also not good at voicing discomfort and are used to distracting yourself with good food and outings, so emotions get suppressed and do not clear, and the body is affected too.

Your foundation is fairly sturdy, with more physical strength than most people. But your body is also a little stiff, with not enough flexibility, and minor ailments easily accumulate bit by bit. Which part of the body needs more attention depends on which palace in the whole chart has the most malefic stars gathered, then use the earthly branch of that palace to match the organ (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig triple burner); do not look it up by the element of the Martial star in the Health palace; the risk of accidental injury or needing surgery should also be kept in mind. You are very good at suppressing emotions, but if they are left unspoken for a long time, the irritation mostly settles in the body as aches and soreness hard to name. Your temperament is firm, and when you get busy you easily put your body last.

Your foundation is fairly sturdy, with more physical strength than most people. But your body is also a little stiff, with not enough flexibility, and minor ailments easily accumulate bit by bit. Which part of the body needs more attention depends on which palace in the whole chart has the most malefic stars gathered, then use the earthly branch of that palace to match the organ (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig triple burner); do not look it up by the element of the Martial star in the Health palace; risks such as accidental injury or needing surgery should also be kept in mind. You are very good at suppressing emotions, but if they are left unspoken for a long time, the irritation in the end mostly settles in the body as aches and soreness hard to name.

Your foundation is good, and your physical capacity is among the strong in a crowd. But the harder something is, the more easily it breaks: ordinarily you can endure, but once you are exhausted you may collapse suddenly. Which part of the body needs more attention depends on which palace in the whole chart has the most malefic stars gathered, then use the earthly branch of that palace to match the organ (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig triple burner); do not look it up by the element of the Seven Killings star in the Health palace; accidents such as knocks and falls also deserve attention. When preparing to have a child under great pressure and with little rest, you will have a harder time than others; during pregnancy you are unwilling to show weakness and so easily become overtired. Around menopause is a big examination, and the debts of a lifetime of pushing through easily come to collect all at once.

Your foundation is good, and your physical capacity is among the strong in a crowd. But the harder something is, the more easily it breaks: ordinarily you can endure, but once you are exhausted you may collapse suddenly, going to one of two extremes. Which part of the body needs more attention depends on which palace in the whole chart has the most malefic stars gathered, then use the earthly branch of that palace to match the organ (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig triple burner); do not look it up by the element of the Seven Killings star in the Health palace; accidents such as knocks and falls also deserve attention. Prolonged high-intensity work with insufficient rest will lower your resistance accordingly.

You are skilful and considerate, and you know how to look after a family. You are the kind of woman people call "good at managing a household". You do not like to push to the front, but whatever reaches your hands gets handled properly; you are not good at creating topics of conversation, yet you can run a home in perfect order. You value appearances, and from dress to hosting guests you keep a sense of measure, not wanting your family to lose face before outsiders. It needs to be said clearly: your gentleness is cultivation, not a lack of spirit, so do not confuse the two. It is not that you have no views of your own; you are just used to ranking them behind other people's.

You must learn to close the valve a little; you do not have to carry every pain. When listening to someone confide, set a time limit, change the subject after half an hour, or say outright that today you are not well and will talk another day; a true friend will not turn against you for that. In other people's tangled love affairs, do not take any side. You are soft and gentle by nature, and the opposite sex may easily misunderstand; if you already have a family, deal with male friends openly, invite a few others along, and limit meeting one-on-one.

Your mind is close-knit and your speech is clear. You speak well and have strong analytical ability; however tangled the people or matters, you quickly find the thread. You are born seeing deeply and can perceive the reason beneath the surface, but you also easily keep circling in your heart and walk into a dead end. You think a lot, study many things without mastering them, and are not exactly sociable with others. In love, where you most easily lose out is in speaking too bluntly and having too many opinions: you feel you are analyzing, but your partner hears it as criticism.

You are soft-hearted and shy about asking for debts to be repaid, which needs special guarding against. Before lending, write down the amount and the repayment deadline; saying it beforehand is much easier than raising it afterwards. If you truly cannot open your mouth, lend only an amount you would be willing to give away; lending as if giving leaves your heart at peace. Feelings can be close, but the accounts must be clear; the two do not conflict.

Inside, you are like an old tree that stands firm by itself and can also give shade to others. On ordinary days you seem to have no great ups and downs, but when real trouble comes you are the one who stays steady; this stability is your greatest blessing. Your biggest weakness is excessive worry: the affairs of every person in the family and every friend beside you are kept in your heart, and over time they become prolonged tension.

Inside, you are like an old tree that stands firm by itself and can also give shade to others. On ordinary days you seem to have no great ups and downs, but when real trouble comes you stay steady; this stability is your greatest blessing. Your weakness is that you care for a whole circle of people while leaving yourself out.

Inside, you are actually quite lively. Your curiosity is always on; you have an innate interest in things that cannot be thought through, such as philosophy, religion and destiny studies, and the deeper you read the more hooked you become. Your life is mostly hard first and easy later: in youth your spirit is spent there, and only from middle age onward do you gradually have free time. You enjoy the pleasure of reflection, and are also trapped by it: the mind is like a machine that never switches off, a gift when it produces results, a burden when it cannot stop.

Inside, you are actually at peace. You are not easily swept away by great joy or sorrow, life flows along, and you are the type who knows how to enjoy good fortune. The trouble is that in everything you first ask yourself: is this appropriate? Will people laugh at me? This hesitation follows you for life: you do not dare say you are tired, do not dare say you want to refuse, do not dare express discomfort, and you struggle to keep up a neat appearance, struggling until even you feel stifled.

The foundation of your inner world is peace. You are not easily swept away by great joy or sorrow, and you are the type who knows how to enjoy good fortune. The trouble is that in everything you first ask yourself: is this appropriate? How will people see me? This hesitation has followed you for many years: you do not dare say you are tired, do not dare say you want to refuse, do not dare tell of discomfort, and you always keep a tidy appearance, keeping it up until even you feel stifled. Your gentle obedience truly deserves to be cherished, but as for what you want, it seems you are the only one who does not take it seriously.

Inside, it is very hard for you to be truly idle. Repetitive, stable days where one glance shows the whole road are only suffering to you, and as soon as something new appears you cannot sit still. Liveliness is your everyday state, and quiet leaves you uneasy. Being a bit tired and busy when young does not matter; people like you are mostly busy first and then enjoy later, and the further on you go the more comfortably you can live.

Inside, it is very hard for you to be truly idle. Repetitive, stable days where one glance shows the whole road are only torment to you, and as soon as something new appears you cannot sit still. Liveliness is your everyday state, and quiet leaves you restless. Being a bit busy and tired when young is nothing to worry about; people like you are mostly busy first and then enjoy later, and the further on you go the better you know how to live comfortable days.

Inside, you have a world that others cannot see. All kinds of possibilities are calculated over and over in your head, you have a real interest in philosophy, destiny studies, spiritual practice and art, and once you dive in you stay a long time. Your life is mostly hard first and easy later: in youth your inner strength is all spent on thinking, and only from middle age onward do you gradually loosen up. The hardest lesson of your life is pressing the pause button: thinking until you cannot stop, still awake at three in the morning, and unable to do anything the next day.

Inside, you are more sensitive than you look, and also lonelier than you look. By day you hold every arena steady: meetings, clients, your child's matters, none is missed. When night grows quiet, you easily think over and over "am I too strong?", "does he dislike me like this?". When people acknowledge you, you feel life has flavour; when you are denied, even if the words are very polite, it is enough to keep you sleepless for days. Fortunately you are by nature someone who knows how to enjoy good fortune; what really traps you are the overly high demands you place on yourself.

What is in your heart is much more complicated than outsiders see. By day, in front of others you are crisp, saying one means one; when night grows quiet, the thought "what have I really gained?" easily comes up. Your joy depends heavily on others' recognition: when affirmed, your whole self lights up; alone, you easily doubt yourself.

Your character is strong and independent. You demand a lot in love; you cannot stand a mediocre relationship, nor one that is not between equals, and would rather be alone than accept it. For this reason the stage of finding harmony will be longer. If you marry too early, the harmony will have many setbacks; if you wait until you are settled yourself before discussing marriage, you will likely meet someone who truly suits you. The husband you need is someone who earns your admiration in some field and also gives you enough space; once you admire, you are willing to yield.

You see love as something to be cultivated properly. You pay attention to atmosphere, mood and the details of being together. You fear most being abandoned or treated crudely; wounds of the heart heal harder than wounds of the body, so you need someone emotionally refined enough. Your partner is gentle and considerate, understands mood, may work in design, the arts, real estate or finance, and will turn the home into a place both beautiful and warm. The way he helps you is not by directly stepping into your work, but by keeping the nest steady so you can rest assured and throw yourself into striving; on buying a home and managing finances he can also offer practical advice.

When choosing a partner, you do not look at appearance and circumstances. You value character and attitude toward life, and would rather wait long than settle, so mostly you will not start a family too early. In love you are used to being the caretaker and decision-maker, and over time the relationship easily becomes unbalanced, with your partner feeling treated like a student. The wife who suits you should be a few years older than you, mature and experienced, able to stay calm in big matters, and may work in law, medicine, education or consulting; she does not necessarily step forward for you, but her being by your side is already your support. The two of you live together like old friends, with no need to cling to each other every day.

You are a person with great pull who is not easy to see through. You know many things, you have presence standing in a crowd, and the craving in your heart has never stopped. You are unyielding to the bone, dare to overturn the old and start again, stand out most easily in positions that call for ability, and quickly make people remember you even in unfamiliar places. The trouble is a hard temperament, a tendency to contest, and big emotional swings; when pressure arrives or love has trouble, your reactions easily go to extremes, either exploding or shutting your whole self away. With so many people drawn to you, romantic trouble and gossip behind your back follow in equal measure.

You are an iron lady in your career. You act decisively and cleanly, without beating around the bush, and efficiency and results are your yardstick. You have an innate sharpness for numbers and money, your ability to earn ranks fairly high among the fourteen main stars, and you perform best in fields such as industry and finance. This hardness is capital in your career, but in love it easily keeps people out: you do not pretend to be weak, nor are you willing to settle, and many men therefore dare not come near. You do not have many friends but they are all trustworthy, and at critical moments someone beside you often lends a hand.

You are a typical person who gets real work done. You act directly, dislike beating around the bush, and value efficiency and results. You have an innate sharpness for numbers, assets and practical gains; while others are still holding meetings, you have already started. Your weakness is that you are not good at expressing feelings, and with others you easily appear cold or hard, sometimes speaking too bluntly and hurting people without knowing it. Your temper flares quickly but passes quickly too; you do not hold anger overnight, and by the time others are startled you have long turned the page. You are not good at polite socializing, and you do not have many friends, but they are all trustworthy. The greater the pressure, the calmer you are, and at critical moments someone beside you often lends you a hand.

You are someone for whom things go better away from home than at home. Staying in one place easily makes you feel stifled, while going out you meet people willing to support you, and opportunities are many too. Outside there is especially a lot of socializing, banquets and sudden encounters, the connections are more complicated than at home, and gossip and trouble often come from these occasions.

You are someone for whom things go better away from home than at home. Staying in one place easily makes you feel stifled, while going out you meet people willing to support you. The people you meet outside are also mixed; on business trips, travel and visits to faraway places, you often meet people who stir your heart but hide danger. Long-distance love is where you must be especially careful; with distance between you it is easy to mistake an air of mystery for sincere feeling.

You are someone who prospers more away from home than at home. Changing the place you study or work makes you more likely to meet people willing to give you a hand; staying in one place brings more petty gossip. Locked for a long time in a small circle, you start to think idle thoughts and feel hemmed in. Studying far away, going abroad, or working in another city often decides how far your second half of life can reach.

You are someone who prospers more away from home than at home. Leaving familiar ground makes you more likely to meet people willing to give you a hand; staying in one place brings more petty gossip. Staying in one place a long time dulls you; a mind like yours needs fresh input regularly to keep its sharpness. Sales, consulting, postings to other places, cross-region projects, jobs that involve running back and forth suit you especially well.

You are a born protector. You are steady and solid, and in everything you first check whether it is safe; in the eyes of those around you, you are the ballast stone of the boat. The Treasury governs wealth, property and food and clothing for a whole life, like a storehouse that stockpiles money, so mostly you do not lack money, and the resources and connections you have are kept too. Others find you reliable, you do what you say, and they are willing to entrust important matters to you. You look mild and kindly, but inside you keep a ledger: mildness is the outer layer, and clear calculation is the core. Your weakness is being too conservative; opportunities that can only be seized by taking a little risk often wait until they expire.

You are a born homemaker. You are steady and solid, with a high demand for a sense of security, the kind of woman who keeps a family most stable. The Treasury governs wealth, property and food and clothing, and you are very good at managing money and resources. You live uprightly and your mind is also nimble, giving practical help to your husband and children. You are not someone who only goes along; you think faster than you appear to, but you just do not like to contend. In love you are faithful, you value the practical side of marriage, and even more whether your partner is reliable.

You are a born doer. Once you have made up your mind, you say it and do it; while others are still hesitating, you have already started. The more urgent, difficult or hard-fought the matter, the better you hold up, and you are the most dependable person at the critical moment. The price is a hot temper and big emotional swings, and you often weigh things over and over when something happens, so people around you often cannot guess what you are thinking. You do not compromise and are easily seen as hard to approach; sometimes you rush out before being fully prepared and waste extra effort. You do not have many friends but they are very close, you dislike socializing, and inside you often feel a loneliness of not being truly understood by anyone; this is innate, and not something you have done wrong.

You are someone who shines by going out, and cannot show your abilities by staying in your hometown. The family's old trade and old business often cannot help you; mostly you must move yourself, change places and take root again from scratch, and building a name elsewhere is much faster than in your local area. Going to lively places with big stages, such as the east and the south, will generally go more smoothly for you.

You are someone who shines by going out, and cannot show your abilities by staying in your hometown. The family's old trade and old business often cannot help you; mostly you must move yourself, change places and take root again from scratch, and building a name elsewhere is much faster than in your local area. Going to lively places with big stages, such as the east and the south, will generally go more smoothly for you. When Prosperity (money coming in) is present, going out brings both fame and profit.

You are someone for whom things go smoothly only by going out. The old resources in your hometown often cannot help, and changing city to take root again makes it easier to accomplish things. In another place, a foreign company or a cross-region platform, many things that weigh on you locally will ease, and there is much more room to show your abilities. After starting a family, being tied down in your movements by the family is common, but if you stay entirely at home you will wilt very quickly; you must keep up contact with the outside to keep your spirit.

You are someone for whom things go smoothly only by going out. The old resources in your hometown often cannot help, and changing city to take root again makes it easier to accomplish things. In another place, a foreign company or a cross-region platform, many things that weigh on you locally will ease, and there is much more room to show your abilities. After starting a family, being tied down in your movements by the family is common, but if you stay entirely at home you will wilt very quickly; you must keep up contact with the outside to keep your spirit. When Prosperity (money coming in) is present, in another place you gain both fame and profit.

You feel steady only when you are busy, and when you are idle your heart feels empty. Your inner world fluctuates more than it appears: you can love very deeply, and you can also, over a small matter, think it over and over without letting yourself off, easily shutting yourself in, telling no one, sinking deeper the more you think.

You feel steady only when you are busy, and when you are idle your heart feels empty to the point of restlessness. Your inner world has more scripts than anyone's: you can love very deeply, and you can also hold a grudge for a very long time; you can make very beautiful things, and you can also fall into very dark moods. Your most typical flaw is shutting yourself in: a small matter replays over and over in your heart, you tell no one, and the more you think the deeper you sink.

You are an independent, decisive kind of woman. Your eye lets no grain of sand through, and what you say you will do, you count on. Your ability is recognized: in a fiercely competitive environment you are the best at rising from adversity, and your career is usually smoother than your love life. The hard gate is marriage: your temperament is firm and you demand a lot of a partner, preferring to stay single over settling, and an equal is hard to find in the first place. If you marry too early, the obstacles in finding harmony will be fairly clear; deciding only after thirty makes it easier to meet someone who truly suits you.

You are a rare kind of gentle, refined young man. Your mind is soft, and your consideration is almost meticulous. You notice the small feelings others overlook, you remember your partner's preferences mentioned in passing, and so you are especially loved by those close to you. But you may also be said to be too soft in nature: you dislike being blunt, dislike showing off in crowds, and would rather quietly finish things behind the scenes. You are at your best when it is quiet and you are rarely disturbed; crowded, noisy places instead drain your strength.

You are the kind of person who must go out. The livelier the place and the more trade there is, the more you prosper, while staying home guarding a spot gives you no room to show your abilities. In another place, the ties of your hometown loosen and your ability can truly be used, so things usually go better for you far away than locally. Highly specialized fields such as finance, engineering, foreign trade and technology suit you best. It is only that when you shoulder things alone outside, your loneliness is also heavier than others', and there are often few people beside you to talk to.

You are the kind of person who must go out. The livelier the place and the more trade there is, the more you prosper; curling up at home guarding a spot gives you no room to show your abilities. You suit work that involves running back and forth across regions, such as finance, engineering, foreign trade and technology; outside you rely on your real ability and not on connections, and the road of trade and working the market runs smoothly for you. It is only that where opportunities are many outside, disputes are many too, and verbal quarrels, conflicts and collisions are all more likely than at home.

You are the kind of person who can make the atmosphere boil just by walking into a room.
