You are open, frank, quick to laugh, and dare to state your views; strangers easily take to you because you hide nothing. But this radiance has a price: you are not good at self-examination, nor at being alone, and stopping to think is torment for you, so you keep busy without pause. You value appearances over substance; this is not vanity, but you truly feel being seen by others is very important, and in youth this also easily wears you out. For those with the Sun Fallen (weak), it is even clearer: you give a lot, the return is slow, fame comes late, and the temper is more stubborn too.

You are the kind of person who puts people at ease wherever you are placed. You are steady, easy to work with, value appearances but do not show off. Serving as the right hand of the person at the top feels more comfortable to you than leading yourself; you do not like charging to the front, but whatever you have taken on you do properly. You speak practically and do not go in for formalities; you soften when you see others in difficulty, and anger rises in your heart when you see someone doing things dishonestly. You do not compete or grab, but your measure of right and wrong is very straight. You care about appearances: your dress, words and the look of your home all keep a sense of measure; this is not showing off, but you feel a person ought to have bearing.

You are the kind of person who looks ordinary but is actually very steady. You do not like to stand out, and in everything you calculate clearly; you are not good at arranging grand shows, but at the critical moment you can hold up. Inside you have an instinct: accumulating matters more than expanding, and keeping matters more than winning. In youth you seem half a beat slow, and while people your age charge ahead you are saving up; from middle age onward this steadiness shows its good side, with steady money, a steady home and steady connections. Your temperament is mild, but mildness is only temperament and does not mean you do not calculate; in fact you have plenty of scheming, and every account that needs counting is counted down to the last coin.

You are the kind of woman for whom people turn for a second look when you walk into a room. You are multi-talented, know how to have fun and how to talk, and there is never a lack of people around you. Many pursue you, but few are truly worth entrusting yourself to; amid the bustle, what you need most is your own clear head. By nature you want to try everything, so your days are more brilliant than others', and also more fragmented. The first half of life mostly passes in experience and struggle, and real settling and achievement often show clearly only in the second half.

What you care about most is appearances; you do not seek the greatest, but you must not lose your sense of measure. In love you are not the passionate type, more like a reliable partner, not romantic but one who will not suddenly vanish. Your biggest weakness is a lack of explosive force, so you easily miss opportunities that demand you act. The suggestion is that in this life you should arrange at least one bold decision: changing city, changing field, or investing money saved for a long time in yourself all count. Calculate the worst outcome clearly, and act if you can accept it; only then does your steadiness turn into strength.

Your greatest risk is not stumbling into a pit but marking time. In a place that is too safe, a person stops advancing. The suggestion is that every two or three years you actively change position or take on a new project. The people who give you a hand are mostly elders and superiors in the organization, so do not just bury yourself in work: once every half year, talk with your direct superior and state clearly what you have accomplished, using numbers where you can. If you really start a business, choose a direction where a steady income flows in every month and the risks are visible; for a side line, choose something tied to your main work, and do not move to another field.

What you do best is maintaining well and making the existing estate solid. It is not opening wild land from zero. Growing in a large organization, making yourself steady first and then making yourself stand out, is the path that suits you best. State agencies, banks, insurance, accounting and auditing, administrative management, and legal compliance in large companies all suit you; being a teacher, or working in training and education, is also your road. You are steady and reliable, are trusted a great deal at work, and are the kind of dependable employee large organizations value most, and you can fairly easily look after both career and family. Your weakness is keeping too strictly to the rules; when a promotion opportunity arrives, you are then reluctant to contend for it.

What you do best is maintaining well and making the existing estate solid. It is not opening wild land from zero. Growing in a large organization, making yourself steady first and then making yourself stand out, is the path that suits you best. State agencies, banks, insurance, accounting and auditing, administrative management, and legal compliance in large companies all suit you; being a teacher, or working in training and education, is also your road, and quite a few people hold a job and teach at the same time, missing neither end. You are reliable and responsible, keep the rules strictly, and help a team run in good order, but you are not good at seizing opportunities in violent upheavals.

The thing you most need to learn is to accept the umbrella that others hold out. You have sheltered yourself for too long already. The suggestion is to leave half a day free every week with nothing scheduled; sleeping, daydreaming or walking all count. From middle age onward you can find a professional to talk to, or try slow jogging, swimming, calligraphy or painting, to let yourself slow down. Having one trade in hand that you can bring out is the steadiest; devote yourself to one field, and do not keep eyeing the next mountain.

The thing you most need to fix is separating asking for help from failure. Opening your mouth to ask someone for help does not mean you are inferior. The suggestion is to leave half a day free every week with nothing scheduled; sleeping, daydreaming or walking all count. From middle age onward you can try finding a professional to talk to, or slow jogging, swimming, calligraphy or painting, things that help a person settle. Having one trade in hand that you can bring out is the steadiest; devote yourself to one field, and do not keep eyeing the next mountain.

You have a capital that you yourself often overlook. You learn anything quickly and know many kinds of work, so changing careers or learning another skill is not hard for you. The lesson you really need to make up is very simple: say aloud what you care about in your heart; a single "I worry about you" is received by family more easily than ten things you quietly do extra. When you disagree with others, ask about the other person's meaning clearly first and judge afterwards; do not rush to conclude who is right or wrong, and many misunderstandings are spared this way.

You have many friends, and your paths are mixed. You can talk a few words with anyone, the kind of person everyone knows; but those who are truly close confidants, to whom you can entrust matters, can be counted on the fingers of one hand. You are most easily drawn to people who speak well and stage things fully, and you also most easily lose out because of this type: they promise quickly, and when it comes to doing, they are nowhere to be seen.

You look more mature than people your age. Not in appearance, but in a calm bearing. You live kindly and seem easy to talk to, but on matters of principle you do not give way at all. You have an instinct to shelter others: when a friend has trouble, they think of you first, and when a colleague is stuck you offer a hand. This gives you good popularity, and also tires you: you take on other people's troubles far too easily, and although it clearly has nothing to do with you, you end up sinking into it. In love you easily attract partners younger than you, or those who need more care, and you like that feeling of being needed.

You are full of vitality and want many things. You also know many things, your communication ability is strong, and by personal charm alone you can influence a group of people. Outwardly you are approachable, but inside you are actually quite hard; once you have made up your mind you dare to act, and can also be impulsive. Your greatest trouble is wanting to try too much, finding it hard to stay with one thing long enough, and when excited you easily take risks in love and money. You have friends all over the world, but the bonds are not deep, heating up fast and cooling fast. The dissatisfaction inside you is your driving force, and also the reason you find it hardest to be still.

You are gentle, soft-hearted and value feelings. You are the kind of person people want to be close to on first meeting. You dislike hard confrontation, and when something big happens your first reaction is to find someone to discuss it with; this is not weakness but your way of holding steady. You are also intelligent and learn fast, and this ability helps you widen your road, so how life goes does not depend entirely on others. Where you most easily lose out is softness of heart: knowing full well that a relationship is not right but still not bearing to cut it off; knowing full well that someone is using you but, the next time she asks, agreeing again. You do not lack kindness; what you lack is a clear boundary.

You are gentle, sensitive and fine-minded. You pick up feelings others have not yet spoken, which makes you the softest presence before those close to you. The reverse is also true: a careless remark from someone can echo in your heart for a very long time. You are like the moon that is sometimes full and sometimes waning, with noticeable differences in your state from one time to another; when good, you can do anything, and when low, even answering a message is hard. You have never lacked people who are fond of you; what you lack is someone who can truly protect this softness of yours.

Your father is mostly a well-groomed, competitive person. He works as a civil servant, a teacher or a doctor, or builds a career of his own, and he also has expectations of you, hoping you will bring honour to the family in the outside world. Between you and your father, things lean toward the formal, with polite words and not many moments of real heart-to-heart. The way you deal with superiors is basically a copy of the father-and-child pattern; you are just as strong with leaders, and discomfort easily arises over who gets to shine. When the Sun is Fallen (weak), the old books say "in the Fallen position it clashes with the father", and of the two parents the father is clashed with first.

Your father is mostly someone who likes to read and likes to reflect. The two of you talk well together, but there is not much everyday closeness, and the affection is all hidden in reasoning and topics of conversation. Your mother's influence on you is usually deeper than your father's, and your early reading habits and your way of seeing things were mostly guided by her. Some people lived apart from their parents for a time in childhood, or were raised by elders, or took a godfather or godmother; these are only different forms of fate, and there is no need to think of them in a bad light.

Your parents are mostly teachers, doctors or engineers. With people who like to read and like to reason, you talk well, but precisely because you are so alike, everyday trifles rub against each other without end. Your mother's influence on you is usually deeper than your father's; the two of you can understand each other, and can also most easily touch each other's sore spots. Some people lived apart from their parents for a time in childhood, or were raised by elders, or took a godfather or godmother; these are only different forms of fate, and there is no need to think of them in a bad light.

Your parents are mostly mild in temperament, and love you more than they scold you. The atmosphere at home is not tense, and this is a very practical support for you. But this love is also a pit: when someone arranges everything for you, your own drive gets worn away. When Taboo (obstruction) is present, the health of your elders needs more attention, or the affection runs a little cool. At work you cooperate most smoothly with gentle superiors, and when you meet a forceful person you are easily pressed down.

Your parents are mostly mild in temperament, and love you more than they scold you. After marriage you also get along easily with your in-laws, and your gentleness is liked by the elders. The pit is that you want too much to please everyone, giving in all the way down the line, until your own thoughts have no place left to rest.

Your parents are steady and practical. The family estate is fairly substantial, your father is mostly a stable person in a state agency, a bank or a traditional industry, and the family teaching is thrift and keeping the household, advancing steadily. The bond with your parents is generally full, and your greatest blessing comes from here: there is an estate to inherit and a disciplined way of working to learn.

Your parents are steady and practical, and the family estate is fairly substantial. They are mostly in a state agency, a bank or a traditional industry, and the family teaching is thrift and keeping the household, advancing steadily. Your relationship with your mother is especially harmonious, as close as sisters, and in keeping a home and raising children she is your greatest teacher. After marriage you also get along well with your in-laws, who value your steadiness and your skill at keeping a home, only your contributions are easily taken for granted.

You are independent and think things through. You have a calm beyond your years; when others panic at trouble, you are already working out the next step. You have a man's sense of taking responsibility, you can bear the workload, and your family feels steady following you, a real support to your husband and children. You have plenty of noble people in your life, and when you are stuck there is always someone older and respected who steps in. In love you are used to being the caretaker and adviser, like teacher and student, and over time your partner will feel pressure. You set a high standard for both yourself and those beside you, and in the end the one who is tired is you.

Your career rests on two things: knowing a lot, and wanting a lot. The more crowded and lively the trade, and the more you open up a situation with your tongue and connections, the more you prosper, for example performance, food and drink, entertainment and media, travel and trade, beauty. In a team you are the lively one who can be seen and can draw people in, but for work that requires burying yourself and grinding for three years, you lack patience. Early income going up and down is normal, and the real peak comes after middle age.

Your career lives on "breaking" and "changing". You perform best where reform and opening a new situation are needed, and you cannot stand clinging to the old, repeated day after day. Technology, foreign trade, international commerce, the arts, the military, police, judiciary and diplomacy, and reform-oriented management all suit you, and going out is stronger than holding one place. You dare to voice opposing views and push everyone to change, your greatest value when a breakthrough is needed; when it comes to the stage that needs steady execution, your interest drops very fast. Noble people come from all directions, often met on the road and in cross-field dealings.
