Your career lives by your mouth. Eloquence and professional expression are your most precious capital, standing out most in positions that call for persuading people, conveying information and winning rights for others. Lawyers, teachers and lecturers, journalists, sales consultants, psychological counsellors, hosts, editors and writers, trades that work through language, suit you best. In a team you are the one who dares to raise sharp questions, and speaking too bluntly sometimes makes colleagues uncomfortable. The greatest risk is causing a dispute, even getting caught up in a lawsuit, over just one remark.

Your career lives by your mouth. Eloquence and professional expression are your most precious capital; as a lawyer, trainer, host, translator, journalist or consultant, you have a clear advantage. In a team you dare to raise sharp questions, but speaking too bluntly sometimes makes people uncomfortable, and the workplace truly still holds prejudice against women who are "too good at talking". The greatest risk is causing a dispute over just one remark.

Your career rests on two things: knowing a lot, and wanting a lot. Every trade that lives on popularity, word-of-mouth reputation and personal style suits you: beauty, fashion, livestream selling, event organizing, food and drink brands, and sales all count. You are best at being seen and best at drawing in connections, but for work that requires burying yourself and grinding for several years, you cannot sit still. Early on, thanks to your looks, popularity and circle, opportunities often arrive faster than your ability; this is an advantage and also a trap: once the advantage period is over, a person who has not built up real ability will find the road narrows noticeably.

Your career is spoken for by your real ability. You rely neither on connections nor on image, and you prosper most in positions that need hard capability. Finance and accounting, industrial manufacturing, military, police and law enforcement, surgery, construction engineering, asset management, or positions that require managing people and closing decisions all suit you very well, and when you hold real power in hand you perform best. You work without delay and without many words, and things move faster, but your management of people leans hard, and your subordinates are under no small pressure. For a woman of your type, career is usually smoother than love, and career achievement is your firmest support.

Your career is spoken for by your real ability. You rely neither on connections nor on image, and you prosper most in positions that need hard capability. Finance and accounting, industrial manufacturing, military, police and law enforcement, surgery, construction engineering, asset management, or positions that require managing people and closing decisions all suit you very well. When you hold real power in hand and can make the final call yourself, you perform best. You work without delay and without many words, and with you on the team things move faster, but your management of people leans hard, and your subordinates are under no small pressure. Your money comes from real work, and you receive as much as you do.

Your living situation is usually not very stable. You move house often, repair repeatedly, and have many minor troubles with electricity and plumbing. It is not that you do not know how to choose; you are simply born unable to stay settled. When the Army Breaker is in the Rat palace or the Horse palace, the old family home instead flourishes, though with money coming in and going out. The meaning of a house for you is not a lifelong harbour but more like a base for each stage; you are not good at taking root for twenty years in one place. In renovation you lean toward an avant-garde, individual style, and you do not feel at home following the traditional way.

Your living situation is usually not very stable. You move house often, repair repeatedly, and it is very hard to settle into a home in one go. It is not that you do not know how to choose; you are simply born unable to stay settled. When the Army Breaker is in the Rat palace or the Horse palace, the old family home instead flourishes, though with money coming in and going out. The meaning of a house for you is not a lifelong dwelling but more like a base for each stage; you are not good at taking root for twenty years in one place.

You do not have many siblings. The relationship cannot be called close either: few words, each in a world of their own since childhood, polite when you meet, and heartfelt matters go unspoken. This is not anyone being cold; it is that each sibling is strong and independent and used to carrying things alone. In business partnerships, what you fear most is getting too deeply tied together: the other side is mostly domineering too, and two strong people together are bound to compete over who is higher, in the end hurting both money and affection.

You do not have many siblings, but each of them has their own story. They have unusual experiences, or their paths in love and career differ from other people's. Your relationships are more complicated than in an ordinary family: when good, you talk until midnight, and when faint, you do not make a phone call for years, and feelings and interests are often entangled together. This is where trouble is most likely: today you finish a matter relying on affection, and tomorrow it is unclear who owes whom.

You do not have many siblings, but each of them has their own story. They have unusual experiences, or their paths in love and career differ from other people's. Your feelings for them are very deep, and also easily entangled: when good, you talk until midnight, and when faint, you are out of contact for years. Where trouble is most likely is in mixing the ledger of affection with the ledger of interests: because you talk well together, you overlook the boundary in business, and when the affection breaks, the business breaks with it.

You have a few too few siblings, and everyone has a firm temperament. Since childhood you could not be called clinging; discussing business is easy and confiding is hard. Money dealings between you are often more practical than the emotional bond, and even full siblings keep accounts clear: a loan comes with a written note, and cooperation with a contract. If there is real turbulence, it is mostly over money: dividing a house, supporting aged parents, investing together in something; these places are the most likely to cause an uproar. After marriage, living with your husband's brothers' wives is also a test for you.

Your siblings are mostly firm in temperament, each living their own life, and there are a few too few of them. Since childhood you could not be called clinging. It is not that the affection is poor, but that your whole family is used to laying matters out and speaking plainly; discussing business is easy and confiding is hard, and there is no need to force siblings to be tightly close. Money dealings between you and them are often more practical than the emotional bond: even full siblings count clearly, a loan comes with a written note, and cooperation with a contract.

Your siblings are mostly people who know how to have fun, with wide paths. They are the kind who are never short of company, often found in entertainment, the arts, fashion and sales. There are usually not many of them, each living their own life, and you get along better than if you were crowded together. You talk with each other mostly about recent events and lively topics, and seldom speak from the heart.

Your siblings are mostly people with opinions who like to reason. When you gather, usually no one gives way to anyone. There are not many of you, and your thoughts are hard to bring to one place; living apart early actually means fewer collisions. In business partnerships, what you fear most is a verbal agreement: your suspicious nature plus the other side's suspicious nature, and in a partnership without anything in black and white, it easily ferments into mistrust.

Your siblings are mostly steady in temperament as well. Between you there is a spirit of sheltering one another, and when anyone has trouble the other can be a support. The thickness of the bond differs from family to family: some have only one or two siblings and get along gently, others have quite a few but each lives their own life and seldom meets in daily life. After marriage, living with your husband's brothers' wives, you naturally carry a bit of the standing of an elder, and they like to come and ask you about family matters.

Your siblings are mostly steady and mature in temperament as well. Between you there is a spirit of sheltering one another, and when anyone has trouble the other can be a support. The thickness of the bond differs from family to family: some have only one or two siblings and get along gently, others have quite a few but each lives their own life and seldom meets in daily life.

Your siblings are mostly smooth talkers with wide paths as well. They are often found in sales, entertainment, food and drink, and the arts. There are usually not many of them, each living their own life, and you have fewer worries than if you were crowded together. You are lively when lively, with big scenes at festivals, but on ordinary days you seldom speak from the heart.

Your siblings are mostly honest and easy to get along with. There are not many, two or three being the majority. Among you there is no fondness for big quarrels, and the atmosphere at home is a gentle one. In business partnerships, the other side is mostly the number-two type: steady, willing to cooperate, solid in work, but without enough ability to lead. You set the direction and let them bring things into reality behind you; this division of labour runs most smoothly.

Your siblings are mostly mild and easy to get along with. There are not many, two or three being the majority. The atmosphere at home keeps both the rules and the harmony, siblings do not like big quarrels, and when something comes up each first gives way a step. After marriage, among the wives of your husband's family you are usually the mediator, steady and measured, neither flattering nor aloof, and your in-laws can find no fault in you. If siblings cooperate on some small business, you work together very well. The trouble is that once a good-natured reputation is established, all the family's matters get pushed onto you.

Your siblings are mostly steady and practical. They may work in traditional industries, as civil servants or in banks. Your relationship is mild but conservative: you gather at festivals and are all present when the family has a big event, but on ordinary days there is little deep confiding; it is stable, but you cannot say anyone especially lifts anyone up. After marriage, you also get along gently with the wives of your husband's family, and your steadiness is well liked in this kind of relationship, with few big conflicts. Your biggest hidden danger is not quarrelling but worrying so much about keeping peace in the clan that you put your own interests last; occasions like inheritance, property and joint investment are where you most easily lose out.

Your siblings are mostly steady and practical. They may work in state agencies, banks or traditional industries. Your relationship leans toward courtesy: you gather at festivals and are all present when the family has a big event, but on ordinary days there is little deep confiding, and you cannot say anyone especially lifts anyone up. If you cooperate in business, you naturally lean toward the steady road; traditional industries, chain businesses and buying a house together all lie within your comfort zone, while a style that is too daring does not suit you.

Your siblings are mostly clever and quick-minded. But the affection among you is changeable: each busy with their own affairs, you meet seldom and live far apart, and it is hard to have the closeness of sticking together day after day; you talk fairly well when you meet, and when apart each has their own life. In cooperation you need to be especially careful: the person who pools capital with you usually has many ideas but changes them quickly, one plan today and another thought tomorrow, making execution very difficult.

Among your siblings there is mostly one who stands out especially. That person does well in the outside world and is usually an older brother or sister; when you really meet difficulty, that person is also the first you think of, and you respect them yet cannot help comparing yourself. Your affection is real, but there is a layer of formality between you, with little playful intimacy. In cooperation you must be especially careful: with the Emperor in the Siblings palace, your collaborators are mostly strong in presence, each with their own opinion, and if you also want to hold the decision, it easily becomes two people fighting for the wheel.

Among your siblings there is usually one who is outgoing and well-groomed. This person can stand firm in society and may hold positions such as in a state agency, a school or the media. Dealings among you are fairly frank, with little scheming behind backs, and mostly you appear together in circles of friends and in public settings. With the Sun Temple or Prosperous (strong), your siblings are people you can rely on.

Among your siblings there is usually one who is outgoing and well-groomed. This person can stand firm in society and may hold positions such as in a state agency, a school or the media. Dealings among you are fairly frank, with little scheming behind backs, and mostly you appear together in circles of friends and in public settings. With the Sun Temple or Prosperous (strong), your siblings are people you can rely on. When Prosperity (money coming in) is present, your siblings can truly help you, and working together can even amplify each other's influence.

Among your siblings, you are closer to the women. Your sisters talk well with you, and you are willing to say heartfelt words to them; if you have brothers, you get along in a reserved and gentle way, seldom in direct conflict. In cooperation, your collaborators are mostly fine-minded and sensitive, good at handling human relations, and do not rely on hard confrontation.

Your inner world is like a deep well, flat on the surface and very deep below. You are born fond of research, fond of getting to the truth, and fond of thinking through the reasoning behind matters; used in the right place, this ability is solid research strength. Used wrongly, it becomes over-analysis: a small matter can make you speculate back and forth for three days, in the end accomplishing nothing. Your life is mostly worry in the heart, not disaster coming from outside, but weariness of the heart is real weariness too.

Your inner world is very deep. You are born fond of research, fond of getting to the truth, and fond of thinking through the reasoning behind matters. Used in the right place, this ability is solid research strength. Used wrongly, it becomes thinking over and over: one remark or one expression can make you speculate in your heart for half a month. Your life is mostly worry in the heart, not disaster coming from outside, but weariness of the heart is real weariness too, and what you most need to avoid is brooding alone in a room, going deeper the more you think.

Your partner is mostly a Sun-type man. He is outgoing, charismatic, devoted to his career, and has some reputation or position in his field. When the Sun is Temple or Prosperous (strong), he has a good image and is willing to care for the family; when Fallen (weak), you two must put in extra effort to protect your time together. You admire a man of ability, but this kind of man most easily sets you aside: he is busy with his affairs and you keep watch alone. One more old saying needs correcting: managing the household well does not mean the marriage will last; affection must be built with effort from both of you.

Your partner is mostly a gentle, refined woman with a quiet bearing. She knows how to understand, has a delicate look, and carries herself well. You yourself put great care into love and remember the preferences she mentions in passing; but you are also sensitive and think a lot, and if she leaves one sentence unanswered, you may brood over it all day, so you need your partner to give you enough sense of security. Your partner carries great weight in your heart.

Your circle of connections is both wide and conspicuous. Among the people you know are quite a few men with status and reputation, with whom you talk well and can discuss deeply. This is your advantage, and also where you are most easily gossiped about: outsiders do not see you discussing proper matters, they only see you being close. The brightness of the Sun in this palace decides whether your friends and subordinates are willing to put effort into helping you.

Your circle of connections is both wide and conspicuous. Among the people you know are quite a few with status and reputation, who at critical moments can bring you practical resources. The brightness of the Sun in this palace decides whether your friends and subordinates are willing to put effort into helping you. Male friends are the main axis of your relationships, but being too devoted to loyalty is also the easiest way to take the blame for others.

Your presence is very strong, not through a loud voice but through a bearing that is hard to cross. You are frank, decisive, and dislike beating around the bush; once a matter is settled it is not easy to turn back. You do not like to talk, but once you have spoken you act, and few can beat you in execution; but you cannot stand people who dither, and even less superiors who keep changing direction, so cooperation in a team often has friction. You are hot-tempered and firm, and also prone to suspicion, so people near you must spend some effort to guess you accurately. In love you are frank but not delicate; what you give your partner is the certainty of doing what you say, not the gentleness of understanding unspoken feelings.

You will not have too many children, but each one will be clever. From early on they are a little hard to see through, with a fine mind and strong sensitivity, and talent shows first in fields such as art and literature. Do note that your child awakens early emotionally, and the confiding of adolescence, acquaintances made online and swings of mood will all be a bit more than among peers. You yourself have been through emotional complexity and understand what your child is troubled by better than anyone.

You will not have too many children, but each one will be clever. From early on they are a little hard to see through, with a fine mind and strong sensitivity, and mostly talent shows first in places like art and literature. Do note that your child awakens early emotionally, and the confiding of adolescence and the friction in dealing with others will be a bit more than among peers. You yourself are firm in temperament, and as a father you tend to set demands first; father and child talk little, and each easily braces alone.

Your child has had ideas of their own since small. They will not let themselves be managed entirely, and have a drive to charge ahead. You will mostly not have too many children, and having them a little late is more relaxed. The most likely problem is between mother and daughter: the older your daughter grows the more she is like another you, the more you push the more she talks back, the more finely you manage the further she stays away, and the two of you easily become opponents. If your child takes a path that needs drive such as the military or police, starting a business, sports or scientific research, they often achieve results.

Your child has had ideas of their own since small. Like a little general, they will not let adults manage them entirely. You will mostly not have too many children, and becoming a father a little late is more relaxed. The most likely problem is the adolescent years: the more you press with your standing as a parent, the more your child escapes outside, and hard confrontation only pushes the person away. A child like this, if put in the right place, such as the military or police, starting a business, sports or scientific research, which need drive, often achieves results; if forced to be a well-behaved child, both sides suffer.

Your children are mostly obedient, sensible and easy to raise. Their grades are above average, they behave with propriety, and they are the kind that let a mother worry least. You are especially close to your daughter, like mother and child, sisters and friends all at once, with seldom any conflict. Your bond with children is thick to begin with, childbirth generally goes smoothly too, and during the postpartum month your family looks after you attentively. Note the other side: a child who is too sensible often hides the deepest discomfort, and the obedience you see is not necessarily the child truly being at ease.

Your children are mostly obedient, cooperative and well brought up. From small they are the kind who put people at ease wherever they are placed, liked by teachers and often named in praise at parent meetings. Your bond with children is thick to begin with, and as they grow up their studies and job-hunting go steadily; civil service, professional positions and large traditional companies suit them best. The relationship between you and your daughter is usually especially harmonious, with matching temperaments, and whatever is said goes down well.

Your children are mostly smooth talkers who like to argue and ask a great many questions. From small they like to ask why, and their power of reflection is ample. A child comes a little late, the process may also have setbacks, difficult at first and smoother later. A child like this, put in the right place, on the path of lawyer, scholar or researcher, will have a future; put in a family that only wants obedience, they instead become a thorn in your heart. The conflict most likely to appear is talking back in adolescence: the more you press with your standing as a father, the more the child's eloquence is trained into a weapon against you.

Your children are mostly smooth talkers who often question things. Their power of reflection is ample, and they usually study well, especially in directions such as debate, writing and law. A child comes a little late, the process may also have setbacks, difficult at first and smoother later; this should be viewed more openly, and there is no need to compare early and late with others. The biggest hidden danger is quarrelling between mother and daughter: your words are sharp, and an adolescent child's rebuttals are sharper still, and the quarrelling goes on until neither will speak to the other.

Your children are mostly outgoing, quick to laugh and easily loved. To read a son you look at the yang star, and the Sun is exactly the yang star representing sons. The old saying goes "a late child is precious"; have children a little late, and they will have even better prospects. You and your son influence each other very deeply, and your strong temperament easily presses down your child's opinions without meaning to.

Your children are mostly outgoing, quick to laugh and lovable. To read a son you look at the yang star, and the Sun is exactly the yang star representing sons. The old notion says "a late child is precious"; have children a little late, and they will have even better prospects. You and your son influence each other very deeply; your strong temperament easily presses down your child's own views without meaning to. When Prosperity (wealth advancing) is present, your child's prospects are brilliant, and they may be the one with the most glory in the family.

Your children are mostly outgoing, quick to laugh and well liked. As a little one your child is the lively member of the class, and grown up has a wide road. To read a son you look at the yang star, and the Sun is exactly the yang star representing sons. The old saying goes "a late child is precious"; becoming a father a little late is better, and a child who comes late usually has even better prospects. The greatest difficulty for you as a father is that you care whether your child brings honour to the family, and you easily press your own regard for reputation onto your child.

Your children are mostly outgoing, quick to laugh and well liked. As a little one your child is the lively member of the class, and grown up has a wide road. To read a son you look at the yang star, and the Sun is exactly the yang star representing sons. The old saying goes "a late child is precious"; becoming a father a little late is better, and a child who comes late usually has even better prospects. The greatest difficulty for you as a father is that you care whether your child brings honour to the family, and you easily press your own regard for reputation onto your child. When Prosperity (money coming in) is present, your child's prospects are bright, and they may become the most famous person in the family.

Your children are mostly easy to raise. From small they are the kind you rarely need to worry about, not rebellious, not stepping out of line, and steady in their studies. As a mother you have a special advantage: your steadiness gives your child a sense of security from early on, and the parent-child relationship stays stable all along the way. What truly needs attention is the other side: your love easily shelters your child too tightly, giving too much peace, so the child in turn lacks the courage to charge ahead and learn from mistakes.

Your children are mostly easy to raise. From small they cause less worry, are not rebellious, do not step beyond bounds, study steadily and get along with people. What truly needs attention is not that your child will cause trouble, but that they will dare too little: used to stability, they may easily live a whole life within the set rules, lacking the courage to learn from mistakes.

Your children are mostly firm in temperament and steady in their views. From small your child is like a miniature adult, not clingy and seldom coy. A chart like this leans toward few children, and the bond with children also comes a little later. Your greatest difficulty as a mother does not lie in whether you can provide: material conditions and study plans you arrange both steadily and carefully; the difficulty is the part that has to be said aloud, and a single "Mum loves you" or a hug is like another language for you. Yet this is exactly what your child wants most.

Your children are mostly firm in temperament and steady in their views. From small your child is like a miniature adult, not clingy and seldom coy, and even when there is love inside, it is expressed through actions and not hung on the lips. A chart like this leans toward few children, and the bond with children also comes a little later. As a father you easily step into two pits: one is managing too strictly, treating being good to your child as forging them into a capable person, so that your child's childhood holds few warm memories; the other is using money in place of companionship, thinking that earning money so your child lives well is enough.

Your children are mostly mature early. At home they are like miniature adults, know how to read your face, and take the initiative to share the family's burden. By the old reckoning, you will have about two children. The Heavenly Beam counts as a yang star, and when the Children palace sees the Heavenly Beam there is a son. The biggest hidden worry for you as a father is not that your child does not understand things, but that they understand too much; being sensible too early is the same as handing over childhood early.

Your children are mostly little social butterflies. Full of small talents and good popularity, with a gift for art, performance and work that deals with people. The number of children is usually small, the early years of the father-child bond take some effort, or you become a father a little later than your peers, and from middle age onward the relationship becomes smoother and smoother. The most important thing to watch is the adolescent years, with feelings arriving early and curiosity about stimulating things.

Your children are mostly little social butterflies. Full of small talents and good popularity, liked wherever they go. Your greatest strength as a mother is understanding your child: you can follow along with all their varied interests, and your child is willing to tell you secrets. The most important thing to watch is the adolescent years, with feelings arriving early and curiosity about stimulating things.

Your children are mostly clever, with strong curiosity. Their minds turn fast, and their questions follow one after another. A child like this pushes back harder the tighter you press, and grows up when given space. You easily fall into two pits: one is that you know a lot yourself and are used to directing your child's every decision; the other is using "this is more useful" to steer your child away, instead of letting them do what they want. As for the bond with children, a child may come a little late, and the number is not large.

Your children are mostly clever and bright, fond of asking questions from small, curious, with leaping thoughts. Your greatest ability is understanding your child's flights of fancy, and you can discuss with them questions that adults may not be able to answer. The pit you most easily fall into is parenting anxiety: researching a pile of methods, comparing every step of your child with other people's families, getting more alarmed the more you look, and exhausting yourself. As for the bond with children, a child may come a little late, and the number is not large.

Your children are easy to raise, gentle and considerate. From small they do not worry people much, and grown up they mostly choose a steady road to walk, and father and child seldom clash. Do note that your child lacks the drive to rush forward and easily feels that the present is good enough. You yourself lean toward liking comfort, cannot bear to see your child suffer, and when you dote it easily goes too far, with the result that you raise a next generation with even less drive than you.

Your children are easy to raise, gentle and considerate. From small they do not worry people much, and grown up they mostly choose a steady road to walk, and father and child seldom clash. Do note that your child lacks the drive to rush forward and easily feels that the present is good enough. You yourself lean toward liking comfort, cannot bear to see your child suffer, and when you dote it easily goes too far, with the result that you raise a next generation with even less drive than you. When Taboo (obstruction) is present, your child's constitution is a little weak, or you see each other seldom and are often apart.

Your children are easy to raise and mild in temperament. They seldom clash with you, and grown up can also speak heartfelt words with you like a friend; as a mother you worry less than most. Do note that your child lacks the drive to step forward and take things, and easily feels that the present is enough; your gentleness is a good thing, but a child who stays forever in a soft environment does not know what it feels like to use strength.

Your children are easy to raise and mild in temperament. They seldom clash with you, and grown up can also speak heartfelt words with you like a friend; as a mother you worry less than most. Do note that your child lacks the drive to step forward and take things, and easily feels that the present is enough; your gentleness is a good thing, but a child who stays forever in a soft environment does not know what it feels like to use strength. When Taboo (obstruction) is present, your child's everyday health needs more attention.

Your child is sensitive and refined, and knows how to read faces. Whether you are in a good mood, your child knows at a glance, a rare child who knows how to care. Your bond with daughters is especially deep, and cases of having a daughter, or a daughter first, are more common. Your greatest ability as a father is understanding the small calculations in your child's heart, the kind of father to whom a child is willing to tell secrets on their own.

Your child has the temperament of a little emperor. Your child has strong self-respect, wants independence, and from small does not give in to force. You are precisely the kind of mother who says "everything I do is for you", laying out a clear road ahead for your child, but your child has sensed since small that this love comes with control, and the more you arrange for your child, the more your child does the opposite to prove they can manage.

Your child has the temperament of a little emperor. Your child has strong self-respect, wants independence, and from small does not give in to force; the harder you press, the harder they push back. The mistake you most easily make is exactly using your standing as a parent to press people down, with the result that your child grows up with a firm temperament like yours, and turns around to argue with you to the end. Among your children there is usually one who stands out especially, mostly the eldest, and that child's later path even affects whether your old age has something in your heart to lean on.

Your child is extremely independent, likes to overturn rules, and has creative power. From small a stubborn little one, hard to order about. In the parent-child bond, the early years mostly have setbacks, and only later does it gradually smooth out. Conflict most easily arises between you and your daughter: the more you want your child to keep the rules, the more she wants to overturn them; the more you hope she is steady, the more she wants to take risks, when in fact the two of you share one temperament. Your road to having children also often has snags, with later pregnancy and needing several tries being very common.

Your child is extremely independent, likes to overturn rules, and has creative power. From small a stubborn little one, hard to order about, the kind parents find hardest to manage. In the father-child bond, the early years mostly have setbacks, and only later does it gradually smooth out; the closeness may not be there when young, but over time affection grows instead. A child put in the right place, on the path of starting a business, art, technology or reform, will have great prospects; put in a family that demands obedience and keeping the rules, the child becomes a great worry in your heart.

Your peace of mind is laid on things you can see. The balance in your account, the property deed, the insurance contract; when these are still there, your heart is steady. Unlike the worry of feeling you have not earned enough, what you fear is not that you have not earned, but that what you have will be lost. When life is quiet, your good fortune remains; as soon as things get chaotic, you must live in worry.

Your peace of mind is laid on things you can see. Savings you already have, a solid roof, a few trustworthy connections. When life is quiet, your good fortune remains; as soon as things get chaotic, you must live in worry. Your anxiety is much deeper than it appears, and outsiders usually see only a calm look on your face.

Your home is usually beautifully arranged, with a touch of the artistic. You also keep a place for hosting friends, and everyone likes to gather at your house. As for the family estate, what the previous generation left you mostly cannot be counted on.

Your home is usually arranged with taste. You also set aside a place for fun, such as audio and video, a wine cabinet or a card table, and friends all like to gather at your house. As for the family estate, what the previous generation left you mostly cannot be counted on.

Your family property is tied very closely to your ancestors. The blessing of virtue left by your ancestors, you inherit. When Prosperity (money coming in) is present, the family estate is substantial, and what the elders leave behind can add further glory to you.

Your home has a warmth that shelters people. Relatives like to come and sit, and friends in difficulty run to your place. As for the family property left in the hometown, those with the Heavenly Beam Temple or Prosperous have a share. You are deeply attached to your parents, and even after starting a family, living a little closer to them is what lets you feel at ease.

Your home has a warmth that shelters people. Elders like to come and sit, and friends in difficulty run to your place. As for the family property left in the hometown, those with the Heavenly Beam Temple or Prosperous have a share. You are not suited to a completely independent small family; living with or near your parents is what lets you feel at ease.

Your foundation is not bad, and your recovery is also good. The problem lies in being too good at enduring: the body sent signals long ago, and you let them pass because you felt you could still hold on. Which part of the body needs more attention depends on which palace in the whole chart has the most malefic stars gathered, then use the earthly branch of that palace to match the organ (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig triple burner); do not look it up by the element of the Heavenly Beam star in the Health palace; with prolonged tension, the first sign is poor sleep. You are used to carrying things yourself and not asking for help, and suppressed emotions show up in the body: an irregular menstrual cycle with light flow often comes from there. You lean toward marrying and having children a little late; preparing to have a child may need a longer time, and the stage of postpartum depression should also be guarded against.

Your foundation is not bad, and you recover quickly from illness. The main problem is that you are too good at gritting your teeth: your body has been sending signals for a long time, and because you feel you can still hold on, you let them pass. To know which part of the body deserves more attention, look at which palace in the whole chart gathers the most malefic stars, then match that palace's earthly branch to an organ (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig triple burner); do not look it up by the element of the Heavenly Beam star in the Health palace. When stress drags on, the first sign is poor sleep. You are used to carrying things alone and never ask for help, so loneliness and pressure pile up, and around middle age they tend to surface together, showing up as easy tiredness and restless sleep.

Your foundation leans toward the mild. Overall it is not bad, but it fluctuates quite clearly, and when you are tired for a long time you can collapse for a while. To know which part of the body deserves more attention, look at which palace in the whole chart gathers the most malefic stars, then match that palace's earthly branch to an organ (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig triple burner); do not look it up by the element of the Minister star in the Health palace. Sitting for long hours combined with pressure also makes the cervical and lumbar spine prone to trouble. Emotions are the thing that harms you most: you swallow your grievances, look gentle on the outside, yet are always carrying a load; the periods around pregnancy, childbirth and menopause are when long-suppressed feelings are most likely to burst out.

Your foundation leans toward the mild. Overall it is fairly good, but it fluctuates quite clearly, and when you are tired for a long time you can collapse for a while. To know which part of the body deserves more attention, look at which palace in the whole chart gathers the most malefic stars, then match that palace's earthly branch to an organ (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig triple burner); do not look it up by the element of the Minister star in the Health palace. Prolonged sitting combined with work pressure also makes the cervical and lumbar spine prone to trouble. Emotions affect you especially strongly: you swallow your grievances, look gentle on the outside, yet are always carrying a load, and if it is not released for a long time, the body is the first place that cannot take it.

Your foundation leans toward the sturdy. Your health is generally not bad. To know which part of the body deserves more attention, look at which palace in the whole chart gathers the most malefic stars, then match that palace's earthly branch to an organ (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig triple burner); do not look it up by the element of the Treasury star in the Health palace. Most of your troubles come from a life that is too comfortable: little exercise, a slowing metabolism, weight creeping up bit by bit, and a back and joints that wear down from sitting too long. You do not like to voice your worries and swallow everything in your heart, and suppressing it for long will affect your appetite and your resistance.

Your foundation leans toward the sturdy. Your health is generally not bad. To know which part of the body deserves more attention, look at which palace in the whole chart gathers the most malefic stars, then match that palace's earthly branch to an organ (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig triple burner); do not look it up by the element of the Treasury star in the Health palace. With a comfortable life and little exercise, the metabolism slows, weight creeps up bit by bit, and the back and joints wear down from sitting too long. You also do not like to voice your worries, and suppressing them for long will affect your appetite and your resistance.

Your foundation leans toward the sturdy. Your state of health is generally not bad. To know which part of the body deserves more attention, look at which palace in the whole chart gathers the most malefic stars, then match that palace's earthly branch to an organ (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig triple burner); do not look it up by the element of the Emperor star in the Health palace. Your body and emotions are especially tightly linked: you have strong self-respect, and whenever you meet setbacks or denial you press all the pressure down inside; the first things that cannot take it are your sleep and discomfort around the head.

Your foundation leans toward the sturdy. Overall it is fairly good. To know which part of the body deserves more attention, look at which palace in the whole chart gathers the most malefic stars, then match that palace's earthly branch to an organ (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig triple burner); do not look it up by the element of the Emperor star in the Health palace. Your body and emotions are very tightly linked: you have strong self-respect, and whenever you meet setbacks you press all the pressure down inside; the first thing that cannot take it is your sleep. Women have one more layer - the rhythms of emotion and body affect each other, emotions swing widely before and after the period, and irregular cycles are fairly common, so it is worth keeping a record yourself.

Your weak point is being too conservative. When something new is laid out in front of you, you often wait until everyone else is used to it before you move. A suggestion is to leave yourself room to try and fail: learn one new skill each year and get to know a few people outside your circle. It is right to value ability and character when choosing a life partner, but do not turn your requirements into a checklist; pay more attention to whether being together feels comfortable. One more point: you want to keep your family within a safe range so much that it easily takes away their space; when you disagree with a family member's decision, hear them out first and then speak.

Your mind is so delicate that even you find it tiring. The tone of someone's sentence, a flicker of hesitation in their eyes, and you can split it into three layers of meaning in your heart. This sensitivity makes you more thoughtful than anyone in small matters, but in big matters it drags you down - one decision gets replayed a dozen times in your head, and by the time you actually act, the best moment has passed. You have an innate interest in metaphysics, destiny studies, psychology and unseen patterns, and the more you dig, the more addicted you get. Where you tire most is in intimate relationships: you pick up the other person's emotions about yourself too easily, and when he is unhappy you are uncomfortable well before he is.

Your inner world is always more complicated than your expression. You are not a good-tempered person; that fire keeps burning, it is just that at times you hold it down and do not let it out. Your likes and dislikes are clear: when you like someone you like them very deeply, and when you dislike someone you remember it for a very long time. You are intelligent, but this intelligence is often misused: over a single remark you turn over and over what the other person meant, and one detail can pass through your mind for months. You suit politics, the judiciary, the military or police, the arts, or any complex field that needs sharp judgment; a path with a bit of an edge is one you walk with the grain. You need to guard against the other side: gambling, relations between the sexes, and lawsuits - once you get caught up in these three, it is not easy to withdraw.

Your happiness is very practical. Only when work is done and there is a concrete figure in your account does your heart feel steady; without it you panic. You are someone who cannot sit still, you find work for yourself even when there is none, and being busy is your everyday state; fortunately the busyness mostly brings returns, and in later years you can actually relax. Talk of spirituality and lofty states of mind does not do much for you; what you need is the steady feeling of work finished and money accumulated.

Your happiness comes in a very practical way. A meal that suits your taste, a full night's sleep, being treated gently by someone - your heart is already full, without needing any grand principle. This kind of happiness that grows out of ordinary life is the steadiest and also the hardest to lose. From middle age onward, this fear of being forgotten will become more noticeable.

Your happiness comes in a very practical way. A meal that suits your taste, a full night's sleep, being treated gently by someone - your heart is already full, without needing any grand principle. This kind of happiness that grows out of ordinary life is the steadiest and also the hardest to lose. When Taboo (obstruction) is at work, you easily fall into a kind of unease, always worrying whether you are no longer cared about; a partner who is a little cooler, family who are a little busier, a friend who has not been in touch for a few days - all get blown up by you. From middle age onward, this fear of being forgotten will become more noticeable.

Your home is basically bought by yourself. What your family leaves you is limited, your youth is not easy, and from middle age onward you buy more and more smoothly, so comparing homes with other people in your twenties makes no sense. When you buy a home you look at whether it is comfortable to live in, not at how much it will appreciate, which is not wrong in itself. When Taboo (obstruction) is at work, the more you earn the more you spend, and only when you look back do you see that the money all went into daily living and the home could not be built up.

Your income is not very stable, and it is hard to predict how much will come in next month. Whether you should be your own boss cannot be decided from this one star alone: usually people whose Power and Prosperity meet go into a career or become bosses, so you need to see in the Wealth palace whether Power and Prosperity meet (Wealth Keeper also counts as Prosperity). Opportunities mostly come from connections and visibility; invitations are plentiful but some are good and some are bad, so you must be selective. You spend generously, and the costs of treating guests, giving gifts and keeping up appearances are not small - this is where you lose the most money. In investing you lean toward quick profits, but you do not look closely enough at the risk. Money usually comes late and only truly thickens from middle age onward.

You do not need many friends, you need the right ones. You dislike chaotic places and also noisy, vulgar social gatherings; the people you are most comfortable with are those who act with moderation, speak courteously and work in an orderly way. Helpers and subordinates who are truly capable mostly gather around you only in old age, and lacking people in the early years is normal, so there is no need to doubt yourself because of it. Around you there are often people who ask you to sign, to act as guarantor, or to find connections.

You do not need many friends, you need the right ones. You dislike chaotic places and also noisy drinking parties; the people you are most comfortable with are women who speak politely, live in an orderly way and have a career of their own. People who truly suit you and can help mostly gather around you only in old age, and a thin circle in the early years is normal, so there is no need to force it to make up numbers. Friends around you often come to pour out their troubles, and over time you easily become their emotional outlet while you yourself run empty.

You do not have many friends, but they are all the kind you can confide in and entrust things to. The friends around you are mostly independent, decisive and direct, and meeting once a year does not hurt the bond. What you need to guard against is money: capable subordinates and friends who value loyalty can gradually turn things around, take over, and quietly cost you in the accounts. Around you there are often people who ask you to act as guarantor, to stand up for them, or to smooth things over, and after you agree, the one who ends up dragged in is you.

Your friends range from bosses to ordinary colleagues. They range from artists to merchants as well, and this is your most precious ability: the people you know can be turned into opportunities, information and resources. The trouble is also here: there are especially many people who drink and have fun with you, but few who can step up at the critical moment. Be careful in choosing people too: the one who looks the most impressive and the most capable is instead likely to bring you trouble at an important point.

Your circle of friends is not large but it runs deep. The old books say that Great Gate in this palace brings “many grievances and rebellion”: the people around you carry a lot of resentment and like to talk back, and drifting apart after only a few words is normal.
Your circle of friends is mainly women. Male friends are few in number, but once you have bonded with them, the ties are all steady.

Your circle of friends leans toward the practical. Your friends mostly come together because of shared work and shared interests, and there is little of the kind of friendship where you pour out your heart. Your way of leading people is the same: subordinates who are capable, strong in execution and get things done without needing much said suit you best.

Your circle of friends has two layers. The outer ring is very wide, and you can chat a few words with anyone; the inner ring of true confidants has only two or three people. This is your nature, and there is no need to force yourself to befriend everyone. Take note of the kind of person who knows very well how to package themselves, who says “the two of us, who are we to each other” the moment they open their mouth, who plays the affection card loudly, but may not be reliable when it comes to work. Among men, you easily meet a kindred spirit with whom conversation is especially in tune, but talking too deeply easily crosses the boundary, and in the eyes of outsiders it is also easy to be misunderstood.

The atmosphere of your circle of friends is good. They are mostly sisters you can eat and play with, and gatherings are very comfortable. Your ability to call people together is not weak, and when something really comes up, the people you call do come. The problem is that you are surrounded by good people, and over time you lose your guard in judging people - you clearly feel that someone is draining you, yet the next time she asks, you still agree. Among male colleagues and male friends you are also especially well liked, but your good intentions are easily read by others as something else. When Taboo (obstruction) is at work, friends easily run into money disputes or misunderstandings of feeling.

The atmosphere of your circle of friends is very good. They are mostly people of mild temper who love to eat and play, and when they gather it is like a festival. You are actually quite good at gathering and leading people, and when you really take care of something, the people you call do come. The problem is that you are surrounded by people who flatter you, no one wants to spoil your mood, and you hardly ever hear the unpleasant but useful words. A good temper does not mean you do not need to size people up. When Taboo (obstruction) is at work, you are the easiest to take advantage of, with long-term freeloading and unpaid loans draining you the most.

Your circle of friends is steady and practical. The circle is not large, but old friends of twenty years, former colleagues and former neighbours are still there, and at the critical moment they are the group you can truly count on. Leading a group is the same: when you say one word, people follow and act, and the colleagues you are most comfortable with are subordinates who are both capable and steady.

Your circle of friends rises and falls greatly, with gatherings and partings that are never fixed. In youth people come and go, and your circle changes quickly. The brightness of Army Breaker in this palace decides whether friends and subordinates are willing to put in effort to help you. The biggest pit is someone pulling you into a get-rich-quick venture, and falling in together.

Your circle of friends rises and falls greatly, with gatherings and partings that are never fixed. In youth people come and go, and your circle changes quickly. The brightness of Army Breaker in this palace decides whether friends and subordinates are willing to put in effort to help you. Among male friends and people who work alongside you, there are often true comrades.

In your circle of friends there are many people of higher standing and long experience. In lively places full of young people you actually do not stay long. The old books say Heavenly Beam in this palace means “many below, a flourishing master”, meaning there are many people around you, and they help you flourish even more.

In your circle of friends there are many elders and many people of long experience. In young, lively places you actually cannot stay long. This is not a bad thing: the helpers around you are mostly reliable, and when you are away there is someone to look after your business. The old books say Heavenly Beam in this palace means “many servants make the master flourish”, meaning there are many people around you, and they can help you flourish.

Your circle of friends values quality over quantity. You dislike shallow social ties and would rather have few but deep ones. In the early years friends and subordinates mostly cannot help you, there is actually no shortage of gossip and trouble, and they do not last long. The old books say Great Gate in this palace brings “many grievances and rebellion”: the people around you carry a lot of resentment and like to talk back.

Your friends are mostly women who are steady like you. The circle is not large, but each one is reliable. This is a great blessing for you: a close girlfriend of twenty years is still at your side, and your relationships are not like those of some people who reshuffle the deck every few years. When the critical moment comes they can truly be counted on, which is the most precious part of your relationships.

Your friends mostly come to you because of shared work and cooperation. The relationships can last a long time, but there is not much friendship where you pour out your heart. You find leading people easy as well: subordinates who are capable, say little and get the job done suit you best.

You have very few friends, but each one is deep enough. The friends around you are mostly independent, decisive women, and meeting once a year does not hurt the bond; you can talk to each other without ceremony. What you need to guard against is money: capable subordinates and friends who value loyalty can gradually turn things around, take over, and quietly cost you in the accounts.

Your ability lies behind the scenes. Being a core pillar within a large platform suits you better than standing at the very front to lead. Administration, legal affairs, finance, personnel, clerical work, and running a large enterprise - positions that follow rules and manage procedures - are what come most naturally. You are the most trusted female employee in the office: important matters, confidential matters and matters needing meticulous care are all handed to you with confidence by your superiors. But this is also a trap: you are easily treated as a useful assistant rather than a successor, your credit is taken by others, and your income is stable but grows slowly.

Your ability lies behind the scenes. Being a core pillar within a large platform suits you better than standing at the very front to lead. Administration, legal affairs, financial accounting, personnel, secretarial work, and running a large enterprise - positions that follow rules and manage procedures - are what come most naturally, and the more complete the system, the higher your efficiency. You work in a way that puts people at ease, but you do not actively compete for resources and promotion, your credit is easily taken by others, and being too honest also makes you easy to take for granted. Your income is stable, but grows slowly.

Your parents are mostly firm and practical. Your father is often a tough man from a technical background, running a business or serving in the army or police, with a rather strict upbringing and few warm words, but materially he will not let you go short. Your affinity with elders is thin in the early years, either leaving home very early or seeing little of them and living far away. Your relationship with your mother is the most complicated: if she is also strong, you two begin to clash from adolescence and may clash right into middle age; if she is gentle, you easily find her too soft and are disappointed.

Your parents are mostly firm people who do practical work. Among them, those in engineering, management, the army or police, or from a technical background are the majority; their upbringing is rather strict, they say little about feelings, but materially they will not let you go short. Your affinity with elders is thin in the early years, either leaving home very early or seeing little of them and living far away. With your father it is especially easy to become two hard people butting heads, neither willing to soften first with a single word, and in later years it becomes respect without closeness.

Your parents are mostly people who keep to the rules and are well brought up. Your family may once have had a civil servant, teacher or someone in a professional position, and you grew up from childhood in a tidy, proper environment. Your affinity with your parents is not thin; you get along harmoniously, with little separation or major quarrelling. This family background gave you not only conditions, but also a sense of proportion in how you act; the steadiness in you comes largely from them.

Your parents mostly keep to the rules and are well brought up. Your family may once have had a civil servant, teacher or someone in a professional position, and you grew up from childhood in a tidy, proper environment. Your affinity with your parents is not thin; you get along harmoniously, with little separation or major quarrelling. After marriage, you very easily become the model daughter-in-law in your in-laws' mouths - steady, proper, willing to cooperate, praised by everyone. But this praise has a price: praised again and again, the household chores become yours by default.

Your Health palace holds Harmony. The Complete Book says only “entering the temple means few misfortunes” about Harmony in the Health palace; the remaining lines are branches belonging to the stars sharing the palace, and do not assign Harmony to any particular organ. If your life has been too comfortable for a long time and lacks exercise, you will grow more and more reluctant to move, which you should watch for yourself.

Your Health palace holds Treasury. There are two views here, which should be read side by side: the Complete Book says of Treasury in the Health palace “few misfortunes, and where misfortune comes there is rescue”, holding that this star is auspicious and can restrain Ram Blade and Hindrance; another reading holds that Treasury cannot resolve disasters and illness, and is auspicious on the surface while hiding ill fortune within. This app follows the latter reading: seeing Treasury is not yet a reason to feel at ease; you still need to look at whether Ram Blade, Hindrance or other malefic stars share the palace, and which Decade you are entering.

Your Health palace holds Strategist. The Complete Book says of Strategist in the Health palace, first of all, “many misfortunes while still in swaddling clothes”, meaning many illnesses and mishaps in childhood. Thinking too much easily leads to poor sleep and a tired spirit, which you should be clear about yourself.

Your Health palace holds Heavenly Beam. Heavenly Beam is a star of shelter, and the Complete Book places it in the Health palace under “discussing abundance”, treating it as a good position, but your health still depends on upkeep, and regular check-ups cannot be skipped once you are older.

Your Health palace holds Minister. The Complete Book says of Minister in the Health palace “few misfortunes, a yellow face with swelling, ailments of blood and qi”, meaning there are not many illnesses and mishaps; what to watch for is a sallow complexion, swelling, and ailments of blood and qi.

Your Health palace holds Sun. The Complete Book says of Sun in the Health palace, first of all, “head wind”, meaning ailments of the head. Use of your eyes also needs to be kept in mind, with an eye examination once a year.
Your Health palace holds Moon. The Complete Book says of Moon in the Health palace that it is discussed separately according to whether it is bright or not.

Your Health palace holds Great Gate. The Complete Book says of Great Gate in the Health palace “pus and blood misfortunes in youth”, meaning that in childhood there were ailments with suppuration and bleeding.

Your Health palace holds Integrity. The Complete Book says of Integrity in the Health palace “misfortune in swaddling clothes, sores and ulcers, ailments of the back and legs”, meaning many misfortunes in childhood, boils, and a back and legs prone to illness. Pay attention to safety when travelling and avoid high-risk activities.

Your Health palace holds Martial. The Complete Book says of Martial in the Health palace “misfortune and hardship in swaddling clothes, injuries to hands, feet, head and face”, meaning many misfortunes in childhood, and hands, feet, head and face prone to injury. So keep safety in mind when travelling and working, and avoid dangerous activities.

Your Health palace holds Emperor. The Complete Book says of Emperor in the Health palace, first of all, one phrase: “few misfortunes”. But the Health palace is for reference only, and you cannot treat it as if nothing is there just because it is Emperor.

Your Health palace holds Greedy Wolf. Greedy Wolf is the star of peach blossom and desire; without moderation in drink and indulgence the body is harmed, so know temperance and keep a regular routine.

Your weak point is not a lack of opinions. Once you have decided something, others find it hard to lead you astray; the weak point is that you do not like to speak up first, and when you must decide for yourself you are used to asking around, and after asking so much even your own judgment is lost. A suggestion: next time you decide, write your own answer down first, and only then go and listen to what others think. There is nothing shameful in playing a supporting role, but you need to be sure it is a position you chose yourself, not because you never gave yourself the chance to step onto the stage.

Your energy and spirit come from outside. When you are recognised and needed, you are full of energy; alone with free time, you easily feel empty and begin to doubt whether you are still needed. When you are busy with plenty of comings and goings, your fortune and spirit both flourish; when you truly have free time, the string in your heart actually grows tighter. When Sun is in the Fallen position (weak), you give a lot, the returns are slow, and you will be worn out.

Your spirit comes from being among many people. Only when people see you and need you do you have strength; alone with free time, your heart feels empty instead. This is not vanity but the way someone like you recharges: when you are busier and have more comings and goings, your fortune and spirit both flourish accordingly, and when you truly have free time, the string in your heart actually grows tighter. The hardest thing is a forced retreat - when your reputation runs into trouble and you have to keep out of sight, your state in that period will decline sharply.

Your state of mind is like a lone fighter. By day you wrestle with the world outside, and in the evening you need to be alone. You are not used to speaking from the heart with others - in front of friends you are the tough one, in front of your partner you are the independent woman, in front of family you are the pillar, and your truly soft side shows only when you are alone. When your heart is steady, you can be as busy as you like and adjust by yourself; when your heart has nothing to lean on, you easily push on until you collapse: clearly tired but unwilling to rest, clearly uncomfortable but unwilling to say so, clearly in need of help but not asking.

Your state of mind is like the moon, with its full and its waning. When it is good, your whole being feels full; when it dips, you withdraw inward and want to see no one. The quiet stretches of time with little disturbance are when you are liveliest; being alone, reading, writing and letting your mind wander are when your efficiency is highest.

Your state of mind is like the moon, with its full and its waning. A change of season or matters in your family can visibly sway you. The quiet stretches of time with little disturbance are when you are liveliest; reading alone, writing and daydreaming are when your efficiency is highest.

Your mind is like a machine that never switches off. Others see you lost in thought, while inside a dozen threads are actually running at once. People often say you “think a lot and have a quick mind”, a remark that is half praise and half sigh. You get started fast and can feel out a way in on anything, and the price is that you have not dug to the bottom of any of it. Your most comfortable position is beside the decision-maker offering ideas - adviser, consultant, technical gatekeeper - rather than carrying the flag yourself; when you really sit in the number one chair, finding this path good today and that one better tomorrow will wear you down first. In feelings it repeats in the same way, not from a lack of devotion but because your mind keeps recalculating. Middle age is your dividing line: either rein it in a little and choose one or two things to do in depth, or keep scattering, and in the end you only touch the edge of everything.

Your mind almost never stops. You are always thinking of overturning things and starting again, it is hard for your thoughts to be truly idle, and worrying draining your energy is normal. This restlessness is both your greatest gift and your greatest lesson. The pit you fall into most easily is “empty once demolished”: after overturning the old, you do not know what to build next, so you simply go and demolish the next thing, spinning in circles, and you grow more and more tired.

Your path lies in aesthetic sense and understanding of people. Real estate, culture and the arts, design, fashion and beauty, psychological counselling, education and finance - fields that need care and a sense of beauty - are where results come most easily. In a group you are the one who smooths the atmosphere: you can tell at a glance who is upset with whom; you also work meticulously, but in places that compare sales figures every day and clash head-on, you feel uncomfortable. The biggest hidden worry is that whenever your home life or feelings get tangled, your work output drops with it, which easily leaves your superiors with an impression of instability.

Your sense of steadiness comes from money. You can sleep only when there is a concrete figure in your account, and you panic when the figure hits bottom. You are someone who cannot sit still, you find work for yourself even when there is none, and fortunately the busyness mostly brings returns, and in later years you can actually settle. This practicality is not shallow; on the contrary it is the steadiest way to live: you will not fall apart because you cannot work out the meaning of life, but you will lose sleep when your account runs to zero.

Your body is very tightly tied to your thoughts. The more you think, the more unwell you feel. Your body is linked to your mood. When your mood flows smoothly you have strength; when your mood is suppressed, your body complains of tiredness on your behalf first. You have a rather sensitive constitution, and holding emotions down for a long time is your biggest hidden danger; sleep and state of mind are usually the first to have problems - tossing and turning unable to sleep, lacking spirit by day, mostly because the emotions have nowhere to go. Whenever your routine gets disrupted, you also recover more slowly than others.

Your body is very tightly tied to your emotions. When your mood flows smoothly you have strength; when your mood is suppressed, your body knows first. The period of preparing for a child, just after giving birth, and around menopause will bring swings more pronounced than usual, and these stages are especially important for you.
