Besides the civil service, fields that need brainpower and adaptability, such as planning, consulting, training and education, and technical research, also suit you; this person is good at strategising and devising plans from behind the scenes. The ancient books say that Strategist entering the Temple (a star in this position has great strength) gains authority and position, that Literary Arts shining in is better still, and that sharing a palace with Heavenly Beam makes a talent skilled in both letters and arms; Fallen (weak strength), it easily loses office and position, and can only start from the footing of a junior clerk, so it does not suit starting a business alone and does best on a large platform. At work you change often, and you need to turn each change into accumulation rather than starting over from scratch.

The key is to let your sensitivity flow rather than letting it build up inside. Journaling, drawing and long periods of deep reading are all outlets for you; if it really weighs heavily, find a counsellor you can talk with over the long term, not waiting for something big to happen before you go, but digging a fixed drainage channel for your emotions. From middle age on, meditation, yoga and the arts, these quiet pursuits, are especially helpful to you. Do not think about grinding yourself into someone numb; what you need is not to become dull but to build one more protective layer around your sensitivity.

Inside, you feel different from others and are too lazy to please anyone, with a very strong sense of independence. Army Breaker governs travel, leaving home, treating the four seas as home, going all over the world. You should also learn to cooperate with people, or you will fight alone all your life.

Going outside is your home ground. You often spend more days away than at home, and you dare to go farther than others your age. In a place where no one knows you, your drive becomes an advantage and you can open up a horizon of your own. Note that a woman struggling away from home is prone to loneliness, and with no one beside her to talk to, the longer she holds on the more tired she becomes; also, when driving away from home or running into conflict with others, take a little extra care.

Going outside is your home ground. You often spend more days away than at home, and leaving home, changing city, even changing country makes it even easier to get things done: in a place where no one knows you, you can rely on your ability to open up a new horizon. But away from home you are also prone to restless travel and entanglement in gossip and disputes: driving, conflicts with others and contract disputes are all things to take extra care with.

The way out lies in being “skilful,” not in being “big.” The “Bone Marrow Rhapsody of Dou Shu” says “Integrity in Rabbit or Rooster is surely a clerk,” meaning mostly doing errand work at the grassroots level; the “Bone Marrow Rhapsody,” discussing a woman's chart, says “Army Breaker and Integrity in Rabbit or Rooster: someone refined and skilful will surely have unusual talent,” meaning that someone with a fine mind and clever hands has outstanding craftsmanship. So you suit earning a living from specialised craft skills and hands-on positions, and a place where you only write documents will not hold you for long. As for Integrity and Army Breaker in the Rabbit or Rooster palace being taken as a sign of dying in water, that reading must be matched with the lines on the tip of your own nose, and without a face reading no such conclusion is drawn. The original line in the “Tai Wei Rhapsody,” “Army Breaker and the Dark Star in the same place, a tomb made in the water” (Army Breaker sharing a palace with the dark star, a grave in the water), refers to Army Breaker meeting Great Gate.
Going outside goes smoothly again and you easily meet benefactors; when meeting malefic stars, be careful when travelling far.
Going outside brings plenty of quarrels and gossip.
Going outside you easily meet benefactors who help you get things done; only when your strength is weak and you meet Heavenly Horse do you wander everywhere.

Going outside is your natural stage. You dare to go farther and to overturn your old life more than others your age. The price is also clear: travelling around outside, your heart is not at peace, which is hard to avoid. When things go well, you can build a name outside, and the farther you go the more you accomplish; but there are also periods of running back and forth without being able to use your strength, busy for nothing. Your nature leans toward solitude, and the loneliness of being alone far away will weigh more on you than on others.

Going outside is your natural stage. Only by stepping outside do you get things done, and you suit going far to build a career more than most people. The price is also very clear: travelling around outside, your heart is not at peace, which is hard to avoid. When things go well, you can make a name outside, and the more you go out the more you accomplish; but there are also periods of running back and forth without being able to use your strength, busy for nothing.
Going outside you have benefactors who support you, and you suit working as an assistant within a large organisation; do not fight alone.
Going outside you can take charge of a region by yourself and stand firm on your own ability.

Going outside, you will meet benefactors. When you leave the place where you live, the greater the pressure of social obligations at home, the more at ease you are elsewhere. Living elsewhere, abroad, or marrying someone from another region suits you better than staying in place; the script that makes you settle at home supporting a husband and raising children is one you mostly cannot play.
Going outside you have benefactors to help you, and everything goes smoothly wherever you go; sharing a palace with Integrity or Martial, you earn money in bustling places and do big business.
Going outside you have benefactors, while at home there is more gossip and dispute; you suit a lot of travelling.

Do not do everything for your child. Love is not taking everything on yourself but letting your child stand firm on their own: when they are small, let them pack their own school bag; when they are older, let them choose their field of study, decide for themselves and bear the consequences. Your empathy is too strong, and you easily take your child's feelings entirely onto yourself; carry that for long and both of you are tired: tell apart whether this is your child's matter or your own. When your child confides in you, listen a lot and judge little, and your child will always want to talk.

Do not train yourself into a blunt person. That is not maturity, it is chiselling the moon into stone; all you need is to leave a protective layer over your sensitivity. Concretely: tell apart which matters are yours and which are other people's; you can feel compassion for other people's emotions without having to carry them home. Schedule important tasks for when you are in good form, and on low days do only the few most essential things. In love there is no need to rush to settle; wait until your temperament is steadier before discussing marriage, and judge a partner by one thing only: whether that person can protect you.
With great strength there is an ancestral legacy; sharing the palace with Strategist, you become wealthy only in old age, and sharing it with Harmony, you step back first and only then advance.
With great strength, late marriage suits you, while marrying early tends to wear down the affection; your partner is capable and heavily set on building a career.
With great strength, the old books say two children. Heavenly Beam is a Yang star and stands for males, so when Heavenly Beam appears in the Children palace you have a son.

With Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void or Earth Robbery added, it cannot rise to prosperity; in this case holding your ground is better than attacking. Protect your legitimate income and do not take risky speculative bets.

With Taboo (obstruction), your parents' constitution is somewhat weak, or your feeling toward them is distant, and elders especially need your company; at work, your relationship with superiors also grows cooler. Change the sentence “they are still healthy” into “every year I arrange a health check-up”, which means do not rely on impressions, but check on schedule and follow the doctor's advice.
With Taboo, Fortune is damaged, emotions meet many setbacks, and things not going as you wish multiply in daily life; you should actively adjust your mindset and face it positively.
Taboo: With Taboo, Fortune is damaged, emotions meet many setbacks, and things not going as you wish multiply in daily life; you should actively adjust your mindset and face it positively.
With Power, you hold money in the proper way and have strong financial management ability; you suit being your own boss or a finance manager, which is a good pattern for starting a business.
With Power, desire turns into controlling strength, giving you strong influence in your own field, and social skill and craftsmanship become your core competitive edge.
Power: With Power, you hold money in the proper way and have strong financial management ability; you suit being your own boss or a finance manager, which is a good pattern for starting a business.
Power: With Power, desire turns into controlling strength, giving you strong influence in your own field, and social skill and craftsmanship become your core competitive edge.

With Prosperity (money coming in), your sources of money open wide, and both career and wealth fortune flourish; the core of Martial's career fits in a single idea: the more solid the work, the more money you make, meaning the more substantial the thing your hands produce, the more money follows, so avoid empty, talk-only positions.
With Prosperity (money coming in), your path of money and wealth is at its most prosperous.
With Prosperity, you gain both reputation and profit, and money comes from the public or from social affairs; this is the ideal pattern for Sun, with light and fortune advancing together.

With Prosperity, the wealth star turns to Prosperity and wealth fortune is extremely strong; this is one of the most powerful patterns for riches, suited to financial investment and running a business, and it carries the image of great wealth.
Prosperity: With Prosperity, you gain both reputation and profit, and money comes from the public or from social affairs; this is the ideal pattern for Sun, with light and fortune advancing together.

Prosperity: With Prosperity, the wealth star turns to Prosperity and wealth fortune is extremely strong; this is one of the most powerful patterns for riches, suited to financial investment and running a business, and it carries the image of great wealth.

With Fame (reputation), both official rank and reputation rise. However, when Heavenly Beam turns to Fame and also carries Prosperity, you can instead enter the world of finance and economics and become a senior manager in the financial sector, so there is no need to avoid it rigidly.
With Fame (reputation), your inner world is rich and your learning grows.
With Fame, learning and reputation are both complete, and you carry authority in your professional field; it is the sign of a pattern of success in scholarship or specialised technical work.
With Fame, craftsmanship and reputation are both valued, you make breakthroughs in literature, education or the arts, you are respected by others, and many noble helpers lift you up.
Fame: With Fame, learning and reputation are both complete, and you carry authority in your professional field; it is the sign of a pattern of success in scholarship or specialised technical work.
Fame: With Fame, craftsmanship and reputation are both valued, you make breakthroughs in literature, education or the arts, you are respected by others, and many noble helpers lift you up.

Volume 2, in its discussion of wives and concubines, says “Army Breaker harms both men and women, and partings and reunions mean separation in life”; sharing the palace with Integrity it is even “harming and also lacking harmony”, meaning that whether male or female, affection is hurt, you meet rarely, you easily drift apart for long periods, and daily life is not harmonious either. When the Spouse palace shows Integrity with Army Breaker (or Integrity with Greedy Wolf), then for the most part it is either separation in life or parting by death, with rare exceptions; with Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star or Bell Star as well, living far apart for long periods is even more likely. The Integrity entry in the wives-and-concubines section of the Complete Book says verbatim “Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star mean separation in life”, without saying whether they share the palace or shine from the trine palaces, and without distinguishing bright or dim (Temple or Fallen), so you need to look at which star it is together with them and how they meet. Your spouse has a strong personality, does not yield, and the relationship has many ups and downs.

Volume 2, in its discussion of the Career palace, says of Army Breaker “in Temple or Prosperous, a military post is glorious beyond others... sharing the palace with Integrity, you do not last as a literary man, and being a clerk is best”, meaning that when Army Breaker enters the Temple (great strength) a military post is the most splendid, while sharing the palace with Integrity does not suit a purely literary post, but you stand firm in practical roles, technical execution and clear discipline; the Bone Marrow Rhapsody also says “Integrity in Rabbit or Rooster is surely a clerk”, which likewise means this Life chart is mostly someone who works at the grassroots level. Your career has many changes, and professional skill and real craftsmanship in your hands are the capital you can rely on.

Volume 2, in its discussion of the Wealth palace, says of Army Breaker “in the Fallen palace, it breaks; the ancestral legacy does not gather”, meaning that when Army Breaker is Fallen, the family estate cannot be kept or accumulated; the Rabbit and Rooster palaces, where Integrity and Army Breaker share the palace, are exactly the positions where Army Breaker is Fallen (weak strength). You cannot rely on ancestral capital, and you must earn money again from scratch. The Army Breaker star itself leans toward spending, with money moving in and out in large swings, coming fast and going fast, so it is best to lock part of your income in advance into safe, fixed assets. Someone with Integrity and Army Breaker in the Wealth palace finds it hard to run a business alone.
Generous, loyal, rule-abiding and valuing good faith, you suit assisting others more than being the commander yourself.
You can manage both people and money, suiting general management.
Good with words, deep thinking and given to suspicion; learn to speak in a rounded way and cause less trouble through what you say.

The old books speak rather sternly about this palace: Volume 1 describes Seven Killings sitting in the Spouse palace as “a mandarin-duck quilt half cold”, meaning half the quilt is cold, sharing a bed with little warmth; Volume 2 says “Seven Killings brings early harm... or marrying late avoids the punishment”, which in plain words is usually: starting a family early easily hurts each other, while marrying a little later avoids it. The method the ancients offered is a single word, “late”: marry later, leave more time to grow in harmony, and the marriage in turn holds firm. This palace should also not be seen as fixed and dead: when the Spouse palace shows Integrity and Seven Killings, it is regarded as very good, and cannot be put on the same level as Integrity with Greedy Wolf or Integrity with Army Breaker, where affection breaks down completely.

The old books speak rather sternly about this palace: “Greedy Wolf at first has trouble attracting subordinates, and in the Fallen position has none at all”, meaning that in the early years it is very hard to take in capable subordinates, and when Greedy Wolf is Fallen (a star in this position with weak strength) you almost cannot attract any; Volume 1 also says “servants in Temple or Prosperous will surely be ruined by the servants themselves”, meaning that when Greedy Wolf is in Temple or Prosperous in this palace, the book judges that you will surely be dragged down by your own subordinates. Conversely, the person who looks the most capable can easily spoil things at the critical moment. In employing people, give small tasks first and big ones later, and widen their authority step by step.

The old books say of Heavenly Beam in the Health palace “abundant and ample”; to know which internal organs need attention, look at the earthly branch of the palace where malefic stars are most concentrated across the whole chart.

The old books state the condition very plainly: in the Temple (a star in this position with great strength) and meeting Left Assistant, Right Assistant, Literary Talent, Literary Arts, Heavenly Leader and Heavenly Halberd, you can sit in a high position and be enfeoffed as a marquis; with only Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star added, it stays at an ordinary level. Sharing the palace with Treasury brings both authority and fame and profit; with Minister added, you hold rank both inside and out, and are also upright and incorruptible; sharing the palace with Army Breaker, you must settle yourself amid bustle and busyness. Volume 1 also says that when Emperor falls in the three palaces of Career, Body (another key position on the chart) or Life, what it needs most is Left Assistant and Right Assistant guarding at its sides.

The old books have the saying “Greedy Wolf does not bring success to the young man”, and the original text is in the Martial entry of the Complete Book: “What is called Martial guarding the Life palace means no light fortune, and Greedy Wolf not flourishing in youth is just this”, speaking of someone with Martial in the Life palace that also meets Greedy Wolf, for whom youth is unfavourable; the Bone Marrow Rhapsody also says “Greedy Wolf and Martial in the Tomb, fortune flourishes at thirty”. Greedy Wolf alone in the Life palace does not directly apply the line “does not flourish when young”.

The old books' way of judging has three layers. One is age: your best partner is older than you, and sharing the palace with Heavenly Beam you should seek an older person all the more. Two is timing: the old books say “late marriage is auspicious”, meaning that marrying a little later is better, giving the two of you enough time to confirm each other. Three is the malefic stars: with Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star added, you are prone to living far apart for long periods, so take note early. Sharing the palace with Moon, your partner is beautiful and also helpful in practical matters. Look for a partner of steady temperament and strong ability to carry things out, to complement each other, which happens to make up for Strategist's tendency to change.

The old books' correct resolution is “marry late and grow old together”, meaning marry a little later, save up enough time for harmony before marriage, and you can in turn live to white hair together; starting a family too early invites friction. Sharing the palace with Treasury also means growing old together; sharing with Minister, your partner is younger than you; sharing with Army Breaker, affection suffers much harm, and the same holds with Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star added; sharing with Greedy Wolf and having benefic stars avoids this layer of harm. Volume 1 also says that when benefic stars shine on the Spouse palace you grow old together, on the condition that stars such as Army Breaker and Seven Killings are not stirring up trouble.

The old books on the Friends palace with Integrity: in the Temple (great strength) it is “one call, a hundred answer”, meaning that once you open your mouth many people respond, your subordinates are capable and friends are willing to step forward for you; Fallen (weak strength) is “servant betrays master”, saying subordinates will betray you and helpers come only in old age; sharing the palace with Greedy Wolf, subordinates are not capable, and sharing with Seven Killings, subordinates will betray you. Whichever star it shares the palace with, if Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star are added, the old books say “not prosperous, they will leave”, people come and still cannot be kept. Your social circle is mostly people with skills and rich feelings, with lively social dealings and many entanglements.

The old books on the Siblings palace with Integrity: in the Temple (great strength) about two people. When it meets Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery, the old books say “there is harm and no harmony”. By the number of people the old books list, siblings are not many. Among your siblings there are mostly people with skills or a distinct personality, and in cooperation one person can carry several sides, though you need to watch their emotional ups and downs.

The old books say of someone with Minister in the Life palace “speaks truthfully and does not act falsely”, meaning they speak realistically and do not put on a show; seeing someone in trouble they soften and want to help, seeing a wrongdoer they speak up to defend others. Besides generosity, there is also a ruler of right and wrong inside, so this is not the kind of good person with no views of their own. In career, you suit a supporting role: administration, legal affairs, secretary or assistant, and going step by step within a large organisation is the smoothest; being solid and trustworthy is your greatest strength. Throughout life you have many noble helpers, and you suit being a partner to a strong leader, achieving your own success in the process of assisting others.

The old books say the Children palace with Integrity is “one person”, about one child; there is also a judgment of two children, with the two views set side by side. Sharing the palace with Treasury, the old books say “rules three noble children”. Sharing the palace with Greedy Wolf, Army Breaker or Seven Killings and with Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added, the old books' original text is “none at all”. Children are few, but their quality is not poor.

The old books on the Parents palace with Integrity: “hard to be a parent”, meaning the bond with elders is thin by nature, and the old remedy was “bowing in addition”, that is, taking godparents or being adopted as a foster child to soften it; sharing the palace with Greedy Wolf or Army Breaker, obstacles come early; sharing with Seven Killings, there is solitude and you easily hurt each other; only sharing the palace with Treasury avoids this layer of obstacle, and with Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added, the bond with your parents is incomplete. This speaks of a thin or thick bond and meeting rarely, not a firm judgment of illness or disaster. In practice it mostly shows as much emotional drama between parents and children, and both sides need to leave some distance.

The old books on the Property palace with Integrity: “Integrity breaks the ancestors”, meaning the ancestral estate cannot be kept and a home mostly has to be acquired by yourself; sharing the palace with Seven Killings you also buy it yourself; sharing with Treasury you receive an estate already there; sharing with Minister it is “none before, some after”, meaning none at first and only later do you have it; sharing with Greedy Wolf, although there is an ancestral estate, it cannot be kept long. The general trend is that the ancestral estate is hard to keep and mostly you acquire it yourself.

The old books on the Fortune palace with Integrity: “alone on guard, fortune is born amid busyness”, meaning that when this star sits alone in this palace, fortune is earned from within busyness, and idleness brings no peace; sharing the palace with Minister is “has fortune and long life”, and sharing with Treasury is “peaceful joy without worry”, both speaking of a settled life with few troubles; sharing with Greedy Wolf, the Greedy Wolf entry in the Complete Book says “with Integrity, fortune is thin”; sharing with Army Breaker, you cannot be still and you toil in body and mind, and with Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star added, your whole life is hard work and only in old age does your heart settle.

The old books on the Fortune palace with Integrity: “alone on guard, fortune is born amid busyness”, meaning that when this star sits alone in this palace, fortune is earned from within busyness, and idleness brings no peace; sharing the palace with Minister is “has fortune and long life”, and sharing with Treasury is “peaceful joy without worry”, both speaking of a settled life with few troubles; sharing with Greedy Wolf, the Greedy Wolf entry in the Complete Book says “with Integrity, fortune is thin”; sharing with Army Breaker, you cannot be still and you toil in body and mind, and with Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star added, your whole life is hard work and only in old age does your heart settle. For a woman: when the Fortune palace has Integrity and Army Breaker sharing the palace, then however good the Spouse palace is, it is not worth discussing, for it is either separation in life or parting by death. For a woman: with Integrity and Army Breaker in Fortune, whether it is separation in life or parting by death depends on the brightness of Sun: if Sun is Prosperous, parting by death is more likely than separation in life, and if Sun is Fallen, it is separation in life.

The old books on the Wealth palace with Integrity: in the Tiger and Monkey palaces it is “wealth born amid bustle”, meaning money comes from busy, crowded places; Fallen (weak strength) is “hard first, easy later”, saying money is hard to earn at first and only later goes smoothly; sharing the palace with Greedy Wolf, money comes strongly and goes strongly; meeting Ram Blade or Fire Star, there is sudden money that comes fast and goes fast; sharing with Seven Killings, you also earn in bustling places; sharing with Minister it is “rich, with full storehouses”, meaning the foundation is complete and money is never short; meeting Great Loss, Earth Robbery or Heavenly Void, you often lose wealth through lawsuits, that is, matters where you must deal with the authorities. Your ways of earning mostly involve skill, connections and creativity, with many sources but also frequent changes.

The old books say the Travel palace with Integrity is “smooth abroad, close to noble helpers, few days at home”, meaning going out brings smoothness, you easily get close to noble helpers, you spend few days at home, and it is by nature a star that suits motion and not stillness; sharing the palace with Seven Killings, “wide wealth-gathering outside”, which says you can collect many sources of money abroad; sharing with Minister, “auspicious in motion”, which says you must move for things to go smoothly. But if Ram Blade and Hindrance are added and the trine palaces also show fierce malefic stars, the old books have a heavier line, “dying on a distant road”, meaning dying on the road in a foreign land. When Integrity shares the palace with Greedy Wolf and Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star are added, the Greedy Wolf entry in the old books says “Integrity sharing the palace with the four malefic stars, hardship abroad”, meaning nothing goes smoothly outside, and travel, money and social contacts all need more care. When the Travel palace has Integrity and Greedy Wolf sharing the palace, both Fallen, and the Life palace has no main star, this pattern is called Half-Void Broken Wing; by the Eight Characters method it is a form of Heavenly Net and Earthly Net, whose limit falls in middle age, with the phenomenon of dying young midway; this speaks of the owner of the chart himself. Middle age means about 30; some have it happen at 29, some at 30, 31 or 32, and this is only a rough principle, so you still need to re-check the palace itself, the opposite palace and the cycle currently running; if the corresponding event has already played out and this age range has passed, do not keep using the same set of stars to judge later years.

The old books on Moon in the Health palace distinguish bright from not bright; to know which internal organs need attention, look at the earthly branch of the palace where malefic stars are most concentrated across the whole chart.

The old books say Seven Killings in the Health palace brings many disasters in childhood and, as you grow, rules haemorrhoids; to know which internal organs need attention, look at the earthly branch of the palace where malefic stars are most concentrated across the whole chart.

The old books say Strategist in the Health palace brings many disasters in childhood; to know which internal organs need attention, look at the earthly branch of the palace where malefic stars are most concentrated across the whole chart.

The old books say Minister in the Health palace brings few disasters and rules a sallow, puffy face and illness of qi and blood; to know which internal organs need attention, look at the earthly branch of the palace where malefic stars are most concentrated across the whole chart.

The old books say of Sun “for a man it is the father star, for a woman it rules the husband”. For a woman: Volume 3 of the Complete Book says “Sun guarding the Life palace, if Fallen then ordinary”, and also says “in Rabbit, Dragon, Snake or Horse without malefic stars, it makes the husband prosper and benefits the sons”. For a woman: Sun stands for father, husband and sons; when within a Decade Sun meets the Taboo star, in those ten years you see no father above, no son below, and no husband in between, which is very harsh; judge only those ten years separately.

The old books say of Sun “for a man it is the father star, for a woman it rules the husband”. For a man: matters of the father are read from Sun in the Parents palace, and the Complete Book says “in the Parents palace, for a man alone it is the father star; if bright it is auspicious, if not bright it harms the father”.

The old books say Sun in the Health palace rules headaches from wind; to know which internal organs need attention, look at the earthly branch of the palace where malefic stars are most concentrated across the whole chart, and do not go by Sun belonging to Fire.
The old books say Moon in the Health palace, “in Temple or Prosperous, has no disasters”.

The old books say Moon in the Health palace, “in Temple or Prosperous, has no disasters”. For a woman: the old books further say that when Moon is Fallen, “for a woman it rules great injury and wasting”, so take special care about bodily injury.

The old books say Great Gate in the Health palace means “in youth, the calamity of pus and blood”; to know which internal organs need attention, look at the earthly branch of the palace with the most malefic stars across the whole chart.

The old books say Integrity in the Health palace rules disasters of boils in childhood and illness of the waist and legs; to know which internal organs need attention, look at the earthly branch of the palace where malefic stars are most concentrated across the whole chart.

The old books say it plainly: “Greedy Wolf in the Fallen palace retreats from the ancestors, with little house and land for a whole life; in Temple or Prosperous there is an ancestral estate but it is also lost, and later you acquire things yourself”, meaning that when Greedy Wolf is Fallen (a star in this position with weak strength) the ancestral estate cannot be kept and you have little house and land all your life, while in the Temple (great strength), although there is an ancestral estate it will scatter first, and from middle age onward you rely on acquiring things yourself; Volume 1 also says “in the Property palace it scatters the ancestral estate, rich first and poor after”, meaning the ancestors' estate will fail, rich first and poor after. Meeting Fire Star and Bell Star, the old books say “there is self-made building”, meaning you can acquire real estate yourself, but at the same time they remind “only fear fire burning the house”, meaning fear of fire in the home, so do not be careless about using fire and electricity or about fire prevention.

The old books say Martial in the Health palace means the hands, feet, head and face are easily injured; to know which internal organs need attention, look at the earthly branch of the palace where malefic stars are most concentrated across the whole chart.

The old books say Army Breaker in the Health palace brings sores and scabies in childhood and a thin, weak body; to know which internal organs need attention, look at the earthly branch of the palace where malefic stars are most concentrated across the whole chart.

The old books say Emperor in the Health palace brings few disasters; to know which internal organs need attention, look at the earthly branch of the palace where malefic stars are most concentrated across the whole chart.

The ancient rhapsodies have a pattern name “Great Gate in Rat or Horse is Jade Hidden in Stone”, and the Complete Book says “Body or Life in the Rat or Horse palace is the Jade Hidden in Stone pattern, and if it also meets Fame, Power and Prosperity, fortune is deep for a whole life”; the trine palaces must meet Fame, Power and Prosperity before it counts. When discussing the overall pattern, try to use pattern names such as Jade Hidden in Stone sparingly, and return to look at the stars themselves and the conditions.
Your partner has a distinct personality, the marriage easily has ups and downs, and marrying a little later is steadier.
Your partner is practical, good at managing a home and kind to people, but suits marrying late.
Your partner is practical and dependable, keeps the rules, and the marriage stands firm on mutual trust.
Your partner is generous and gentle, with a good appearance as well, and the two of you mostly live in peace until old age.
Your partner is good with words and suits marrying late; look for someone older than you.

Your partner is mostly someone with some standing or presence in society, the kind of partner who inspires trust and can hold up the bigger picture. Intimacy carries a measure of formality, passion is not the main thread, and mostly it is an understanding of the kind “being together gives both of us face”, meaning that when the two of you stand side by side both shine; affection is stable, but the intimate side must be cultivated actively, or it easily becomes only a form.

Your partner is mostly good at managing money and a household, and may also hold a certain position in their career or have the ability to lead a team. The two of you live together in the manner of “respecting each other like guests”, meaning courteous and mutually respectful, both putting the stability of the family first. Both of you need face, and the occasional quarrel is mostly about who gets to decide. If Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, or Earth Void and Earth Robbery appear, the book says “marry late and avoid the punishment”, meaning that if you push the wedding date later you suffer less harm, while marrying early invites harm. The original text of the wives-and-concubines section of the Complete Book: of Emperor, “with Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star added, also punishment”, and of Treasury, “seeing Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Void and Robbery, marry late to avoid the punishment”; the original does not say whether they share the palace or shine from the trine palaces, nor does it distinguish bright or dim (Temple or Fallen), so you need to look at which star it is together with them and how they meet.

Your partner is mostly skilled and attractive, passionate feeling also easily brings storms, and both of you need to be tolerant. One more distinction to make clear: the Spouse palace showing Integrity with Seven Killings is regarded as very good, meaning this combination is not bad and must not be confused with Integrity with Army Breaker or Integrity with Greedy Wolf, which two combinations are usually judged as either separation in life or parting by death.
Your partner is talented in many ways and has affinity with people; living together calls for a lot of tolerance.
A partner older than you suits you better, marrying late goes smoothly, and the person is also upright.
Your partner is open yet refined, and you can stay together until old age; meeting malefic stars, you easily end up living separately.
Your partner is forceful and decisive, the marriage easily falls into a tug of war, and marrying late is steadier.
Your partner is strong and capable but somewhat cold and hard in temperament; marrying late suits you, so look for a gentle person.
Your partner is upright with views of their own, and marrying a little later goes more smoothly; the Spouse palace with Integrity and Seven Killings is regarded as very good.

Your partner has a forceful, decisive, practical character, values action, is not given to sweet words, and mostly shows affection through concrete deeds; in managing money or career they are usually quite capable. Sharing the palace with benefic stars, you gain money through your partner and the family estate rises accordingly; meeting malefic stars clashing in, conversely you lose wealth because of your partner. This marriage does not lack strength, what it lacks is warmth, and one side needs to take the initiative to soften.
Your partner is upright and shoulders responsibility; marrying late goes more smoothly, and a partner older than you is better.
Your partner has a strong presence and a hard temperament; marrying late can in turn bring growing old together, while meeting malefic stars means affection suffers much harm.
Your partner is gentle and attentive, and the marriage is harmonious; marrying late makes growing old together even more likely, while meeting malefic stars easily brings discord.
Your partner is intelligent and best older than you; marrying late is better, and if you meet malefic stars, guard against living far apart for long periods.

Only with Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added is it “not harmonious”, meaning the two of you do not get along, and affection is easily worn down. In the way you live together, you are used to taking care of others yet actually also need care, so it easily forms a pattern of one acting like an elder and the other like a child, and you need to pay attention to pulling the relationship back to equal footing. The saying about marrying late comes from later transmission and is not made clear in the Heavenly Beam entry of the book, so treat it only as a reference, not a definitive conclusion.

Make warming, nourishing food the mainstay of your diet. Go easy on very cold or cooling foods and eat at regular times. For exercise choose something gentle with a rhythm: yoga, tai chi and swimming all suit you, and when you break a light sweat your emotions ease off as well. Do not skimp on an annual check-up; any extra items to examine should follow the earthly branch of the palace where malefic stars are most concentrated across your whole chart, and your doctor's advice. If you feel unwell, go and be examined early and follow the doctor's advice, and do not look up symptoms online and frighten yourself. The most important thing: arrange for your emotions to flow freely, and everything else becomes easy.

Eat at regular times and stop at about seven-tenths full. Go light on oil and alcohol; for exercise choose walking, tai chi or moderate-intensity aerobics, which is enough. Have a general check-up once a year, more often after 40; for a woman, a routine examination once a year, and which items exactly to examine you should leave to the doctor to arrange. During pregnancy and childbirth never push on by your own decision, and do as the doctor says; if anything feels wrong in your body, go and be examined early.

Eat at regular times and stop at about seven-tenths full. Go light on oil and alcohol, and do not alternate feasting and fasting. For exercise choose walking, tai chi or moderate-intensity aerobics, which is enough, and do not follow overly fierce competitive sports. Have a general check-up once a year, more often after 40; if anything feels wrong in your body, go and be examined early and follow the doctor's advice, and do not grit your teeth and carry it alone and then search at random online. One more thing, the most important: find a person you can talk with, and say out the things you are holding down inside; when your emotions are in order, your sleep and spirit follow into order.

In working together, the skills of both sides can complement each other and you often think up many new tricks, but desire and the splitting of money can also breed conflict, so state clearly from the start how things are divided: desire can be satisfied together, but the accounts must be reckoned clearly.
With Harmony and Moon sitting in the Wealth palace, money depends on your own accumulation and comes late.

Reputation is the most valuable professional asset you have. Opportunities find you only when many people know you, and your income rises with it. What suits you are fields where you must stand before people: politics, public administration, media, public relations, teaching and public speaking, brand marketing; soldier, police officer, judge and diplomat can also work, civil or military both being fine, and the only fear is being pressed down in the background where no one sees you. You know how to lead a team and how to speak, and can describe a matter so that people want to follow you in doing it; your weak point is detail and execution behind the scenes. Those who help you are usually weighty elders, and mostly they step in only at the critical moment.

Someone with Great Gate in the Life palace thinks deeply about things, likes research, and is fairly heavy on suspicion; as for which side is heavier regarding gossip and quarrels, it is divided only between the two ends of Temple or Prosperous and Fallen, and your Great Gate lies between the two ends, so there is no clear judgment. The book describes Great Gate as “suspicious, studies much but refines little, gets along poorly with people, with much right and much wrong”, meaning prone to doubt, learning widely but hard to refine, not fitting well with people, and with many disputes; this passage is the most important self-reminder about Great Gate's character.

Someone with Greedy Wolf in the Life palace has strong desires, many skills, loves enjoyment and has extremely strong social ability; only Greedy Wolf in the two palaces of Pig and Rat counts as the orthodox peach blossom star, and your Greedy Wolf is not in Pig or Rat, so you cannot see Greedy Wolf and judge heavy peach blossom. The root of the character actually leans hard: rather ruthless, stubborn and obstinate, easily acting on feeling and heedless of everything, meaning you work with enough stubbornness, you are fixed in your ways, and once impulse rises you do not count the consequences; the old books also say “firm and fierce in nature, deep in scheming and far in planning, following the waves as they roll, whom to love or hate is hard to fix”, meaning a firm temperament with plenty of presence, deep-hearted and far-sighted, rising and sinking with circumstances, and what you like or dislike changes as you please. You are not a gentle, easygoing person, only one who hides the sharp edge behind a layer of warmth.

Someone with Strategist in the Life palace has wide interests, knows a little of everything but not enough in any one, and in youth easily keeps changing direction; by middle age they gradually pull in and focus on one or two fields to make great achievements. In love they are also changeable, not very single-minded, with both reason and feeling at once; the old books say a person with this life pattern often worships the Buddha and suits a quiet environment for self-cultivation, so they have an innate interest in philosophy, religion and fate studies, and a rich inner world.

Someone with Strategist in the Life palace reacts fast and has many ideas, but easily thinks too much, sometimes gets stuck in a dead end, is strongly curious, and lacks patience. The old books sum it up in four words, “hasty in nature, kind at heart”, meaning quick-tempered but soft-hearted; this person is good at analysing and devising plans, but rarely sees things through to the end, and the ideal arrangement is to have a partner at their side with strong ability to carry things out.

A person with Emperor in the Life palace is written up in the old books as loyal, generous and mature, modest and upright, honest in appearance, with a broad bearing; with Emperor in the Life palace and no Left Assistant or Right Assistant around, the person is generous but solitary by nature and does not like to mix with people. Beneath the steady exterior, the decisions are made by themselves: once made up their mind, it is very hard to change it, and they will not let others manage them.

Sharing the palace with Seven Killings, the Seven Killings entry in the Complete Book says “with Integrity, diligent and hard-working”; Integrity with Seven Killings in the Fortune palace is a special case, and the shape of the face has to be looked at as well, a layer that cannot be seen on the chart. The spiritual life is fairly rich, interests are wide, and you love food, art and the beauty of the senses, and can find satisfaction through experience.
The bond with your children is faint, and children leave the nest early.
The bond with your parents is faint, and you become independent early; with parents and superiors, do not confront them head-on.

To know which internal organs need attention, do not go by the elements of the stars, and do not look at the Health palace alone: the palace across the whole chart where malefic stars are most concentrated, the weakest, you take the earthly branch of that palace and match it to an organ (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidneys, Dog pericardium, Pig triple burner), and if two palaces are both weak, look at both places. Harmony belongs to Water, but judging the kidneys and urinary tract that way is not how this is done. The Health palace is for reference only, and you must read it together with the Life palace and the Decade you are currently in. It is best to build a habit of regular exercise, have regular check-ups, and follow the doctor's advice.

After the age of forty-five, take the initiative to arrange a full health check-up for your mother. Do not wait for her to say she is unwell. With your parents-in-law, lower your expectations: proper etiquette and courteous, thorough politeness are enough, and the deep mother-and-child bond is kept for your own mother, so there is no need to press your mother-in-law to treat you that way. As for old debts between you and your mother, choose a calm moment, lay them out and say them once; saying them hurts less than holding them in. When your mother is older, being with her and talking with her more is more useful than buying things.

In the middle of a crowd you do not need to show off on purpose; just sitting there, people look your way. What makes people admire you most is that in the midst of chaos you can see the main thread at once, and when a noisy meeting is a tangled mess, the moment you speak it goes quiet. But this natural instinct to sit in the upper seat is also your greatest hurdle: your stubbornness is not that you do not listen to what others say, but that having listened you still do as you see fit; when you are denied, even if the words are polite, they ferment on in your heart. There is always a layer between you and other people; friends respect you and follow you, but it is very hard for them to get close to you. When pressure comes you refuse to show weakness, and holding on for long, your sleep and your stomach and intestines go wrong first.
Elsewhere it is easier to build a name; you suit going away and do not suit staying at home.

Away from home you suit the paths of service, the arts, food and drink, and entertainment, and you also suit partnering with people; good affinity is the most readily usable capital you have abroad. With Taboo (obstruction), going out meets many setbacks, so choose a familiar environment and do not force yourself to charge ahead.
Running about outside is hard work, but money comes from bustling places; Peach Blossom and Heavenly Talent are both strong, so watch out for trouble from drink and sex.
You stand firm in bustling places, value beauty, and stand out in a crowd.
You stand firm in bustling places; when the star is strong, taking positions of real power such as the military or police is the most brilliant, with fame greater than real profit.
Outgoing and warm, generous with people, you value reputation more than practical benefit.
Outwardly calm and rule-abiding, a little stiff in temperament and fond of contending, you are the assistant type and suit being a deputy.
Mostly you leave home and become independent, earning a living by one trade, seeking success in risk your whole life.
Harmony + Right Assistant means subordinates support you and the clan holds together: you do not need to be forceful for everyone to gather around you.
Harmony + Earth Robbery means fortune is robbed: a gentle person is easily taken advantage of by those around.
Harmony + Earth Void means fortune is emptied out: a Life chart that should enjoy blessings is cut off by an unexpected event.
Harmony + Heavenly Halberd means female noble helpers cherish you: mother, elder sisters and female superiors are all sources of fortune for you.
Harmony + Heavenly Leader means a gentle life pattern loved by elders: throughout life there are always male elders who love and protect you.

Harmony + Left Assistant means affinity with people and the group are both good: you are gentle by nature, and with Left Assistant added it is even easier to gather people and resources. You suit fields leaning toward service and relationships.
Harmony + Ram Blade means a gentle life pattern is clashed: your good nature may be bullied by others.
Harmony + Literary Talent means gentle with learning: you suit gentle, intelligent professions such as scholar, psychological counsellor, art therapist and children's educator.
Harmony + Literary Arts means skill and gentleness exist together: artistic work such as music, dance, writing and painting comes most naturally.
Harmony + Fire Star stirs up Harmony's laziness: it makes you more proactive than usual, but you must guard against excess fire harming the body.
Harmony + Bell Star means a gentle life pattern is agitated: insomnia, skin problems and allergies may worsen.
Harmony + Hindrance means the innate habit of delay grows even heavier: whatever the decision, you drag it out for a year if you can.

When Harmony transforms to Taboo in the Health palace or its trine palaces, the habit of loving ease and avoiding exercise is magnified, and problems with weight and blood sugar appear first. Build a habit of regular exercise and keep a close watch on these two items in your annual check-up; to know which internal organs need attention, look at the earthly branch of the palace where malefic stars are most concentrated across the whole chart.

Harmony transforming to Taboo in the Life palace damages Fortune, and the sense of life going smoothly drops markedly: you are by nature someone who should “sit and enjoy heaven-sent fortune”, but because of Taboo you cannot enjoy the blessings you deserve, emotions meet many setbacks, things not going as you wish multiply in daily life, and the feeling of happiness is reduced. You should actively adjust your mindset and use positive drive to make up for fortune that is not enough, and also pay special attention to the health of your kidneys and urinary system.

Harmony transforming to Taboo affects emotions, the fortune of the marriage is damaged, emotions meet many setbacks, discord easily appears in daily life, and the sense of happiness on both sides drops. You need to actively bring freshness into the relationship and regularly create beautiful experiences together.

Harmony transforming to Taboo: a fortune star, gentle and pleasure-loving, ruling blessing and prosperity, suited to service and the arts and to partnering with people; guarding the Life palace and falling in an idle palace and meeting Fire Star and Bell Star, it is instead fierce.

Harmony and Great Gate both sit in the Life palace, a fortune star meeting a dark star (which rules quarrels and gossip). The book says Harmony is not strong in the Ox and Goat palaces and its fortune is reduced; Great Gate is by nature leaning dark and easily brings gossip, so a whole life is never short of verbal disputes. A person with this life pattern looks gentle outwardly and easy to approach, yet has many doubts inside, often goes over the same ground again and again in work, and in dealing with people mostly starts very well and later develops snags.
The hidden danger of Harmony in the Spouse palace is being too smooth: over the long term, plainness easily lets affection gradually cool, and someone needs to take the initiative to nurture it.

The hidden danger of Harmony in the Spouse palace is being too smooth: over the long term, plainness easily lets affection gradually cool, and someone needs to take the initiative to nurture it. With Taboo (obstruction), emotions meet many setbacks, so take the initiative to talk and add a little freshness.
Harmony in the Career palace: you get things done through affinity with people.

Harmony in the Health palace: the old books say only that in the Temple there are few disasters; to know which internal organs need attention, look at the earthly branch of the palace where malefic stars are most concentrated across the whole chart.

Harmony and Heavenly Beam both sit in the Life palace, one fortune star paired with one shelter star, where a shelter star means being protected and cared for. The Treatise on Fortune and Longevity in the Complete Book says “for people of the South, Harmony and Heavenly Beam in the Life palace, in Temple or Prosperous, rule both fortune and longevity”, meaning that for a Southerner with such a Life chart, when both stars enter the Temple (great strength), both fortune and lifespan are good. A person with this life pattern is kind and generous by nature, gentle and non-contending, and in trouble often has elders or noble helpers looking after them, so in setbacks they can mostly pass through safely.

Harmony and Heavenly Beam sharing the palace appears only in the Tiger and Monkey palaces, where the trine and opposite palaces gather Strategist and Moon, just as the Bone Marrow Rhapsody says, “Strategist, Moon, Harmony and Heavenly Beam make a clerk”, meaning this combination suits a civil servant. This combination mostly works in a government office or school, taking a fixed salary, which is a very good pattern in itself but a little soft in temperament; unless Fame, Power and Prosperity gather in, there is no question of going into business, and it is not limited to drawing a salary. In career, paths such as medicine, education, the civil service and social service, work that relies on accumulated time, suit you best. Living at ease for long, your drive to advance easily fades.
Harmony and Heavenly Beam in the Life palace: kind and generous with noble helpers, suited to the civil service and schools; do not take risks.

Harmony and Heavenly Beam in the Spouse palace: your spouse is kind and upright and treats people gently, and Volume 2 calls this combination “an extremely beautiful couple”, meaning a very well-matched pair. However, the Complete Book says of Harmony in the Spouse palace “marry late and live in harmony to old age; the husband should be older and the wife younger”, that is, marry late, with the husband a little older being the better fit; but an age gap is not an answer that applies to everyone, and you must first look at the marriage pattern you were born with; if you meet Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery, the harmony it originally has turns into incompatibility, even living apart for long periods. The original text of the wives-and-concubines section of the Complete Book: the Harmony entry, on seeing the “four malefic stars”, says “lacking harmony, separation in life”, and the Heavenly Beam entry, “with Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Void and Robbery added, not harmonious”; the original does not say whether they share the palace or shine from the trine palaces, nor does it distinguish bright or dim (Temple or Fallen), so you need to look at which star it is together with them and how they meet.

Harmony and Heavenly Beam in the Career palace: the core of the career is helping others. Doctor, teacher, social worker, religious worker and public-interest organisation are the most fitting lines. A person with this life pattern gains a sense of achievement in the process of helping others, but does not suit head-on confrontation in the marketplace.

Harmony and Heavenly Beam in the Wealth palace: Volume 2 says of Harmony “makes wealth from empty hands, flourishing late”, and sharing the palace with Heavenly Beam it is “great wealth”, “making wealth from empty hands, surpassing the ancestors”, meaning you do not rely on a family estate left behind but accumulate entirely by yourself, your wealth can flourish and exceed the previous generation, but you see it rise only from middle age onward; Heavenly Beam in the Tiger palace enters the Temple and is well supplied, while in the Monkey palace it is Fallen and life is hard. In managing money, seek steadiness and stay away from speculation.

Harmony and Moon both sit in the Life palace. Harmony here is not called a fortune star but a star of human harmony, meaning good affinity and getting along; Moon is a star of the civil-official system, standing for money from legitimate sources, with income mostly steady. A person with this life pattern is gentle and refined; the book says that with Harmony in the Temple (the Temple = great strength) the person is kind and upright, and with Moon in the Temple, gentle and courteous, willing to be humble.

Harmony and Moon sit together only in the Rat and Horse palaces, where the trine and opposite palaces (the palaces shining in from the other palaces) gather Strategist and Heavenly Beam. One way of judging holds that Strategist, Moon, Harmony and Heavenly Beam surely mean someone working in a government office or school on a fixed salary, unless Fame, Power and Prosperity gather in, in which case business is possible, and this judgment is not limited by palace position; the Complete Book, Volume 3, annotates the line “Strategist, Moon, Harmony and Heavenly Beam make a clerk” with “if the Life palace is in the Tiger or Monkey direction then count it, and if there are benefic stars then do not count it”, so by the book the Rat and Horse palaces do not apply this pattern. The two views are set side by side. Moon in the Rat palace is in the Temple, and the person is fine-featured and fair-skinned; in the Horse palace it is Fallen (weak strength) and this point is reduced. For a woman: the Complete Book says “if Harmony shares the palace with Moon, a woman meeting it is loose and skilled in appearance; although clothing and income are ample, in the end she is not beautiful, being a concubine or maid who has secret affairs with others”.

Harmony and Moon sit together only in the Rat and Horse palaces, where the trine and opposite palaces (the palaces shining in from the other palaces) gather Strategist and Heavenly Beam. One way of judging holds that Strategist, Moon, Harmony and Heavenly Beam surely mean someone working in a government office or school on a fixed salary, unless Fame, Power and Prosperity gather in, in which case business is possible, and this judgment is not limited by palace position; the Complete Book, Volume 3, annotates the line “Strategist, Moon, Harmony and Heavenly Beam make a clerk” with “if the Life palace is in the Tiger or Monkey direction then count it, and if there are benefic stars then do not count it”, so by the book the Rat and Horse palaces do not apply this pattern. The two views are set side by side. Moon in the Rat palace is in the Temple, and the person is fine-featured and fair-skinned; in the Horse palace it is Fallen (weak strength) and this point is reduced. For a man: a somewhat soft temperament, valuing human feeling in work, and rarely decisive.
Harmony and Moon in the Life palace make a gentle person of refined mind, suited to a steady salary; do not take risks.

Harmony and Moon in the Spouse palace: your spouse is gentle and pleasant to look at. The book says of Harmony in this palace “marry late and live in harmony to old age”, that is, marrying late brings growing old together; Moon sharing the palace “helps a beautiful face”, meaning your spouse is even more beautiful. An older man and a younger woman suit better. If Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery gather in, harmony is reduced and you easily end up far apart for long periods. The original text of the wives-and-concubines section of the Complete Book: the Harmony entry, on seeing the “four malefic stars”, says “lacking harmony, separation in life”, and the Moon entry, “with Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Void, Robbery, Loss and Taboo added, if not harm then separation in life”; the original does not say whether they share the palace or shine from the trine palaces, nor does it distinguish bright or dim (Temple or Fallen), so you need to look at which star it is together with them and how they meet. When Moon transforms to Taboo, emotions easily meet many setbacks, and on whom it falls and at what age you must read further from the cycles. With Moon transforming to Taboo, or with Harmony and Moon together in the Horse palace (Moon not bright), the judgment is discord between mother-in-law and daughter-in-law: for a man's chart, his wife and his mother do not get along, and for a woman's chart, she herself does not get along with her mother-in-law.

Harmony and Moon in the Career palace, where the trine and opposite palaces (the palaces shining in from the other palaces) gather Strategist and Heavenly Beam, make exactly the Strategist, Moon, Harmony and Heavenly Beam pattern, that is, working in a government office or school on a fixed salary. Moon belongs to the civil-official system, income is mainly regular pay, and the civil-service clerical path suits you. In the Horse palace it is Fallen (weak strength) and it is not easy to rise. The temperament is a little soft; unless Fame, Power and Prosperity gather in, there is no question of going into business.

Harmony and Moon in the Wealth palace: Moon stands for money from legitimate sources, following the path of a fixed salary. The book says of Harmony in the Wealth palace “makes wealth from empty hands, flourishing late”, meaning you build a career from empty hands, relying on accumulating bit by bit yourself, and the time of flourishing also leans late. Moon in the Rat palace enters the Temple, so you are well supplied and keep money; in the Horse palace it is Fallen, so you earn and lose and cannot hold on to it. In spending, you value quality of life and are not the type to strive to gather money.

A person with Harmony guarding the Life palace is gentle, modest and generous in temperament, speaks plainly, and plays no schemes with people, so affinity with others is especially good. Harmony is the star of human harmony, meaning this star makes affinity good and suits partnership, and working together with others shows your strengths most clearly. The book says of Harmony “skilled in letters, with unusual ambition but not violent”, meaning writing and vision are both good, and there is a great ambition in the heart, only that the ambition is hidden inside and not shown outside, and the person does not like to contend with others over winning and losing.
Harmony guarding the Life palace: gentle in nature, liked by people, content and therefore blessed; the only fear is too much ease and a lack of drive.
Harmony and Great Gate sharing the palace: pleasant on the surface, with many worries inside, good with words but with much quarrelling and gossip.

Harmony and Great Gate in the Spouse palace: the two of you quarrel quite a lot. Harmony needs a somewhat later marriage to grow old together; Great Gate in this palace suits finding a partner older than you, or else you easily do not fit; with the two stars sharing the palace, there may also be a clever partner, living together for the long term. If the Spouse palace also has stars such as Heavenly Halberd, Literary Talent and Literary Arts, your partner is talented in many ways (an example for a man's chart). If Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery are added, you easily live far apart for long periods or remarry. The original text of the Great Gate entry in the Complete Book is “with Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Void and Robbery added, surely harms two wives or means separation in life”, without saying whether they share the palace or shine from the trine palaces. The Great Gate entry in the Complete Book says “should be older”, and the Harmony entry says “marry late and live in harmony to old age”; for a man's chart the two views coexist (the Harmony entry also says the wife should be younger); an age gap is not an answer that applies to everyone.

Harmony and Great Gate in the Career palace: the career goes from small to large, starting ordinary, mostly beginning with small matters and then accumulating gradually over time. Great Gate in the Ox and Goat palaces is not in the Temple and is weak, and at work you easily draw quarrels and gossip, so deal with each matter on its own terms and do not contend over a momentary win or loss.

Harmony and Great Gate in the Wealth palace: mostly you build a career from empty hands, with a hard start and comfort only in old age. Money comes in and goes out, ups and downs are hard to avoid, and seeking wealth in crowded, bustling places suits you. If your mind is set too high and you are eager to win, you easily lose wealth in a moment instead.

Harmony is the fourth star of the Southern Dipper and is regarded as the “star of human harmony”, meaning this star gives a person a special affinity with everyone and suits partnership; for anything that needs a group of people pulling together to succeed, Harmony suits best. The book ranks it among the fortune-ruling stars of the Southern Dipper, and it is also the main star of the Fortune palace, symbolising fortune, wealth, harmony and enjoyment. A person with Harmony in the Life palace is gentle and modest, kind and frank, with writing and learning both not poor, with ambition in the heart but no show; throughout life fortune is long-lasting and longevity is rather high; if it enters the Temple (strength) and meets benefic stars, the person is clever and good at everything, has no worry about food and clothing and also has reputation, and does not merely live a plain, bland life.

Harmony's greatest test is “too much ease”, meaning it does not like contending with people, takes whatever comes and is content, and easily spends day after day only enjoying itself and unwilling to advance. The book also reminds: if Harmony guarding the Life palace falls in an unimportant palace position and meets gathered malefic stars such as Fire Star and Bell Star, it turns into much hard work and many setbacks, and you cannot rest easy just thinking you “have fortune”.

Harmony's money is valued for being steady and lasting, accumulated through service and reputation, and not suited to gambling or speculation; too much ease also spoils things, and when an opportunity is worth acting on, you must still act.

Harmony's money is valued for being steady and lasting, accumulated through service and reputation, and not suited to gambling or speculation; too much ease also spoils things, and when an opportunity is worth acting on, you must still act. With Taboo (obstruction), the path of wealth is blocked and fortune is damaged, so make preservation the main thing and borrow little.

With Harmony Fallen, fortune is reduced, and the pursuit of enjoyment easily leads to falling back if you do not advance, so you need to deliberately overcome laziness and push yourself to a moderate degree.
Treasury + Right Assistant means loyal subordinates + a firm treasury: throughout life there are always a few key figures at your side who guard your sources of money.
Treasury + Earth Robbery means the treasury is robbed: you may have money swept away by a partner, loans to relatives and friends that are never repaid, and be cheated.
Treasury + Earth Void means the treasury sees emptiness: the old books say “Treasury meeting Void, the storehouse is empty”, the combination Treasury fears most.
Treasury + Heavenly Halberd means a female noble helper helps you keep money: it may be a female teacher who teaches you “wisdom about money”.
Treasury + Heavenly Leader means a male noble helper opens the path of wealth for you: one connection with the right person stepping in is enough to change your whole level of wealth.
Treasury + Left Assistant means a firm treasury + a supporting team: a classic pattern of steady wealth. It suits managing a family business, trust management and asset management.
Treasury + Ram Blade means the treasury is clashed: at least once in your life a large loss of wealth, mostly because of betrayal.
Treasury + Literary Talent means skilled at managing money + educated: it suits the trade of financial planner, private banker and investment adviser.
Treasury + Literary Arts means money management + eloquence: you can explain complex financial plans until clients are convinced.
Treasury + Fire Star means the treasury is burned by fire: a steady life pattern is broken by hasty impulsiveness, and you need to restrain the urge to speculate.

Treasury + Bell Star means the treasury has a hidden danger: on the surface the money is firm, but in reality there are hidden losses (an investment caught in a trap, receivables that cannot be collected).
Treasury + Hindrance means money fortune is slow: steady indeed, but half a beat slower than others.
Treasury in the Career palace: the Bone Marrow Rhapsody of the Dipper calls it “the spirit of clothing and income”.

A person with Treasury in the Life palace is calm in temperament, keeps the rules, values face, has a high need for security, likes to accumulate step by step in a stable environment, dislikes taking risks, and cannot bear constant change.

With Treasury in the Temple or Prosperous in the Spouse palace or its trine palaces, your spouse is calm and dependable, with strong financial ability, the foundation of the marriage is firm, and this is the kind of partner who puts people at ease.

Treasury in the Temple or Prosperous (the Ox, Goat, Snake and Pig palaces are even more auspicious) guarding the Wealth palace brings the Southern Dipper's own treasury position to its peak, exactly the image of “a family fortune of ten thousand strings, never declining through the generations”. What suits you best is a steady allocation of assets held for the long term: real estate in core locations, blue-chip stocks, family bonds, art collecting, getting richer the longer you hold.

With Treasury in the Temple or Prosperous, the ability to keep money is at its strongest and the treasury at its thickest, shown to best effect in government offices, banks or large enterprises, where a calm, conservative nature shines on a high foundation.
Treasury is the first star of the Southern Dipper and manages the treasury; gentle and upright in nature yet able to be flexible, it suits civil posts, teaching or large institutions.

Treasury is the first star of the Southern Dipper, and its transformed qi is “Command”, meaning it is like a manager issuing orders, managing the family estate and managing stability. The Complete Book says it rules wealth, houses and land, and clothing and food; the mnemonic says “Treasury is the storehouse of prosperity, and one with it in the Life palace is in the end rich”, meaning Treasury is a storehouse of money, and a person with it in the Life palace mostly does not lack money in the end. Meeting Literary Talent and Literary Arts, one easily takes first place in examinations and selection; meeting Wealth Keeper and Martial as well, the scale of gathering wealth is rather large. So Treasury is not only about keeping a family estate; meeting benefic stars, the scale of earning money is not small. Treasury is also regarded as a star of civil officials and of teaching, and many people with Treasury in the Life palace become civil servants or teachers, or even both.
Treasury is the treasury of wealth: a comfortable life throughout, money that is accumulated and kept.
Treasury is the treasury of wealth and the best at keeping money; wealth fortune is steady and gradually grows, not hoping to get rich fast but growing thicker the more it accumulates.

Treasury: the Command star of the Southern Dipper, the star of the treasury, calm and conservative, good at managing money; meeting Wealth Keeper and Martial it gathers great wealth; standing alone it does not resolve misfortune; it suits government offices, banks and large enterprises.

Strategist + Right Assistant means a capable adviser: your plans are taken up and spread by the team. It suits being a staff member, strategist or consultant, and works out better than building a career alone.
Strategist + Earth Robbery means the clever are cheated: Strategist trusts its own judgment too much, but Earth Robbery makes you trust the wrong people.

Strategist + Earth Void means cleverness comes to nothing: the good ideas all stay in your head, with very little made real. You should find a partner who leans toward execution to force things to get done.
Strategist + Heavenly Halberd means a female noble helper helps you think: often a word from some female elder or leader wakes you from a bind.

Strategist + Heavenly Leader means a male elder points the way at a critical moment. Strategist is by nature suspicious, and Heavenly Leader gives you a “teacher you can trust”, so do not rush to refuse advice from older people.

Strategist + Left Assistant makes up for Strategist's weakness of “changing often and rarely finishing”: Left Assistant gives you a team to work with, so that your unusual ideas can become real. The best fit is a combination of planning + execution (you come up with the idea, that person does it).
Strategist + Ram Blade means cleverness that harms people: if your intelligence is used in the wrong direction, it becomes the killer of your relationships.

Strategist + Literary Talent is the golden combination of “wisdom + literary talent”, and one view holds that Strategist should be shone on by Literary Talent and Literary Arts. The ability to learn is very strong, suiting the path of scholar, researcher, teacher and technical expert. Examinations, rankings and degrees go fairly smoothly.

Strategist + Literary Arts means both eloquence and literary talent are complete. Media, education, consulting and client-facing trades are best. Your words carry weight and can influence other people's judgment.
Strategist + Fire Star means clever + hot-tempered: too many good ideas but none settle. Write down three ideas each day, but carry out only one.
Strategist + Bell Star means overthinking + self-wearing: insomnia, anxiety and over-analysis are common. You need to practise “setting a deadline for thinking”.

Strategist + Hindrance means changeable and also delaying: Strategist is by nature changeable, and with Hindrance added it becomes “wanting to change but dragging on and not moving”, the most tormenting combination.

Strategist and Heavenly Beam sitting together can carry both civil and military roles; if the trine palaces form Strategist, Moon, Harmony and Heavenly Beam, go into the civil service and do not start a business.
Strategist and Heavenly Beam in the Dragon and Dog palaces: no need to worry about fortune and lifespan; one star is kind-hearted, one shelters you, and you have a fine set of abilities.

Strategist and Heavenly Beam in the Life palace: a wisdom star paired with a sheltering star is the “pattern of a good person”, meaning a good heart that likes to do good deeds. This person is kind by nature, glad to help others, with a strong sense of justice and mission. Heavenly Beam is a shelter star that can turn danger into safety; Strategist is a wisdom star, flexible and changeable. Together they are “using wisdom to do good”, meaning using your head to do good things.

Strategist and Heavenly Beam in the Spouse palace: the book says your partner suits being older than you, marrying late goes smoothly, and starting a family too early easily meets setbacks. Your partner has a proper appearance, a gentle and upright temperament, and holds out a hand when you are in trouble. With Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added, you easily do not get along and may even live apart for long periods, so push the wedding date later all the more. The original text of the Wives and Concubines chapter of the Complete Book: Strategist, “with Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star added, rules separation in life”, and Heavenly Beam, “with Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Void and Robbery added, often not harmonious”; the original does not say whether they share the palace or shine from the trine palaces, nor does it distinguish bright or dim, so you need to look at which star it is together with them and in what way they meet.

Strategist and Heavenly Beam in the Career palace: the book says that Heavenly Beam sitting together is the quality to carry both the civil and military paths, and Strategist sitting together achieves outstanding things with a prominent position. Education, scholarship, religion and staff or strategist work all belong to this type and can be done. If the trine palaces also gather Harmony and Moon, forming the Strategist, Moon, Harmony and Heavenly Beam set of stars, then as in the line “Strategist, Moon, Harmony and Heavenly Beam make a clerk”: you surely work in a government office or school as someone on a fixed salary; unless Fame, Power and Prosperity shine in, there is no question of going into business. With malefic stars added, achievements are ordinary.

Strategist and Heavenly Beam in the Wealth palace: the book says Strategist must spend heart and effort to generate wealth, and sitting together with Heavenly Beam you earn extra by using your head to think of ways; but the money does not flourish greatly, and you must change trades several times before building an estate.
