The path of wealth lies in your specialty and planning, accumulating gradually through real ability. With Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added, it is hard first and easy later, only enough to live on.

Strategist and Moon sit only in the Tiger and Monkey palaces, where the trine palaces gather Harmony and Heavenly Beam, matching the saying “Strategist, Moon, Harmony and Heavenly Beam make a clerk” (the Bone Marrow Rhapsody of the Dipper writes “Strategist, Moon, Harmony and Heavenly Beam make a clerk”). This kind of life chart surely works in a government office or school on a fixed salary, with a gentle and mild temperament, and is a good pattern in itself; but if Fame, Power and Prosperity shine in, there is still the possibility of business, and it is not limited to working for a wage.

Strategist and Moon in the Spouse palace: your partner is mostly gentle, refined, intelligent, and understands you. The Wives and Concubines section of the Complete Book calls this combination “a beautiful homemaker”, “best to take a younger person”, meaning your partner has a delicate face and helps you shoulder the family, and suits looking for a partner younger than you. The marriage values spiritual exchange and has much to talk about, but occasionally you tend to think too much and give rise to suspicion. If the malefic stars Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery gather, you easily are more apart than together and end in parting. The original text of the Wives and Concubines chapter of the Complete Book: Strategist, “with Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star added, rules separation in life”, and Moon, “with Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Void, Robbery, Loss and Taboo added, if not harm then rules separation in life”; the original does not say whether they share the palace or shine from the trine palaces, nor does it distinguish bright or dim, so you need to look at which star it is together with them and in what way they meet.

Strategist and Moon in the Career palace: the career is mainly earning a living with your head. In the Career section of the Complete Book, both the Strategist and the Moon entries say “standing on the clerk's footing”, meaning you stand firm through the civil service and a fixed position; there is also a view that counts Strategist, Moon, Harmony and Heavenly Beam (Strategist, Moon, Harmony, Heavenly Beam) as a life chart that eats state rice, meaning that drawing a fixed salary in a government office, school or large organisation fits your nature best, suiting clerical work, administration, research and finance. There is also the idea that unless Fame, Power and Prosperity shine in, there is no question of going into business.

Strategist and Moon in the Wealth palace: Moon manages money, Strategist manages planning, so you manage money with a plan and calculate spending carefully. The Wealth section of the Complete Book says “spends heart and effort to generate wealth” and “makes wealth and a household from empty hands”, meaning money must be earned by spending heart and effort, mostly you build a career yourself from empty hands, not helped by what your ancestors left. Moon in the Tiger and Monkey palaces is not in its strongest position, so ups and downs in income and spending are hard to avoid; keep a steady income and do not speculate.
Strategist and Moon keep money: you earn it by spending heart and effort, build a career from empty hands, and should follow a steady income path and not speculate.

Strategist and Great Gate in the Life palace: a wisdom star paired with a dark star (which rules quarrels and gossip) is the pattern of “eloquence without obstacle”, meaning you know how to speak and debate, and speak with substance. This person has very good eloquence, clear logic, and is good at debate and analysis. Great Gate manages quarrels and gossip, and Strategist manages flexibility and change; together they are “making a living by the mouth”, meaning earning a living by the mouth, which suits best the trades that rely on speaking, such as lawyer, journalist, host and teacher.

Strategist and Great Gate in the Spouse palace: your partner is clever and sharp, a good talker, and the book says “Strategist sharing the palace gives a beautiful homemaker”, meaning your partner is beautiful and also helps you; but Great Gate brings discord, and the two of you often quarrel in daily life. The book says this combination suits finding a partner older than you, and marrying late is steadier than marrying early. For a woman: she suits marrying an older husband. With Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added, you easily are more apart than together and part. The original text of the Wives and Concubines chapter of the Complete Book: Strategist, “with Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star added, rules separation in life”, and Great Gate, “with Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Void and Robbery added, surely harms two wives or rules separation in life”; the original does not say whether they share the palace or shine from the trine palaces, nor does it distinguish bright or dim, so you need to look at which star it is together with them and in what way they meet. The secret of living together is to argue less over right and wrong, leave many ways to step back, and turn debate into discussion.

Strategist and Great Gate in the Spouse palace: your partner is clever and sharp, a good talker, and the book says “Strategist sharing the palace gives a beautiful homemaker”, meaning your partner is beautiful and also helps you; but Great Gate brings discord, and the two of you often quarrel in daily life. The book says this combination suits finding a partner older than you, and marrying late is steadier than marrying early. For a man: there are both sayings, Strategist saying a younger person suits and Great Gate saying an older person suits. With Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added, you easily are more apart than together and part. The original text of the Wives and Concubines chapter of the Complete Book: Strategist, “with Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star added, rules separation in life”, and Great Gate, “with Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Void and Robbery added, surely harms two wives or rules separation in life”; the original does not say whether they share the palace or shine from the trine palaces, nor does it distinguish bright or dim, so you need to look at which star it is together with them and in what way they meet. The secret of living together is to argue less over right and wrong, leave many ways to step back, and turn debate into discussion.

Strategist and Great Gate in the Career palace: the career mostly involves eloquence, analysis and planning, and lawyer, teacher, journalist, host, consultant and analyst are the best-fitting trades. The book says this combination goes smoothly in the Rabbit palace, while in the Rooster palace, although it is also fairly good, it is hard to have a beginning and an end; with the same ability falling in the Rooster palace, guard against changing direction midway and abandoning things halfway. When Great Gate enters the Temple (the Temple = this star here has strength) it suits a military post (posts of real power such as the army and police), holding authority, and a purely civil post will not last long, so it is best to bring your eloquence early into a specialised profession.

Strategist and Great Gate in the Wealth palace: mostly you build a career from empty hands, and money comes from bustling places: where there are many people and much news, there is money to earn. In Volume 2 of the Complete Book, the entry for Strategist in the Wealth palace says “with Great Gate, seeks a footing amid the bustle”, and the Great Gate entry says “with Strategist, the qi of wealth is born from the person, and what is done is not one thing”, meaning money must be seized in bustling places, comes from earning it yourself, and what you do is often not just one trade.

Strategist and Moon both sit in the Life palace: one is a wisdom star, and one is a wealth star leaning toward softness (it rules money). Strategist manages the mind, with quick reactions, flexible adaptation and high intelligence; Moon is of the civil-official type, manages regular wealth, and what is earned is mostly steady, such as a fixed salary. This life pattern has a flexible mind, is good at analysis and planning, gentle outside and talented within, not fond of show but refined in thought.

With Strategist in the Temple or Prosperous, intelligence and flexible ability are fully developed, and the ability to plan and analyse reaches its peak, the best life pattern for a consultant, analyst or planner.

Strategist is regarded as the star of the “civil official wearing rank, a star that wears official rank”, meaning it walks the civil-service path, carries official standing, and relies on the mind: quick to react, quick to move when it speaks, clever, with high intelligence; the old books call it an auspicious star of the Southern Dipper that can add years and lengthen life. The Complete Book says it is full of schemes and changes, meaning a flexible mind, many ideas, changing as soon as it speaks, born with the quality of an adviser and suiting best a supporting position: civil service in internal affairs, planning, consulting, education and technical research all suit. There is also the view that Strategist follows regular wealth, helping others work and drawing a fixed salary is the steadiest, and it does not suit taking charge of a region alone or charging ahead by yourself.
Strategist is a clever star, suited to being an adviser, and what it fears most is changing back and forth without result.

Strategist's greatest test is “many changes and nothing accomplished”, meaning changing back and forth and in the end achieving nothing: if the trine palaces (the palaces shining in from the other palaces) have too many malefic stars, you easily are too clever for your own good and start strong but finish weak. Note also that there is a view that clearly states that Strategist itself has no function of resolving misfortune or restraining it, so when you meet malefic stars do not treat it as a benefic star to rely on. The Complete Book says of Strategist: “If it guards the Body or Life palace, the person is extraordinary. Meeting Heavenly Beam, the Left and Right Assistants, and Literary Talent and Literary Arts, in civil life they are distinguished and honoured, in military life loyal and good. If in a Fallen position and clashed and broken by the Four Malefic Stars, it is a lowly pattern”: only when it is Fallen and also clashed and broken by the Four Malefic Stars is it counted as a lowly pattern, and it is not that meeting malefic stars means running about for a whole life. On appearance, tradition follows Yin Wood and holds it to be “slender and tall, fine brows and bright eyes, the air of a scholar”, meaning a refined, scholarly person with a bookish air; but there is a view that judges the appearance of someone with Strategist in the Life palace in the opposite way: dark skin, short and small build yet a very sturdy body, both men and women alike, short, nimble, with very quick reactions. When discussing, take this latter view as the standard; appearance has to be checked against the real person, and cannot be settled from the chart alone.

Strategist is by nature the main star of the Siblings palace. Your siblings are clever and flexible, with quick minds. If it meets Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star, the original text of the old books is “although there are some, they harm each other”: you have siblings, but they harm one another. If you go into business together, your partner knows how to plan but changes opinions often, so guard against blowing hot and cold.
Strategist by nature governs siblings: your siblings are clever, but each has their own idea, and partnership suits only the short term.

With Strategist Fallen in the Spouse palace or its trine palaces, your partner's cleverness and flexibility decline, and they may seem hesitant and lacking views of their own, or their feelings change often so that they are hard to grasp, and they need more tolerance and guidance.

With Strategist Fallen, talent and wit are less fully developed, changeable but lacking the ability to carry things out, and you are easily regarded as unstable because of erratic changes. Focus on one direction and dig deep, and make steadiness the main thing.
Strategist with Moon: a quick mind that knows how to plan but thinks too much, suited to civil posts in the civil service; do not take risks.
Strategist with Great Gate: a quick mind and a sharp tongue, with much gossip as well; the Rabbit palace is good, and the Rooster palace is hard to keep lasting.

Strategist: a wisdom star, regarded as a civil official wearing rank, following regular wealth; good at planning, suited to the civil service, consulting and education, a talent leaning toward supporting roles.
Heavenly Beam + Right Assistant means loyal subordinates + disciples: a network of relationships of the “school lineage” kind can form.
Heavenly Beam + Earth Robbery means the bond of shelter is robbed: the resources of your elders are seized by others (siblings fighting over property, peers competing for favour).
Heavenly Beam + Earth Void means the bond of shelter comes to nothing: elders are still there, but their real help is limited.
Heavenly Beam + Heavenly Halberd: a female elder cares for you, and the influence and support of the maternal side on you is very large.
Heavenly Beam + Heavenly Leader: a male elder cares for your fate, and throughout life male noble helpers keep lifting you up.
Heavenly Beam + Left Assistant means a shelter star with added support: your ability to shelter others is magnified, suiting work in education, medicine, public welfare and religion.
Heavenly Beam + Ram Blade means the shelter star is wounded: the fortune that elders' help brings is reduced, and you must rely on yourself.
Heavenly Beam + Literary Talent means learning + maturity: the typical “old scholar's life chart”, suited to being a university professor, a professional appraiser, or a senior elder in your field.
Heavenly Beam + Literary Arts means eloquence + maturity: public speaking, teaching, transmitting the Way and passing on a craft, and religious lecturer are best.
Heavenly Beam + Fire Star means a strained bond with superiors: you easily clash with elders and bosses.
Heavenly Beam + Bell Star means a hidden bond with superiors: outwardly respectful, but in truth there is a knot in the heart.
Heavenly Beam + Hindrance means the bond of shelter is delayed: help from elders comes late, but it is worth the wait.

With Heavenly Beam in the Temple or Prosperous, recovery after illness is good. Volume 1 of the Complete Book, in the Heavenly Beam entry, says Heavenly Beam “in the Friends or Health palace, appearance is all judged as abundant”, and sitting in the Health palace it is by nature an image of surplus. But you must still have a regular health check-up every year, and do not make light of early signals because you are “able to endure”.

With Heavenly Beam in the Temple or Prosperous, its sheltering power is fully developed and its ability to turn danger into safety is very strong; throughout life there are noble helpers keeping you safe, and in danger you often turn peril into peace, suiting trades that carry authority and a service nature.

With Heavenly Beam transforming to Fame in the palace of affection, in love you attract the other person through reputation or learning, your partner values cultural taste, and the common topics are mostly at the level of learning and the spirit.

With Heavenly Beam transforming to Fame, learning and reputation are both complete, your professional name spreads far, and this is an ideal pattern for academic research and specialist consulting, attracting opportunities through reputation.

Heavenly Beam transforming to Fame: a shelter star and a longevity star, ruling shelter and the bond with superiors, suited to law, medicine and education; the Complete Book says “it must enter the Temple to bring wealth and rank; in a Fallen position, meeting Fire Star and Ram Blade that break the pattern, it is lowly, solitary and short-lived”.
Heavenly Beam in the Career palace: rules holding office, with much social dealing and hosting.

A person with Heavenly Beam in the Life palace handles matters maturely, has a bond with superiors, likes to help people, and has a heavy heart for saving the world. The Rhapsody on Form and Nature says “Heavenly Beam is steady and weighty, the heart as clear as jade and ice”, meaning this person is calm, with a mind pure as ice and jade; the Complete Book says such a person is “solid and refined, clever and upright, with no private bend in the heart, glad to help others”, meaning thick-natured and handsome, intelligent and straightforward, hiding no selfish thought and glad to help people. Being upright, generous and clear in principles is the most prominent base colour of this type of person. Heavenly Beam's temperament is rather upright and generous, with a very strong personality, looking gentle but in the bones not willing to yield.
Heavenly Beam sitting in the Wealth palace: money mostly comes from learning and service.

Heavenly Beam is the second star of the Southern Dipper, and its transformed qi is “Shelter”, meaning like a great tree that shields people from rain and wind, ruling lifespan, sheltering, and the bond with superiors. The Complete Book calls it “solid and refined, clever and upright, with no private bend in the heart, glad to help others”, meaning a thick-natured, clever, straightforward person who hides no selfish thought and is glad to help. A person with it in the Life palace is mature and calm, acts openly and decisively, and however hard things get, always leaves some room to retreat. There is a view that Heavenly Beam is the only star among all stars that is complete in both civil and military, able to be both a civil and a military official; it also regards Heavenly Beam as the Food God, so there is much social dining and a good fortune of eating and drinking.

Heavenly Beam is a sheltering star that rules lifespan and also the bond with superiors, good for both civil and military roles, with a way back in danger; only when weak and with malefic stars added is it lonely.

With Heavenly Beam Fallen, its sheltering power is weak and its ability to turn danger into safety is reduced; throughout life you need to rely more on your own effort, depend less on “luck”, and actively build professional strength.

Heavenly Beam: a shelter star and a longevity star, ruling shelter and the bond with superiors, suited to law, medicine and education; the Complete Book says “it must enter the Temple to bring wealth and rank; in a Fallen position, meeting Fire Star and Ram Blade that break the pattern, it is lowly, solitary and short-lived”.
Minister + Right Assistant, together with Left Assistant, both rule support: your steadiness and coordinating ability are recognised by the team.
Minister + Earth Robbery means support is robbed: the boss you help may turn around and bite you once.
Minister + Earth Void means support loses its place: your ability as a deputy is not appreciated by anyone, and you need to actively switch to independent work.
Minister + Heavenly Halberd means a female noble helper: it may be a senior female manager or client who becomes the turning point of your career.
Minister + Heavenly Leader means a male noble helper promotes you to deputy or partnership: often a male boss who values your calm.
Minister + Left Assistant means a seal star + support: it suits the “number two” position such as deputy to a senior manager, CFO or CTO, steadier than building a career alone.
Minister + Ram Blade means the seal is wounded: the deputy position is easily replaced, and the stability of the career is shaken.
Minister + Literary Talent means calm + learning: suited to legal work, administration, civil posts and policy research.
Minister + Literary Arts means gentle + eloquent: diplomacy, public relations and coordination are best.
Minister + Fire Star means calm that is clashed: ordinarily gentle but occasionally flaring into fierce anger, so watch your emotional management.
Minister + Bell Star means calm that is pressed down: inwardly often anxious and prone to stomach and intestinal illness.
Minister + Hindrance means calm that is dragged slower: the ability to decide is weakened further.

Minister does not contend with others for the lead, yet it is not a person lacking views of their own. The old books say “does not change purpose to follow wickedness, nor alter course under threat”, meaning that the person does not change their aims because the people around do wrong, nor change their mind when threatened; and also “speaks truthfully, and does not act falsely”, that is, speaks honestly and is not false. Seeing others in trouble they soften, seeing others do wrong they are indignant, and inside they have their own ruler of right and wrong. What you truly need to train is to speak out that right and wrong: being gentle is a strength, but it is also easily taken as easygoing by those with intentions, so you must set your own boundaries.
Minister in the Career palace: the Complete Book says “in the Career palace, getting it brings glory and honour”.

A person with Minister in the Life palace is generous, keeps the rules and values good faith. The old books say “in appearance, honest and weighty; clean and upright, fond of food and drink; clothing and income abundant”, meaning an honest, calm face, a pure style, loving good food and a little wine, and never lacking food and clothing throughout life; the point on appearance is matching the face against the Life chart, which needs to be checked directly against the real person. You suit being a helper, supporting others to get things done; you dislike taking risks, put the stable harmony of life first, and colleagues and superiors all trust you.
Minister sitting in the Wealth palace: no worry about food and clothing, suited to steadily saving money.
Minister keeps money through accumulation; money is kept, and occasionally there is quick money too, but do not rely only on speculation.
Minister brings ample wealth; sharing the palace with Integrity you earn from trade, and meeting malefic stars you cannot keep it.

With Minister in the Temple or Prosperous in the Spouse palace or its trine palaces, your spouse is loyal, kind and honest, dependable and responsible, a steady partner, the foundation of the marriage is solid, and life is stable.
With Minister in the Temple or Prosperous, your ancestors have an estate to divide.

With Minister in the Temple or Prosperous, the trait of the supporting talent is fully developed, and the direction of administrative management and legal secretary work develops best, trusted and relied on by superiors, the most dependable one among those with a high foundation.
Minister is the “seal star”, meaning a deputy who holds the seal: a high position, but little real power.

Minister is the fifth star of the Southern Dipper, and its transformed qi is “Seal”; the “seal” is the official seal, and this star manages rank and acts on behalf of the ruler, so it stands for support, loyalty, administration and legal affairs. There is a view that Minister is like the prime minister in heaven, a very good supporting talent, and so it is always a high position with light authority; a person with Minister in the Life palace suits being an assistant, secretary or adviser to others. As for always being the deputy, that speaks of the ten-year Decade reaching Minister, and does not mean the Life palace with Minister is a deputy for a whole life.

Minister's best pattern is called “**Treasury and Minister facing the palace**”: the Life palace is in the Tiger or Monkey, with Treasury and Minister sitting in the Wealth palace and the Career palace respectively, both ends shining on the Life palace. The old books say “Treasury and Minister facing the palace, a thousand measures of grain income”, meaning no worry about food and clothing for a whole life and a high position as well, and this is one of the steadiest good patterns on the chart.

With Minister Fallen in the Spouse palace or its trine palaces, your partner's loyal, kind and dependable quality declines, and they may be a little lacking in decisiveness, needing you to take the initiative and carry more.
With Minister Fallen, the ability to support declines, the trait of a high position with light authority becomes clearer, and you need to be more outstanding in professional skill to be recognised.
Minister: a seal star of support, loyal, kind and honest, a high position with light authority, suited to administration, secretarial and legal work, with preservation above all.

A relationship that is too calm easily cools in intensity over time. Do not take not quarrelling to mean everything is fine. Set aside a stretch of time for the two of you every week; sharing a meal or walking a stretch of road together is enough; say the dissatisfaction in your heart clearly at that moment and do not pile it up. If you want to meet people, boldly ask relatives and friends to introduce you; this route is the most effective for you. Do not pull in all your own thoughts just because the other person is steady; the relationship can go far only when your opinions are spoken.

Sun + Right Assistant, together with Left Assistant, both rule support, but Right Assistant leans toward “following of its own accord”: your reputation will attract fans, partners and students on its own.
Sun + Earth Robbery means reputation is robbed: once famous you easily meet jealousy and slander, and you need legal protection and a public-relations strategy.
Sun + Earth Void means empty reputation: you easily have fame without real profit.
Sun + Heavenly Halberd means a female noble helper promotes you: especially in careers that need to be “in view”, a female media figure is willing to step forward and support you.
Sun + Heavenly Leader means a male noble helper takes special care. If your father is alive, he mostly gives support, and in your career you are often noticed by senior men.

Sun + Left Assistant means reputation and team are both complete: you are not only bright but also have people pushing you. It suits careers that need exposure (public accounts, intellectual property, politics, media).
Sun + Ram Blade means Sun is clashed: for a man's chart the father-and-child bond easily breaks, and the career is easily suppressed.

Sun + Ram Blade means Sun is clashed: for a man's chart the father-and-child bond easily breaks, and the career is easily suppressed; for a woman's chart, expectations of her husband are high, so disappointment comes easily.

Sun + Literary Talent is the omen of the “Sun and Literary Talent pattern”. This pattern means learning and reputation, suits education, publishing and media, and is the life pattern of a leader of public opinion in the present day.
Sun + Literary Arts means outstanding eloquence, with speeches that move people. The trades of media broadcaster, public speaker and coach suit best.
Sun + Fire Star means the light is too dazzling: you easily offend people and speak without leaving a way back. After middle age there are easily problems with the heart and eyes.
Sun + Bell Star means the light is pressed down: radiant outside but tormented inside, with very sensitive self-esteem.
Sun + Hindrance means the light is uneven: there is a high chance that your ability is buried, and you need to actively “step out under the stage lights”.

Sun transforming to Prosperity guarding the Life palace gains both reputation and profit, with money coming from public affairs or social reputation: this is the ideal pattern for Sun, with light and fortune advancing together, the louder the name the higher the income, shining in public places for a whole life.

Sun transforming to Prosperity: a noble star, ruling honour and distinction; Sun belongs to the military officials, a star that wears military rank, and Sun belongs to windfall wealth; its brightness decides how it comes out, for a man it is the father star, and for a woman it rules the husband.

Sun and Heavenly Beam both sit in the Life palace, one star open and aboveboard, one sheltering others. A person with this life pattern is open and selfless, decisive at work, and cannot bear injustice. The Complete Book says of Heavenly Beam “solid and refined, clever and upright, with no private bend in the heart, glad to help others”, meaning calm and handsome, with a clear mind that is also upright, hiding no selfish thought and glad to help people; it also says that if it meets Literary Talent, Literary Arts, Left Assistant and Right Assistant, you can reach a position at the centre or in supervision, born with the air of “petitioning on behalf of the people”, willing to step forward for ordinary folk.

Sun and Moon both sit in the Life palace, one Yang and one Yin, called “Yin and Yang shining together”, meaning the two stars light each other. A person with this life pattern is both firm and soft: outwardly active, warm and generous (Sun), inwardly refined and sensitive, thinking thoroughly (Moon). The old books say this combination depends on the birth hour: those born by day take the bright part of Sun, and those born by night take the clear part of Moon.

Sun and Great Gate both sit in the Life palace, called in ancient times “Great Gate and Sun sharing the palace”, saying these two stars are in one palace. Sun is the star of openness and aboveboard dealing, Great Gate is a dark star ruling speech and quarrels; Sun shining on Great Gate is “turning dark into light”, meaning quarrels become eloquence and gossip becomes reputation. A person with this life pattern knows how to give speeches and express themselves, and suits being a public figure, in media or education, trades where you must speak before crowds.

A person with Sun in the Life palace is outgoing and warm, has a leader's air, likes to help people, acts generously, and values reputation more than money. If it enters the Temple (the Temple = this star's strength), the spirit is high and the person is radiant and self-confident; if Fallen (weak), the temper is hard and hot, and the old books say “seldom fits with people and invites strife”, meaning not fitting with crowds, easily drawing gossip, clashing with people, or appearing domineering and subjective.

A person with Sun in the Life palace is straightforward, and the old books say “the person is loyal and stubborn, and does not pick at right and wrong”, meaning loyal and upright, not counting petty rights and wrongs; they value honour and face, joy and anger show on the face; in appearance mostly a square, round face, a ruddy complexion and a loud voice.
Sun in the Life palace rules reputation and status; how it comes out depends on the benefic and malefic stars in the trine and opposite palaces.
Sun sitting in the Children palace: the children are radiant and outgoing, with the pull to be noticed in front of everyone.

Sun and Heavenly Beam sitting in the Spouse palace: your partner is upright and has a sense of social responsibility: the steady part of Heavenly Beam is dependable; the career-minded part of Sun is strong. The Complete Book says that with Sun and Heavenly Beam in one palace and Left Assistant and Right Assistant added, the spouse is virtuous and reasonable, and you also easily meet good opportunities through your spouse. A partner a little older than you suits better. For a man's chart especially so. This palace fears early marriage most; the old books say that with Sun in the Temple (a star of strength), marrying a little late is good, and marrying too early instead hurts affection, so late marriage suits you.

Sun and Heavenly Beam sitting in the Spouse palace: your partner is upright and has a sense of social responsibility: the steady part of Heavenly Beam is dependable; the career-minded part of Sun is strong. The Complete Book says that with Sun and Heavenly Beam in one palace and Left Assistant and Right Assistant added, the spouse is virtuous and reasonable, and you also easily meet good opportunities through your spouse. A partner a little older than you suits better. This palace fears early marriage most; the old books say that with Sun in the Temple (a star of strength), marrying a little late is good, and marrying too early instead hurts affection, so late marriage suits you.

Sun and Heavenly Beam sitting in the Career palace: the core of the career is upholding fairness. Judge, prosecutor, lawyer, professor and head of a public-interest organisation are the most fitting trades. A person with this life pattern brings out the most value in careers connected with fairness and justice.

Sun and Heavenly Beam sitting in the Wealth palace: money is earned from a proper career, and spending is also measured. The Complete Book says that with Sun in the Temple (a star of strength) there is plenty in hand, while Fallen (weak) means hardship and setbacks; with Heavenly Beam in the Temple there is ample wealth, even reaching the top rank of riches and honour, while Fallen it is only hard earning enough to live on, so everything depends on the strength of the two stars. Heavenly Beam is a shelter star, like an elder protecting your money, and Sun governs proper income laid out in the light; when both stars are bright, the path of wealth is both steady and wide.
Sun and Moon both sit in the Life palace, one bright and one dark; the neighbouring palaces must bring in benefic stars and good fortune before it becomes something great.

Sun and Moon sitting in the Spouse palace: your partner is open yet refined. The old books say “Moon sharing the palace is a helper in the home”, “Sun sharing the palace means growing old together”, meaning your spouse helps you and the two of you can stay together until old age; the same chapter also has “early marriage harms”, meaning that marrying too early instead hurts affection, so late marriage suits you. Meeting Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void, Earth Robbery and Great Loss, even if affection is not hurt you easily live apart for long periods. The Moon entry in the Wives and Concubines chapter of the Complete Book reads, in the original, “with Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Void, Robbery, Loss and Taboo added, if not harm then rules separation in life”, without saying whether they share the palace or shine from the trine palaces, nor distinguishing bright or dim, so you need to look at which star it is together with them and in what way they meet.

Sun and Moon sitting in the Career palace are called by the old books “civil and military both excellent”, meaning both the civil and military paths can be carried. Sun manages reputation and position, Moon manages financial planning, so you both lead people and manage the accounts, suiting general management that takes care of both inside and outside. When the two stars are Fallen (stars of weak strength), although ambition is high, the career easily stumbles and it is hard to stand out.

Sun and Moon sitting in the Career palace are called by the old books “civil and military both excellent”, meaning both the civil and military paths can be carried. Sun manages reputation and position, Moon manages financial planning, so you both lead people and manage the accounts, suiting general management that takes care of both inside and outside. With Fame (reputation), Power (authority) and Prosperity (money coming in) meeting Left Assistant, Right Assistant, Literary Talent, Literary Arts, Heavenly Leader and Heavenly Halberd, the position can reach very high; when the two stars are Fallen (stars of weak strength), although ambition is high, the career easily stumbles and it is hard to stand out.

Sun and Moon sitting in the Wealth palace: Moon is the wealth star (it rules money and property), and Sun manages reputation and status, so you both know how to manage money and keep it. The old books say of this palace “little first, much later”, meaning that at first earning is not easy, and only after middle age do you slowly become comfortable. With benefic stars such as Left Assistant and Right Assistant also arriving, the Complete Book says “makes no small fortune”.

Sun and Great Gate sitting in the Spouse palace: your partner has good eloquence and handles people skilfully, mostly works in public-facing jobs, and also brings connections to the family. The book says that with Sun in the Temple (a star of strength) a somewhat later marriage suits, and marrying too early instead hurts affection; Great Gate here suits finding a partner older than you, or else it is hard to fit together. Only when the Spouse palace is free of the four malefic stars Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star is it easy to grow old together. However, good stars in the Spouse palace do not mean the marriage bond comes early; there are examples of Great Gate and a Prosperous Sun in the Spouse palace together with Red Phoenix and Heavenly Joy slow to arrive, in which case the marriage bond comes late.

Sun and Great Gate sitting in the Career palace: the core of the career is expression before the public, and teacher, lawyer, politics, host and media are the most fitting trades. The book says that when Great Gate and Sun are in one palace the career has advances and retreats, and both stars must enter the Temple (stars of strength) to last long: if both are bright you can hold on for a long time, and if not bright, you rise and fall erratically and change paths midway.

Sun and Great Gate sitting in the Wealth palace: the book says Great Gate suits building a career from empty hands, and money must be earned in bustling places; sharing the palace with Sun, early on earning has successes and failures, and by middle age there is still not much to spare in hand. A person whose mind is set too high and who is too fond of contending instead loses more easily in a moment.

Sun is the ruling star in the middle of the sky, and its core is one word, “noble”, speaking of reputation, status and public image; Volume 1 of the Complete Book calls it “the pivot of the Career palace”, meaning the master switch of career fortune, and it suits best sitting in the Career palace. A person with Sun in the Life palace has a noble air and can do both civil and military roles; with benefic stars helping, there is reputation and position, and meeting malefic and wicked stars, there is toil of heart and mind. There is a view that places Sun among the “stars that wear military rank”, meaning it follows the military path, which today corresponds to soldier, police officer, judge and diplomat, and it also suits politics, management and serving the public.

Sun values brightness most: from the Tiger to the Horse it enters the Temple (the Temple = this star's strength), and from the Rooster to the Ox it is Fallen (weak). The Complete Book also says Sun is “Fallen when born at night, Temple or Prosperous when born by day”, so whether born by day or night must be considered as well, and the position of the palace on the chart cannot be taken as the birth hour. The old books also say that when Sun is Prosperous and does not meet Earth Void or Earth Robbery, it “rules wealth for a whole life”, meaning money is never lacking all your life, so Sun does not have only fame and no money, but fame goes first and money comes along with fame.
Sun shining on Great Gate lights up the dark side; when both stars are strong, eloquence is good and reputation is great.
Sun's money belongs to windfall wealth, and how much comes in is hard to say beforehand.
Sun with Heavenly Beam: a strong sense of justice, many noble helpers, suited to law and public welfare.
Moon + Right Assistant, together with Left Assistant, both rule support, but it leans toward family warmth: the affection among family members is deep, with much mutual help.
Moon + Earth Robbery means the Property palace is robbed: you may lose house and land through family disputes or the division of property in a marriage.
Moon + Earth Void means the Property palace comes to nothing: for a woman's chart the family estate cannot be kept, and for a man's chart there is little attachment to the family.
Moon + Left Assistant means a firm Property palace + ample support: a woman's chart is especially blessed, with house and land, treasury and family relationships all steady.
Moon + Ram Blade means gentleness is wounded: for a woman's chart the marriage is easily hurt, and for a man's chart relations with women are strained.
Moon + Literary Talent means the life chart of a talented woman or man: literature, the arts, psychology and education are the most natural fields.
Moon + Literary Arts means gentleness + skill: music, writing, dance and design are the directions of natural gift.
Moon + Fire Star means gentleness is burned: big emotional swings, irregular periods and skin problems (clearer in a woman's chart).
Moon + Bell Star means gentleness is pressed down: the endocrine system, sleep and emotions are the problems that need particular attention.
Moon + Hindrance means affection is delayed: a good romance is dragged out, neither hot nor cold, and in the end usually goes nowhere.
Moon leans toward corresponding to daughters; the old books say girl first, boy after, and the first child is mostly a girl.
With Moon in the Temple (the Rooster, Dog, Pig, Rat and Ox palaces), the moon is at its fullest and brightest, and the air of wealth and honour reaches its peak.

With Moon in the Temple (the Rooster, Dog, Pig, Rat and Ox palaces), the moon is at its fullest and brightest, and the air of wealth and honour reaches its peak. For a woman, this pattern is the image of great wealth and honour.

With Moon in the Temple (the Rooster, Dog, Pig, Rat and Ox palaces, especially Pig, Rat and Ox) guarding the Wealth palace, the moonlight is at its fullest and brightest, the image of the richest in a region: the ability in the Property palace and in real estate investment reaches its strongest, the best state of property wealth fortune among the 14 main stars, and you should allocate assets heavily to it.

With Moon transforming to Fame in the Wealth palace or its trine palaces, money comes from gentle, refined professional fields such as literature and education, the arts, design and psychological counselling, earning through a sense of aesthetics and emotional value; the path of wealth of a woman with this pattern often has an aesthetic nature, such as beauty, interior design or goods for women; money comes with taste, and reputation and accumulation advance side by side.

With Moon transforming to Fame guarding the Life palace, literary and artistic talent and emotional intelligence go side by side, with professional reputation in the arts, education and culture, and a gentle, scholarly air that leaves a deep impression.

Moon transforming to Fame: the star of wealth and honour of the moon, refined in feeling; in the Temple it brings wealth and honour, and in a woman's chart in the Temple it is even better, ruling the Property palace and houses and land.
Moon in the Career palace: follows the civil-service path and draws a fixed salary.

A person with Moon in the Life palace is refined and sensitive inside, very rich in compassion, has an especially good eye for beauty, likes quiet, and does not like contending with people. The book says such a person is clever and fine-featured, with a proper and gentle temperament. For a woman: her appearance is mostly fine and pretty, which is a matter of matching the face against the Life chart and needs to be checked directly against the real person; her air is gentle and elegant, with a gift for the arts.

A person with Moon in the Life palace is refined and sensitive inside, very rich in compassion, has an especially good eye for beauty, likes quiet, and does not like contending with people. The book says such a person is clever and fine-featured, with a proper and gentle temperament. The air is gentle and elegant, with a gift for the arts. For a man: romantic, with a rich inner world that he does not show much, and easily governed by feeling.

What a person with Moon in the Life palace fears most is having their emotions affected: the moon wanes and waxes, and emotions rise and fall with it, so you need to find ways to steady yourself. Refined thought is the double-edged blade of Moon, and strong sensitivity also means being easily prone to melancholy and sentiment.
Moon sitting in the Travel palace: going out, you follow the paths of culture, the arts, finance and real estate.

Moon is the moon itself, its transformed qi is “Wealth”, meaning it manages property; it is also the ruler of the Property palace, managing houses and land, and one of the stars that rule wealth on the chart. The old mnemonic says “Sun rules honour, Moon rules wealth”, put in plain words: Sun leans toward status and reputation, and Moon leans toward money and family property. So a person with Moon in the Life palace values accumulating wealth, real estate and the warmth of home. The book also says Moon is the mother star, and also the wife star.

Moon is the moon itself, its transformed qi is “Wealth”, meaning it manages property; it is also the ruler of the Property palace, managing houses and land, and one of the stars that rule wealth on the chart. The old mnemonic says “Sun rules honour, Moon rules wealth”, put in plain words: Sun leans toward status and reputation, and Moon leans toward money and family property. So a person with Moon in the Life palace values accumulating wealth, real estate and the warmth of home. The book also says Moon is the mother star, and also the wife star. For a man: Moon is read for the mother and the wife, and for a whole life he is rather deeply influenced by these two women.
Moon is the ruler of the Property palace, and houses and land are governed by it.

Moon values brightness most. The Complete Book says that for Moon “the Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse and Goat palaces are Fallen positions, and the Rooster, Dog, Pig, Rat and Ox palaces obtain fullness”. Volume 3 of the Complete Book, on Moon in the Rat palace, notes “a person born at night fits the pattern”, so whether born by day or night must be considered as well; the day-and-night image of a palace position cannot be taken as the birth hour. Moon falling in the Rat position is the pattern “Clear Water, Bright Moon”, meaning clear water and a bright moon, a daughter of pure, lovely looks and fair skin, like Chang'e in the moon.

Moon values brightness most. The Complete Book says that for Moon “the Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse and Goat palaces are Fallen positions, and the Rooster, Dog, Pig, Rat and Ox palaces obtain fullness”. For a woman: between Moon in the Temple and Fallen, the Complete Book's way of speaking differs enormously. Volume 3 of the Complete Book, on Moon in the Rat palace, notes “a person born at night fits the pattern”, so whether born by day or night must be considered as well; the day-and-night image of a palace position cannot be taken as the birth hour. Moon falling in the Rat position is the pattern “Clear Water, Bright Moon”, meaning clear water and a bright moon, a daughter of pure, lovely looks and fair skin, like Chang'e in the moon.
Moon manages property and houses and land, and the moon must be “bright”, meaning that only with enough brightness is there wealth and honour.

With Moon Fallen (the Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse and Goat palaces) in the Wealth palace or its trine palaces, the moonlight is dim, the air of wealth and honour is reduced, and wealth fortune is unstable and easily disturbed by emotions. Make steady saving the main thing, take fewer high-risk investments, and expand only after the cycle turns good.

With Moon Fallen (the Rabbit, Dragon, Snake, Horse and Goat palaces), the moon loses brightness, the air of wealth and honour weakens, emotions easily turn gloomy, and wealth fortune, especially property wealth fortune, is somewhat reduced, so make up for it with a positive mindset and action.

Moon: the star of wealth and rank of the moon, with refined feelings. When it is in a Temple position it brings wealth and rank, and it is even better for a woman's chart in a Temple position. It governs the Property palace, meaning land and houses.

With Seven Killings in the Spouse palace, your partner has a strong personality, acts decisively, and feels things intensely, so there is a fair amount of conflict and tug-of-war in the marriage. This path needs much more patience and tolerance, and each of you must give the other enough room to act independently. Both of you have to learn to step back, otherwise there will be a lot of arguing at home and it will be hard to find peace.

With Harmony in the Spouse palace, your love life is generally smooth, your partner is gentle and attentive, and the two of you live together in harmony. This is one of the fairly good configurations for the Spouse palace. The most important line in the book is “Harmony: marry late and grow old together”, meaning that marrying a little later actually leads to a marriage that lasts until white hair, and in terms of age it is good for the man to be older and the woman younger. Sharing the palace with Moon means a beautiful partner, sharing it with Heavenly Beam makes a very well-matched pair, and sharing it with Great Gate means more quarrels. If the four malefic stars Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star are added, husband and wife easily fall out of harmony and may even live apart for a long time, which you must not fail to guard against.

With Treasury in the Spouse palace, the Complete Book says “Treasury, mutual generation, a cherished spouse of noble standing; meeting Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void or Earth Robbery, marrying late avoids punishment and you will grow old together”. In plain words: husband and wife are well matched in temperament and love each other, and the partner themselves is in good circumstances and has standing. If you meet Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void or Earth Robbery, marrying a little later brings less trouble, and a late marriage in fact lasts until old age. Another passage also says Treasury means “growing old together”, meaning the two of you can live to old age side by side.

With Strategist in the Spouse palace, your partner is clever and flexible, talented in many fields, and quick-witted, but their feelings change easily and there is a considerable chance of drifting together and apart. When living together you must give each other enough room for ideas, and not control too tightly, otherwise trouble arises easily.

With Heavenly Beam in the Spouse palace, the Complete Book says “Heavenly Beam: the wife should be very beautiful”, meaning your spouse suits someone older than you and has an upright, pleasant appearance. Sharing the palace with Harmony means a peaceful life together, and sharing it with Strategist means a beautiful, gentle and virtuous partner. Another saying goes “Heavenly Beam sharing the palace, husband and wife are an extremely fine match”, meaning the two of you can become a very fulfilled couple. The book rates Heavenly Beam in this palace as by no means low.

With Minister in the Spouse palace, your spouse is honest and trustworthy, does what they say, and the marriage is stable, making them a partner who can walk beside you for the long term. Feelings centre on stability and harmony, with not much romance or passion, but loyalty is high, which makes this a good configuration for building a lasting marriage.

With Sun in the Spouse palace, your partner is outgoing and positive, has presence in front of others, and has a strong drive for career. The old books say this palace is “Temple or Prosperous, marry late for good fortune, marrying early brings harm”, meaning that when it is in a Temple position (a Temple position means this star is at full strength), marrying a little later goes smoothly, while settling down too early wears away the feelings. In a Temple position it also means “a person gains nobility through the wife”, meaning that through your spouse you gain good opportunities and standing. If it shares the palace with Heavenly Beam and Left Assistant and Right Assistant are added, you can marry a gentle, virtuous and understanding partner.

With Moon in the Spouse palace, your spouse is gentle and refined, attentive to mood and sentiment, with considerate feelings, and the quality of the marriage is fairly high. When Moon is in a Temple position (Temple means strength, Fallen means weakness), feelings are sweet and smooth; when it is Fallen, your partner has big emotional swings, or the relationship is damaged by emotional problems.

With Army Breaker in the Spouse palace, the book says “Army Breaker: both man and woman harm each other, separating and gathering means parting in life”. In plain words: whether man or woman, the two of you easily hinder each other and live apart, living apart for a long time is a common form, with more distance than closeness, and drifting together and apart is the norm on this path. Volume one also says “when it is not in the proper place in the Spouse palace, the marriage advances and retreats”, meaning the love path is not very smooth, the marriage goes one step forward and one step back, repeating again and again, and is hard to settle in one go. Sharing the palace with Emperor is “suited to a wife older in years”, meaning a partner older than you is in fact steadier; sharing it with Martial or Integrity makes the situation heavier and the discord greater. One view holds that late marriage applies to people with Army Breaker in the Life palace at Rat or Horse (the hero star in a Temple position), where both men and women marry late; that is about the Life palace, not about seeing Army Breaker in the Spouse palace, so it cannot be carried over directly. Both sides must leave enough room for freedom for the relationship to last.

With Emperor in the Spouse palace, your partner has an uncommon temperament and a kingly presence, and the old books give it bluntly in two words, “strong nature”, meaning a hard nature and a strong sense of self who does not easily bow the head. When the two of you live together it easily becomes “two emperors contending for the throne”, meaning two emperors fighting over the throne, each with their own reasons, so one side must learn to yield a step.

With Greedy Wolf in the Spouse palace, feelings come on warm and strong, and your spouse is talented in many fields and attractive. Greedy Wolf is a peach blossom star, but there is a main rule: only when it falls in Pig or Rat is it true peach blossom, and at Horse it is a military officer star, so do not casually assume peach blossom. The old books judge this palace without politeness, the original text being “Greedy Wolf: man or woman, no fine match, a bridegroom three times, in a Temple position suited to marrying late”. In plain words: whether man or woman, the marriage does not easily hold firm in one go, marrying early easily repeats, and when Greedy Wolf is in a Temple position (this star at full strength in this position) it suits marrying a little later even more. So see clearly what you truly want before entering marriage, and the quality of the household will in fact be higher. If malefic stars Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star also share the palace, the old books say “means parting in life”, meaning it is easy to live apart for a long time, and arrangements in two places need to be discussed first.
Husband and wife easily wear on each other and are not very harmonious; marrying late is steadier than marrying early.
Husband and wife are very well matched, but you must marry late and have an age gap of some years for the marriage to last.

If the trine and opposite palaces (the palaces read together with this one) have good transformations backing it, then it is a strong-with-strong union, and the two of you can achieve more together. With Seven Killings in the Spouse palace, both sides have a hard personality, so the key is whether the two of you are mature enough to complete each other.

If the Life, Travel, Wealth and Career palaces together gather Strategist, Moon, Harmony and Heavenly Beam, then it fits the saying “Strategist, Moon, Harmony, Heavenly Beam make a clerk”: you will certainly work in a state office or a school, a person on a fixed salary. Only if Fame, Power and Prosperity shine on it from afar is there any room for business.

If the Life, Travel, Wealth and Career palaces together gather Strategist, Moon, Harmony and Heavenly Beam, then it fits the saying “Strategist, Moon, Harmony, Heavenly Beam make a clerk”: you will certainly work in a state office or a school, a person on a fixed salary. Only if Fame, Power and Prosperity shine on it from afar is there any room for business. A person with Fame (reputation) in the Career palace suits taking the exam for a state office.

If Fire Star or Bell Star shares the palace with Greedy Wolf, it forms “Fire Star with Greedy Wolf” or “Bell Star with Greedy Wolf”, meaning these two stars set Greedy Wolf ablaze; away from home, chances of a windfall rise sharply, and a single business trip or journey may bring in a sum, only it comes fast and also goes fast. If Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery are added, and you also meet Loss and Killings, the old books say “adding Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void, Earth Robbery, Loss and Killings, in a Yearly period you suffer soldiers and plunder”, meaning that in that year you meet the disaster of armed violence and robbery while away from home.

There is no need to rush marriage; settling down a little later is in fact steadier. The old books say that with Harmony in the Spouse palace the husband should be older and the wife younger, and you being a bit older than her makes living together easier; this is a reference, not a hard condition. In daily life do not treat “not arguing” as good feelings. Take the initiative to arrange some new things for the two of you to do together: travelling, learning a hands-on craft, or changing where you live for a while are all fine. When she makes a request, do not agree just to get it over with; say what you think as well, so that the relationship does not turn into you alone giving way.

There is no need to rush marriage; settling down a little later is in fact steadier for you. The old books say that with Harmony in the Spouse palace the husband should be older and the wife younger, and the other person being a bit older than you makes living together easier; this is a reference, not a hard condition. In daily life do not use one-sided giving way to buy peace. If you do not speak, that person truly does not know. When you have a thought, say it right then, and you can still be gentle after saying it. The two of you need new things to do together; travelling, learning something more, or changing your living environment for a while are all fine, so that the relationship does not stand still.
The marriage easily has clashes, your partner has a strong temper, and you suit marrying late.

With Seven Killings in the Children palace, your children have strong, independent personalities, and to some degree often go against their parents. They decide for themselves very early, the bond between parents and children leans towards the thin side, and “the child has had a world of their own since small” is common. The book says Seven Killings in the Children palace “means the lot of a single person alone”, meaning few children, just one. One view holds that Seven Killings means two children, while another holds that Seven Killings stands for one son; the two views are set side by side without saying which to take as the standard. There is an example of Seven Killings in the Children palace meeting Heavenly Horse, meaning the son will move away from your side as he grows up. The parent-child relationship must be nurtured actively, so do not be fooled by the illusion that “the child does not need me”.

With Harmony in the Children palace, your children are mild and kind, parents and children live together easily, the children have good feelings for their parents, and the atmosphere at home is warm. One way of counting holds that Harmony corresponds to one child; the Complete Book instead counts children by Temple or Fallen position and the stars sharing the palace, and the two views are set side by side. The Complete Book says Harmony in a Temple position is “five sons, one of them of noble standing”, about five children, with one who makes a name. If Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery are added, the Complete Book says “meeting punishment and harm, few children to see you off at the end”.

With Treasury in the Children palace, the Complete Book says “Treasury: five people”, meaning about five children. In temperament, your children are calm and practical with strong ability to manage money, and the parent-child relationship is stable, the kind that puts your mind at ease in old age. Note that the children are kept close but do not dare to charge ahead much, so beyond “material sufficiency”, give more emotional exchange and room to try and make mistakes.

With Strategist in the Children palace, your children are bright and quick, flexible in mind and fast learners, but changeable by nature and not easily settled. One view takes Heavenly Beam as a Yang star standing for sons and Strategist as a Yin star standing for daughters. The old books say Strategist in a Temple position (at full strength in this position) means about two children. If Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery are added, the old books write “entirely without children”. When living with your children you must give enough room for freedom: Strategist cannot bear being bound, and the tighter you press the stronger the reaction. When Strategist and Great Gate are both in the Children palace, one view says that with these two stars in the Children palace there is no son, that brothers exist but sons do not; the word “none” here means only no sons, not no children at all. The Great Gate entry in the Complete Book instead says “Strategist, with one person”, so the two views are set side by side.

With Heavenly Beam in the Children palace, your children are mature and calm, understand matters fairly early, and are the kind that spare their parents worry; you are both teacher and friend to them, each independent and not clinging. The Complete Book says Heavenly Beam in the Children palace “in a Temple or Prosperous position, two people”, meaning two children when it is in a Temple position (at full strength). If Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery are added, the Complete Book says “early harm”. Heavenly Beam is a Yang star standing for sons, so it implies that this palace has one son.

With Heavenly Beam in the Children palace, your children are mature and calm, understand matters fairly early, and are the kind that spare their parents worry; you are both teacher and friend to them, each independent and not clinging. The Complete Book says Heavenly Beam in the Children palace “in a Temple or Prosperous position, two people”, meaning two children when it is in a Temple position (strength). If Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery are added, the Complete Book says “early harm”. Heavenly Beam is a Yang star standing for sons, so it implies that this palace has one son. With Fame (reputation), the children are educated and have a name.

With Minister in the Children palace, volume one of the old book says “with children obtained, the line continues and flourishes”, meaning the bond with children is naturally thick and the descendants prosper. Volume two adds that if Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star do not share the palace, then “there are two children who make something of themselves”, meaning two children who grow up well. Your children are warm-hearted and honest, dutiful and practical, and the parent-child relationship is stable and harmonious, the kind that “worries parents least”. Their nature is not that of risk-taking pioneers, but they are reliable and give their parents a sense of security.

With Sun in the Children palace, your children are bright and outgoing in nature, have presence in front of others, and develop quite well. The old books say Sun in a Temple position (this star at full strength) means “three sons and two daughters, with late children being noble”, meaning three sons and two daughters, and those born a little later in fact have better prospects. If Sun is Fallen (weak), the old books say “even with three sons, none makes it”, meaning that even with three children it is hard for them to do well. When it shares the palace with Great Gate, the Sun entry in the Complete Book says “Great Gate shares with three people”, while the Great Gate entry says “sharing the palace with Sun, one or two sons are raised apart”, and the two passages are set side by side. Sun is a Yang star, and when counting sons, one Yang star in the Children palace counts as one son.

With Moon in the Children palace, your children are delicate and gentle with refined feelings, get along well with their parents, and live together with them in harmony, the type that “knows how to be coddled”. Moon is a Yin star standing for daughters, and falling in the Children palace it means a good bond with daughters. The book says “three daughters and two sons, daughters first and sons after”, meaning three daughters and two sons, mostly with a daughter first and a son after. When Moon is in a Temple or Prosperous position (both are strong positions), the old books say “in a Temple or Prosperous position, a noble child”, so the children are likely to have prospects, to be fine-featured, and to make something of themselves. If Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery are added, the old books say “few children”.

With Army Breaker in the Children palace, the book calls it “a child of hard strength”, meaning your children have firm personalities and strong independence, do not take the ordinary road, and want to stand on their own very early. Volume one says Army Breaker “in the Children palace, loss first and success after”. In plain words: the path with children meets obstacles first and succeeds later, and the bond leans towards the thin side. One way of counting holds that Army Breaker usually gives more, about two children. The book says Army Breaker in a Temple position (this star at full strength in this position) means three children, and the two views are set side by side. The book says “uncontrolled, meeting Earth Void, Earth Robbery, Fire Star and Hindrance, few children”, so there are fewer children.

With Emperor in the Children palace, your children carry a noble air, there is often one outstanding child, and they have natural leadership. Volume one of the old book says “when the palace of sons and daughters gains auxiliary benefic stars, it means noble children are born”, so with benefic stars such as Left Assistant and Right Assistant helping, your children have prospects. Volume one also says “if it holds alone with no one to assist, the Children palace is lonely”: Emperor, a single star standing alone here with no helpers beside it, means few children and loneliness as well. On the number of children, the old book says Emperor in a Temple position (at full strength in this position) means three sons and two daughters. The old book says that adding Left Assistant, Right Assistant, Literary Talent and Literary Arts gives five children. The old book also says “holding alone and then adding Earth Void and Earth Robbery, a lonely ruler”. Your children have strong independence and high self-respect, and with their parents it is more like teacher and friend; teaching must be done by leading them slowly, and forcing them backfires.

With Greedy Wolf in the Children palace, your children are talented in many fields, strong in peach blossom, and active in socializing; from small they are the kind of child “everyone who meets them likes”, meaning they are cherished wherever they go. As for the parent-child relationship, the child has strong independence, with their own desires and pursuits, and parents find it hard to control them fully.
The bond with children is thick, and the old books say two children make something of themselves.
Children are not many, but their talent shows early. If it shares the palace with Greedy Wolf, Army Breaker or Seven Killings and also meets malefic stars, the old books say “entirely none”.
Children have strong personalities and become independent early.
Children have an easygoing personality, their drive to advance needs plenty of encouragement, and it suits building a sense of goals in them from a young age.

Children have an easygoing personality, their drive to advance needs plenty of encouragement, and it suits building a sense of goals in them from a young age. With Taboo (obstruction), the children's constitution leans weak, or the feelings between you are distant; pay attention to their health in daily life and have regular check-ups as the doctor advises.
Your children mostly have talent and skill, clear-cut personalities, and early-maturing feelings, and in adolescence they have more on their minds than friends of the same age.
The number of children leans towards few, and their character is firm.
Children have talent but are not many in number, and peach blossom comes early. With Greedy Wolf in a Temple or Prosperous position, the old books say “early punishment and harm”.
Children come late, hard first and smooth afterwards, and there are many quarrels between parents and children.
Children are mild and kind, and parents and children live together easily. When this star is strong, there are many children.
The bond with children is thick, and the old books say Treasury in the Children palace means five children.
Children are bright and quick, though not many in number. Meeting malefic stars, the old books say “entirely without children”.
What you keep is money you already have, the family estate grows thicker the later it goes, and with Fire Star a sum may arrive after middle age.
Being at peace is a blessing; add malefic stars and Taboo stars and you toil through your days.

With Seven Killings in the Career palace, one view ranks Seven Killings, Army Breaker and Greedy Wolf all among the military officer stars; turning to career, Seven Killings and Army Breaker govern loss and toil, so a career has to be earned by running about and hard work. The book is very clear, the original text being “Seven Killings in a Temple or Prosperous position, a military post stands out, authority and rank are not small, not suited to a scholar”. In plain words: when Seven Killings is in a Temple position (this star at full strength in this position) you go into military posts (the army, the police and the like), can rise to a very high position and hold no small power, but it does not suit a purely scholarly path, and purely clerical or administrative posts in fact bury it. Sharing the palace with Martial brings both power and status, and sharing it with Integrity easily brings a prominent name.

With Harmony in the Career palace, the book says that when Harmony is in a Temple position (strength) it is “suited to both civil and military”, meaning you can do both civil and military posts, not only light work. Sharing the palace with Heavenly Beam gives no small authority and rank, and sharing it with Great Gate is small first and big after. It is best not to see Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star or Bell Star; seeing malefic stars brings many ups and downs in your career.

With Treasury in the Career palace, the Complete Book says “Treasury in a Temple position, civil and military both fortunate; without Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void or Great Loss it is entirely fine; with Emperor, a name in both civil and military; with Integrity or Martial, power and rank; meeting Earth Void and Earth Robbery, ordinary”. That means: when Treasury is in a Temple position (this star at full strength), both civil and military posts go smoothly; without Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void or Great Loss causing trouble it is even more complete; sharing the palace with Emperor, you have a name on both the civil and military paths; sharing it with Integrity or Martial, you easily hold power and standing; meeting Earth Void and Earth Robbery, it is only ordinary. The “Bone Marrow Rhapsody” of Dou Shu also says “Treasury and Minister are the spirits of clothing and salary; as a scholar or an official, they surely signal a smooth road”, meaning these two stars govern food, clothing and pay, and in office or at work your road is smooth and unobstructed.

With Strategist in the Career palace, one view ranks Strategist among the “civil officer, official-sash stars”, meaning the civil path, carrying the status of an official, and working as a civil servant or in internal affairs suits you best. It also says Strategist follows the regular-wealth path, helping others work, and drawing a fixed salary is steadiest. If Strategist together with Moon, Harmony and Heavenly Beam, all four stars, gather and shine on the Life, Travel, Wealth and Career palaces, it forms the “Strategist, Moon, Harmony, Heavenly Beam” pattern, meaning a fixed combination formed by these four stars. The saying “Strategist, Moon, Harmony, Heavenly Beam make a clerk” means you will certainly work in a state office or a school as a person on a fixed salary, which is already a very good pattern. There is also the idea that only if Fame, Power and Prosperity shine on it from afar is there any room for business.

With Heavenly Beam in the Career palace, the Complete Book says “Heavenly Beam in a Temple position at Horse, meeting Left Assistant, Right Assistant, Heavenly Leader and Heavenly Halberd, talent in both civil and military”, meaning Heavenly Beam in a Temple position (strength) at the Horse palace and meeting Left Assistant, Right Assistant, Heavenly Leader and Heavenly Halberd makes a person fully gifted in both civil and military affairs. One view holds that Heavenly Beam in a Temple position at the Horse palace takes the path of a military officer holding power, but the condition is that the Life palace is precisely at the Horse palace with Heavenly Beam seated in the Life palace, so it cannot be carried directly over to the Career palace for a reading. There is also the idea that Heavenly Beam is the only star complete in both civil and military, able to be either a civil or a military official; and it is also treated as a Food God, which in the Career palace means an official with a great deal of socializing.

With Heavenly Beam in the Career palace, the Complete Book says “Heavenly Beam in a Temple position at Horse, meeting Left Assistant, Right Assistant, Heavenly Leader and Heavenly Halberd, talent in both civil and military”, meaning Heavenly Beam in a Temple position (strength) at the Horse palace and meeting Left Assistant, Right Assistant, Heavenly Leader and Heavenly Halberd makes a person fully gifted in both civil and military affairs. For a man's chart: the benefic-and-malefic verse for Heavenly Beam in a man's chart in the Complete Book goes “Heavenly Beam, the star of longevity, meets Strategist, Sun, Literary Talent, Left and Right together; at Rat, Horse, Tiger and Monkey it is in a Temple position, an official post of clear distinction reaching the three highest ministers”, which speaks of a man's chart with Heavenly Beam holding the Life palace, not of Heavenly Beam falling in the Career palace. One view holds that Heavenly Beam in a Temple position at the Horse palace takes the path of a military officer holding power, but the condition is that the Life palace is precisely at the Horse palace with Heavenly Beam seated in the Life palace, so it cannot be carried directly over to the Career palace for a reading. There is also the idea that Heavenly Beam is the only star complete in both civil and military, able to be either a civil or a military official; and it is also treated as a Food God, which in the Career palace means an official with a great deal of socializing.

With Minister in the Career palace, the old books say “in a Temple position, suited to both civil and military, with abundant salary”, meaning that when Minister is in a Temple position (strength) both civil and military posts can be taken and income is plentiful; when Fallen (weak), the career has big ups and downs, so you should choose a stable foundation all the more. One view calls Minister an excellent assisting talent, but that speaks of the Life palace seating Minister; for Minister falling in the Career palace, the “Questions and Answers on the Stars” says “gaining it in the Career palace brings glory and distinction”.

With Moon in the Career palace, the book says that in a Temple position (Temple means strength, Fallen means weakness) it is easy to gain standing, and meeting Sun, Literary Talent, Literary Arts, Left Assistant and Right Assistant you can rise to a fairly high official rank. Sharing the palace with Harmony suits both civil and military posts; sharing it with Strategist, you mostly stand firm from the grass-roots level on up. When Fallen, though ambition is high, the career is often interrupted and does not easily stand out, so it is better to switch to a path that suits your nature more. As for fields, real estate, culture and the arts, financial planning, fashion and beauty, and food and hospitality suit you, fields that need an eye for beauty and attention to detail.

The Career palace is where Sun sits best. Volume one says Sun is “best placed in the Career palace”, meaning Sun in this palace is the most fitting. The old books say “in a Temple position, both civil and military are good”, meaning that when it is in a Temple position (a Temple position means the star has strong force), both civil and military posts go well. In concrete terms, Sun belongs to the military-officer family, that is, the military-post path, which in modern terms points in four directions: soldier, police, judge and diplomat. Beyond that, state offices, public-sector work, media and management positions, any job that needs a “public image”, are all Sun's stage. The Tai Wei Rhapsody also says “Sun meeting Literary Talent in the Career palace, enters the royal court, wealth and rank complete”, meaning Sun and Literary Talent together in the Career palace let you enter the inner circle to work, with both fame and gain. In a Temple position the road to office is smooth, with a certain social standing; when Fallen (weak force), promotion is a struggle, and it is best to change profession or environment rather than cling on forever.
