The old books say “Treasury and Martial in the palace of wealth and home, and also carrying power and Prosperity, make a lavish rich man”, meaning that sitting in the Wealth and Property palaces and also having benefic transformations, you are a wealthy man who dares to spend. Treasury “meeting the Ram, Hindrance, Fire, Bell, Void and Robbery has success and failure”, meaning that when it meets the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery, money rises and falls, and keeping is the main thing.

Martial and Minister sitting in the Spouse palace: your partner is warm-hearted, modest and gentle, upright and practical. Martial here suits a later marriage; sharing the palace with Minister, the harmony between you is moderate, polite and courteous but with little warmth. Your partner mostly works in finance or management.

Martial and Minister sitting in the Spouse palace: your partner is warm-hearted, modest and gentle, upright and practical. Martial here suits a later marriage; sharing the palace with Minister, the harmony between you is moderate, polite and courteous but with little warmth. For a woman's chart: a husband a little older suits better. Your partner mostly works in finance or management.

Martial and Minister sitting in the Career palace: the core of the career is managing money and enforcing rules thoroughly. Accountant, auditor, finance director and bank manager are the trades that fit best. You work with care and order, and the place where you shine most is somewhere with institutions and systems.

Martial and Minister sitting in the Wealth palace: Martial takes care of earning and Minister takes care of managing, so your pockets are full and you manage money methodically, with a conservative style. Income comes mainly from a legitimate profession, there is often a noble helper to lift you, you earn and found a business through opportunities from noble helpers, and money builds up like water trickling drop by drop, not chasing violent profits. With the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery, money scatters easily and is hard to accumulate; when only the four stars Ram, Hindrance, Fire and Bell are met, you mostly earn through skill and physical effort.

Martial in the Temple or Prosperous position, its firm and decisive quality is fully brought out, execution and financial ability reach their peak, and in the real economy or finance you can achieve great things; this is the state of earning money at its best.

Martial is a Northern Dipper wealth star (governing money), representing money, the star with the heaviest wealth energy among the fourteen main stars, which is to say “the king of the wealth stars”. Martial has three layers of meaning: the first represents the military official, the second is a wealth star, and moreover the strongest among the wealth stars; Martial is also ranked with Emperor and Sun as the three noble-helper stars, so in life you easily meet noble helpers, and when trouble comes someone often helps.

Martial and Army Breaker sitting together in the Life palace: a wealth star (governing money) paired with a star prone to waste and destruction. The two military-official stars Martial and Army Breaker sharing a palace are called general stars in a fitting seat, meaning a general standing in the right position, who easily reaches great rank; military officer, military or police, judiciary and diplomacy are the positions that carry both discipline and authority and suit best. The character is firm and decisive, daring to take risks and daring to place bets.

Martial and Army Breaker sitting in the Spouse palace: the old books say a later marriage suits, and founding a family too early brings many setbacks. Martial itself carries a lonely energy, and is also called the Widow Star; Army Breaker's temperament makes people hard to predict, so the two of you easily see little of each other, and the marriage repeats itself - the Army Breaker entry in the “Complete Book” says “Martial in the same palace, harm three times”, meaning the marriage suffers repeated damage and is hard to settle in a single attempt; your partner is hard-natured and acts against convention. Marrying late, with each of you keeping your own space, is better; with benefic stars you may gain money through your partner.

Martial and Army Breaker sitting in the Career palace: two military-official stars meet, like a general standing in the right position, and the path of the military or police, the judiciary and disciplined forces suits best, bringing success more easily than purely desk work. The old books say Army Breaker in a strong position is especially outstanding on the military path, and with Literary Talent and Literary Arts added it stands out even more easily; with the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star it is very ordinary, suited to some small trade, keeping to your own station.

Martial and Army Breaker sitting in the Wealth palace: the Martial entry in volume two says “with Army Breaker in the same palace, east to west it goes, none at first and some later”, meaning money runs east and west to come and runs east and west to go, there is none at the start and only later is there some; volume one says “Army Breaker with the wealth star, money reaches the hand and turns to nothing”, and says Army Breaker “with Martial entering the wealth position, tilts east and collapses west”, so money that reaches your hand easily turns to nothing. Add Earth Void and Earth Robbery, and the Army Breaker entry in volume two says “adding Void and Robbery, extreme poverty”.
Martial manages the money and Treasury manages the storehouse; you are born knowing how to earn money, and even more how to keep it.

Martial in the Fallen position in the Wealth palace or its trine palaces, the firm energy of the wealth star is suppressed, the fortunes of money rise and fall markedly, earning is hard work, and a rigid manner easily makes you miss out on cooperation. You should soften your way of dealing with people, take steadiness and caution as the main thing, and not expand aggressively.

Martial in the Fallen position, its firm and decisive energy weakens, execution is reduced, the fortunes of money rise and fall markedly, and being too rigid easily makes you miss opportunities for cooperation, so you should soften your way of dealing with people.

Martial and Greedy Wolf sitting in the Spouse palace: the “Complete Book” says “Greedy Wolf in the same palace, marry late and there is no punishment”, meaning that if the marriage is put off a little there is no damage to the relationship; marrying early means “man and woman do not do well”, meaning that for either man or woman the marriage does not go smoothly and there are quite a few setbacks. Your partner is practical and skilled, and someone of a similar age suits you. With benefic stars you easily gain money through your partner; with the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery you lose wealth because of your partner, and the relationship also tends to grow distant for a long time. The original text in the “Wives and Concubines” chapter of the “Complete Book”: of Martial, “if ominous, marrying a wife loses one's livelihood”, and of Greedy Wolf, “adding the Ram, Hindrance, Fire and Bell governs separation in life”; the original text does not say whether they share the palace or shine on it from the trine palaces, nor does it distinguish bright from dim, so you must also look at which star it is and how they meet.

Martial and Greedy Wolf sitting in the Career palace suit best the positions that do real work, such as the army or the police; when the two stars are in the Temple position (strong stars) and also meet the Fire Star and Bell Star, you hold great power. For a woman's chart: when the pattern forms she can also stand on her own. The “Complete Book” also has a heavy saying, “Greedy Wolf in the same palace makes a corrupt official”, meaning that as an official you easily stumble over money and must hold your limits firmly; with the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added it is ordinary.

Martial and Greedy Wolf sitting in the Career palace suit best the positions that do real work, such as the army or the police; when the two stars are in the Temple position (strong stars) and also meet the Fire Star and Bell Star, you hold great power. For a man's chart: when the pattern forms it is most favourable for the path of real power, with mostly travel and running about outside, and a military-official star in the Travel palace is best. The “Complete Book” also has a heavy saying, “Greedy Wolf in the same palace makes a corrupt official”, meaning that as an official you easily stumble over money and must hold your limits firmly; with the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added it is ordinary.

Martial and Greedy Wolf sitting in the Wealth palace: the saying “Greedy Wolf does not bring success to a young man” describes exactly this - before thirty, earning has both successes and failures, and only after thirty do you see large inflows. The “Complete Book” says “Martial and Greedy Wolf in the wealth and property palaces, a sudden windfall of private wealth”, meaning that sitting in the Wealth or Property palace, money can suddenly grow large; right after it comes the line “avoid the Void”, meaning that empty stars are what you fear most, and meeting Earth Void and Earth Robbery it comes fast and goes fast. When the two stars are in the Ox and Goat palaces they are both in the Temple position, volume two says of Greedy Wolf “Temple or Prosperous, a sudden windfall”; the Martial entry also says “with Greedy Wolf in the same palace, wealth comes only after thirty years”, so there is no need to wait to meet the Fire Star, and the windfall comes after thirty.

Martial and Greedy Wolf sitting in the Wealth palace: the saying “Greedy Wolf does not bring success to a young man” describes exactly this - before thirty, earning has both successes and failures, and only after thirty do you see large inflows. The “Complete Book” says “Martial and Greedy Wolf in the wealth and property palaces, a sudden windfall of private wealth”, meaning that sitting in the Wealth or Property palace, money can suddenly grow large; right after it comes the line “avoid the Void”, meaning that empty stars are what you fear most, and meeting Earth Void and Earth Robbery it comes fast and goes fast. When the two stars are in the Ox and Goat palaces they are both in the Temple position, volume two says of Greedy Wolf “Temple or Prosperous, a sudden windfall”; the Martial entry also says “with Greedy Wolf in the same palace, wealth comes only after thirty years”, so there is no need to wait to meet the Fire Star, and the windfall comes after thirty. When Martial transforms to Prosperity (money coming in), the path of money is even more prosperous.

Every year, seriously cultivate three to five friends you can talk to honestly. This is far better than casually knowing a hundred people. You do not need to pretend to be cute, but now and then you can show a little of your soft side and say “I cannot manage this either”, and only then will people dare to come close to you.

The Fire Star and Bell Star meeting Greedy Wolf in the Dragon, Dog, Ox and Goat palaces: volume three of the “Complete Book” also has the line “Greedy Wolf meeting the Bell and Fire in the four Tomb palaces, a wealthy family estate, a marquis or earl of noble rank”, and this line originally discusses the life pattern.

The father carries a special weight in your life. He is mostly competitive, well known and able to shoulder responsibility, the first male model you saw, and the standard by which you later choose a partner largely follows from him. When the Sun is in the Fallen position (weak force), the old books say “in the Fallen position it harms the father”, and of the two parents the father is harmed first. When it transforms to Prosperity (money coming in), he is the most helpful person at several key turning points of your life.

The path of the father is a big theme in your chart. Your father mostly has the final say, has some standing outside, and expects a lot of you. The bond is not thin by nature; the difficulty is that the two of you are too alike in temperament: when young you would not let him manage you, and in middle age, because of that same hard temper, you gradually run out of things to say to each other. With your mother you are gentler, but if your mother is also strong-willed there is still tension. Meeting a strong superior is the same: if you stubbornly confront them, you mostly lose.

The path of the father is the biggest theme in your heart. You always want his approval, yet because you are so much like him you clash at the slightest thing. The bond is not thin by nature; the difficulty lies in temperament. If your father leans toward career, has the final say and expects a great deal of you, even hoping you will make something of yourself like a son - this pressure later becomes the drive that propels you forward for life. If things are tense with your mother, it is mostly because she is used to holding words back in her heart, while you are blunt.

The Parents palace with Seven Killings means a rather distant relationship with your parents, early independence, supporting yourself, and “I have not relied on my parents since I was little” is a common self-description. The books say bluntly that Seven Killings in the Parents palace “harms early, is far from the ancestors, and the six kin and blood relatives are lonely”, which in plain words means: the bond with your parents is thin, you leave home very early, and relatives rarely gather. But this same fact also leaves a way out: sharing the palace with Emperor and with benefic stars added it is “without punishment”, meaning there is no mutual obstruction; while meeting the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery, your parents are “not complete”, meaning there is something lacking in your parents' health or care, and this is an area to pay a little more attention to. With superiors too you lean toward being tough and easily clash with superiors and managers, the kind of worker who “will not bow”, so you should take the initiative to yield and learn to reconcile. The biggest lesson of this palace is “learning to bow your head”; if you keep holding firm, the path only grows narrower.

The Parents palace with Harmony means your parents are gentle and easygoing, living with them is light, superiors are fairly easy to talk to, and there is little feeling of being pressed down. The books say that when Harmony sits alone in this palace and is also in the Temple position (strong force), the bond with parents and children rarely has problems; sharing the palace with the Moon, both parents are alive and well, sharing with Heavenly Beam you either do not go against each other's wishes or cannot keep the ancestral estate, and sharing with Great Gate you do not get along well. If the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery are added, the bond with your parents is not complete, which in ancient times was called “bowing to parents a second time”, meaning being taken in by foster parents, becoming an adopted heir, or being raised by others when young.
The Parents palace with Harmony means your parents are gentle and easy to live with.

The Parents palace with Treasury: the “Complete Book” is very definite: “Treasury, both parents alive; with Emperor, also no punishment; with Integrity or Martial, in the Temple or Prosperous position no punishment; adding the Ram, Hindrance, Fire, Bell, Void and Robbery, it governs injury.” In plain words: your parents are both present and the bond is complete; sharing the palace with Emperor also brings no harm; sharing the palace with Integrity or Martial, as long as Treasury is in the Temple or Prosperous position (both strong positions), also brings no harm; but adding the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery is not very favourable for your parents. Your parents are calm and practical, and the family has a certain material foundation. This palace also reads superiors: the relationship is stable and dependable, you are easily trusted, but you mostly go by the path of seniority.
The Parents palace with Treasury, the old books say “Treasury, both parents alive”.
The Parents palace with Strategist means your parents are intelligent and the family values learning.

The Parents palace with Strategist means your parents are intelligent and the family values learning in education. The old books divide it into two cases: in the Temple position (strong force) there is no harm or separation from your parents; in the Fallen position and meeting the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery, the old books say “staying with two families, bowing to parents a second time, or becoming an adopted heir or live-in son-in-law”, meaning being sent to be raised in another's home, taking foster parents, or becoming an adopted heir or live-in son-in-law; mostly it is a matter of leaving your parents early and growing up with other elders, and it need not be seen in a bad light. Sharing the palace with the Moon or Heavenly Beam and without malefic stars, the old books say “with the Moon, escaping punishment; with Heavenly Beam, no punishment”, and with malefic stars added “it cannot avoid injury”; sharing the palace with Great Gate, “Great Gate, early punishment”, there is already an obstacle with your parents in childhood. In dealing with your parents you should be more flexible.

The Parents palace with Heavenly Beam: volume one says directly that Heavenly Beam “is the master of the parents”, meaning Heavenly Beam is itself the lead star of the Parents palace; it also says “in the Parents palace it is thick and dignified”, meaning the elders are substantial and carry authority. The family has accumulated virtue, a pattern of “a wise person sitting in command at home”. The “Complete Book” in several palaces mostly also writes “Heavenly Beam in the same palace, no punishment”, meaning that when Heavenly Beam shares the palace, relatives rarely obstruct or harm each other. However, this Heavenly Beam entry also makes other distinctions: sharing the palace with Harmony, “with the four malefic stars there is punishment, without malefic stars no punishment”; sharing the palace with the Sun, “harm comes late”, and with malefic stars added, “harm comes early as well”. At work it is the same: you easily meet older superiors who sincerely support you, a bond of teacher and student rather than of rank.
The Parents palace with Heavenly Beam, Heavenly Beam is the lead star of the Parents palace.

The Parents palace with Minister: the old books say “Temple or Prosperous, no punishment”, meaning that in the Temple position (strong force) there is no mutual obstruction with your parents, the bond is deep, and there are few setbacks of long separation. Your parents are loyal and generous, from a practical family background, and the family upbringing values trustworthiness and practicality; “be an honest person” is a line you heard from childhood on. The relationship with superiors is by the book, you receive basic trust, but the road to promotion leans conservative and a “jump-level promotion” is rare; you suit a stable organization, building trust gradually through long-term performance. With the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added it is “early punishment”, meaning that in early life the bond with your elders is already thinner, you seldom gather, and promises made by elders or family contracts easily run into changes.
The Parents palace with Minister means your parents are loyal and generous.
The Parents palace with the Sun: the Sun reads the father; whether the bond is deep or thin depends on the brightness of the Sun, the stars sharing the palace and the malefic stars.

The Parents palace with the Sun: the image of the father is tall, with good social standing, and he has expectations of reputation for his children; with superiors the relationship is open and formal, with little private friendship. Volume one judges this palace thus: “for a man, take it as the father's star; bright is auspicious, not bright harms the father”, meaning the Sun in the Parents palace reads the father, bright is good and dim harms the father; volume two also says “in general, to read the parents take the Sun as the father and the Moon as the mother”, and the Sun in the Parents palace of a woman's chart also reads the father. In the Temple position (the Temple position means this star has strong force) there is no obstruction with the father and he is an important noble helper; in the Fallen position (weak force) the old books say “harms the father”, and the opening part of volume two also says “the Sun in a Fallen palace governs first harming the father”, so of the parents the father is harmed first; with the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added, the old books say “harms the parents early”, and this layer of harm to the parents comes early. If the Sun and the Moon are both Fallen, that is the Sun and Moon turned against each other, the six kin are hard to rely on, and it is hard to depend on your parents; volume two says “if both stars are in the Fallen position, go only by the person's birth hour: born by day, the father remains; born by night, the mother remains”, so you must look separately at whether you were born by day or by night. With the Sun in the Snake palace and Great Gate in the opposite palace, both stars in the Temple or Prosperous position and also seeing a transformation to Prosperity, your parents have wealth and you inherit the ancestral estate; this is your parents' wealth and cannot be counted directly as income from your own business.
The Parents palace with the Moon: the Moon is the mother's star, and reading the mother is the closest fit.

The Parents palace with the Moon, reading the mother is the closest fit: the Moon is itself the mother's star, your mother is gentle and attentive, the atmosphere at home is warm, and it is a “mother-centred” kind of family, meaning the thread of affection runs through the mother. The books say that when the Moon is in the Temple position (= strong force, Fallen = weak force) mother and child do not obstruct each other; sharing the palace with the Sun and without the four malefic stars Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star, both parents are alive and well; with these four stars added, the old books say “adding the Ram, Hindrance, Fire and Bell harms the mother, otherwise one passes to another household and leaves the ancestral home”: harming the mother, or otherwise becoming an adopted heir and leaving the old hometown.
The Parents palace with Great Gate means there are often verbal clashes with your elders.
The Parents palace with Integrity means the bond with your parents leans thin; only sharing the palace with Treasury avoids this layer of obstruction.

The Parents palace with Army Breaker: the books say “Army Breaker harms early and is far from the ancestors”, meaning the bond with your parents is faint and you leave home to be independent very early; volume one also says “in the Parents palace, the breaker-general brings punishment and harm”, meaning this close bond leans thin and the two sides easily obstruct each other. The way to respond is “change the name, be sent to be raised, and escape punishment”, which in plain words means: change your name, become an adopted heir or be sent to be raised in another's home, and both sides are then at peace. Sharing the palace with Emperor it is “without punishment”, meaning this mutual obstruction does not appear; sharing the palace with Martial or Integrity, this situation comes earlier. Army Breaker in the Horse palace in the Temple position and also with benefic stars is called the heroic star in the Temple with benefic stars, and can inherit the father's ancestral estate; in that case it is not judged as scattering and separation. The relationship with superiors also fluctuates unpredictably, and it is hard to stay long under one person.
The Parents palace with Army Breaker: the bond with your parents is faint and you leave home early; each of you being independent and living separately leaves both sides at peace instead.

The Parents palace with Emperor: the old books give two words, “no harm”, meaning the bond with your parents does not easily suffer damage or early separation; sharing the palace with Treasury, Minister or Greedy Wolf without malefic stars added also has no such harm, and this is the most important point of this palace. Your parents often have standing, or a very strong presence, and high expectations of their child; with superiors, elders always carry a layer of hierarchy, and your attitude should keep some respect. If the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery are added, the bond lessens and you tend to grow distant; sharing the palace with Army Breaker, this distance comes earlier.
The Parents palace with Emperor: the old books say “Emperor, no harm”, the bond with your parents is not thin, and your parents have prestige and can be relied on.

The Parents palace with Greedy Wolf: your parents are lively and multi-talented, the atmosphere at home is light, and they are the “parents who know how to play”, meaning the kind who can watch TV series and play games with you; with superiors you are tactful and very resourceful, easily leave a good impression on superiors, and at work you are the type with “especially good relationships”. The old books give conditions for Greedy Wolf in the Parents palace: in the Fallen position it means “leaving the ancestral home early, bowing to parents a second time, becoming an adopted heir or live-in son-in-law”, that is, leaving the original home early, taking foster parents or becoming an adopted heir; sharing the palace with Integrity it is “early punishment, governing loneliness”; sharing the palace with Emperor and without malefic stars, your parents are “both alive and well”.
The Parents palace with Greedy Wolf: your parents like to have fun and are multi-talented, and you too are very resourceful with superiors.
Your parents are strong-natured, and in early life the bond leans thin.

The path of the parents is the main axis of your whole life. They are mostly substantial and dignified, there is not much conflict with you, and the real tension is that you always want to measure up exactly to the shape they expect.

The path of the parents is the main axis of your whole life. They are mostly substantial and dignified, there is not much conflict with you, and the real tension is that you always want to measure up exactly to the shape they expect. When it transforms to Fame (reputation), your parents are educated and have a good name outside.
Sitting alone, you gain blessings through being busy; sharing the palace with other stars, the blessing differs in each case.

Manage money conservatively and steadily; fixed-term savings or buying a house suit better; high-risk speculation does not suit you, and wealth relies on accumulation rather than sudden bursts. With the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery, or with Loss and Taboo, the “Complete Book” says “success and failure with no accumulation”, meaning there are successes and failures and you cannot keep money.
The Property and Wealth palaces are the two most comfortable seats for Treasury; the ancestral estate is kept, and what you buy yourself is also prosperous.

The Property palace with Seven Killings: the atmosphere at home is rather tense, everyone in the family is strong-willed, and living there is not very relaxing; “home like a small barracks” is common, meaning you cannot relax even in your own home; real estate changes a lot, you are not well suited to staying long in one place, and moving and changing homes is common. It is best to choose a more independent living space, leaving yourself enough territory of your own; “a place to breathe alone” is very important. The “Complete Book” has two further points: Seven Killings sharing the palace with Integrity, the Integrity entry says “Seven Killings in the same palace, buy it yourself”, so property relies on your own purchases; the Seven Killings entry says “meeting Punishment and Prisoner in the Property or Parents palace, parents are injured and the estate is hard to keep” (Prisoner refers to Integrity; Punishment refers to Heavenly Punishment, and one view says the Ram Blade).

The Property palace with Harmony: the books say “little at first, much later, buying it yourself is very prosperous”, meaning what the ancestors left is limited, property mostly relies on buying it yourself from nothing, and gradually grows in middle age. Sharing the palace with the Moon and in the Temple position (strong force) it can reach great wealth, sharing with Heavenly Beam it retreats first and advances later, and sharing with Great Gate there is little property. With the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star and Earth Void added, the books say “none at all”, and property cannot be kept. The same applies when it transforms to Taboo (obstruction).

The Property palace with Treasury: the “Complete Book” says “Treasury, fields and gardens flourish, the ancestral estate is kept and what is bought oneself is prosperous, and with Emperor great wealth”, which in plain words is: the house and land prosper, what the ancestors passed down is kept, what you buy yourself can also be afforded, and sharing the palace with Emperor it is even easier to accumulate a large fortune. Master Xi Yi ranks the Property and Wealth palaces as the “joyful temple” seats of Treasury, meaning Treasury is most comfortable in these two palaces. Sharing the palace with Integrity or Martial, the books say “keeps the ancestral estate flourishing”, and the ancestral estate is kept. Meeting the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery, property instead lessens and has ups and downs; meeting Earth Void and Earth Robbery, the family estate easily turns to nothing and the house is hard to keep; meeting the Left Assistant and Right Assistant, the ancestral estate grows more prosperous day by day.

The Property palace with Strategist: the old books have five words, “retreat from the ancestors, newly create wisdom”, meaning the estate the ancestors left mostly cannot be kept, and the family property has to be bought anew by yourself from the start. Sharing the palace with Great Gate, falling in the Rabbit palace there are farm estates, falling in the Rooster palace the ancestral estate cannot be kept, and the family circumstances are large at first and small later. The living environment changes a lot, with frequent moves or renovations. Sharing the palace with Heavenly Beam you acquire property and are comfortable only in old age, and sharing with the Moon, buying it yourself is best.

The Property palace with Heavenly Beam: the “Complete Book” says “Heavenly Beam in the Temple or Prosperous position has an ancestral estate”, meaning that in the Temple position (strong force) there is an estate passed down from the ancestors; sharing the palace with Harmony it is hard at first and easy later; sharing with Strategist, as long as the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery are not met, you end up with property. The ancestors give shelter and the family has a foundation. The rhyme also says of Heavenly Beam “in the Property or Siblings palace, to have it, blessings arise of themselves”, meaning that falling in the Property or Siblings palace, blessings come on their own.

The Property palace with Minister: the house is solid, the home is tidy and orderly, family members live together in a practical way, and “not a speck of dust in the house” is the basic tone. The Minister entry in the “Complete Book” says “Temple or Prosperous, has a share”, and Minister in the Temple or Prosperous position receives a share of the family estate. On the sayings for sharing the palace: the Minister entry says sharing with Emperor is “buy it yourself”, sharing with Martial is “no share”, and sharing with Integrity with the Ram, Hindrance, Fire, Bell, Void and Robbery added is “the ancestral estate drifts away”; but the Emperor entry says “Minister in the same palace, the family property is ready-made”, the Martial entry says “Minister in the same palace, ruin is seen first and property comes later”, and the Integrity entry says “Minister in the same palace, none at first and some later”, two views set side by side. It suits you to choose a place to live that leans practical, valuing whether the home works well, not how lavishly it is decorated.

The Sun in the Property palace: the “Complete Book” says of the Sun “in the Property palace, you receive the shelter of the forefathers' home”. The old books say that in the Temple position (the Temple position = a star with strong force) one “gets the ancestral estate, prosperous at first but not yet level”, meaning you mostly receive the ancestors' estate, but it is prosperous first and then turns ordinary, and keeping it matters more than creating it; in the Fallen position (weak force) and meeting the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery, fields and houses are “none at all”, meaning the Property palace is empty-handed and real estate cannot be kept. In the case of sharing the palace with Great Gate, the Sun entry says in the Tiger palace it is “flourishing”, in the Monkey palace it is “retreat from the ancestors, not without landed property”, while the Great Gate entry says “the Sun in the same palace, none at first and some later”, two views set side by side.

The Property palace with the Moon: this is one of the most fitting seats for the Moon. The Moon is itself the master of the Property palace, governing houses and land; the books say that in the Temple position (the Temple position = this star in a strong position, Fallen = weak force) there is a lot of property, and its ability to accumulate real estate ranks first among the stars. Sharing the palace with Strategist it is an estate you build yourself, and sharing with Harmony it is bought from nothing, all earned by yourself. The home is cosy and refined, and female family members have a large influence. If it is Fallen, and the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery are added, the books say fields and houses are “none at all”, and you must read every word of a purchase contract carefully.

The Property palace with Army Breaker: the books say “Army Breaker in the Rat or Horse palace keeps the ancestral estate flourishing”, meaning that falling in the Rat or Horse palace, the estate the ancestors left instead prospers; only that at the same time it says “seen with advance and retreat”, meaning there is income and outflow, and rising and falling by turns is normal. Falling in other palaces, real estate changes a lot, you move often and find it hard to stay long in one place; with the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star added it is “retreat from the ancestral fields, few fields”, meaning the ancestors' land cannot be kept and grows less and less; sharing the palace with Integrity it is “ruin first, then property is bought”, meaning that first there is one round of decline, and only later can you buy houses and land. Sharing the palace with Emperor, the Army Breaker entry says “the family property is ready-made”, while the Emperor entry says “Army Breaker in the same palace, retreat from the ancestors”, two views set side by side. When Army Breaker is Fallen, volume one says “in the Property palace in a Fallen position, the ancestral foundation is shattered”.

The Property palace with Emperor: the old books judge “flourishing, bought by oneself and prosperous”, meaning the family property flourishes, and the most prosperous part is what you earn and buy yourself, while counting on what the ancestors left is instead not the main line (sharing the palace with Army Breaker, the Emperor entry says “Army Breaker in the same palace, retreat from the ancestors”, while the Army Breaker entry says “Emperor in the same palace, the family property is ready-made”, two views set side by side); sharing the palace with Minister, the Emperor entry says “Minister in the same palace, the family property is ready-made”, while the Minister entry says “Emperor in the same palace, buy it yourself”, two views set side by side; the books also say “gaining the Left and Right Assistants, Literary Talent and Literary Arts”. The living place values style, and property can be seen as one of the main ways of accumulating. With the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery it becomes buying but not being able to keep, so buy property steadily and do not act in many places at once.

The Property palace with Greedy Wolf: the living place emphasises enjoyment and beauty, you like a life of quality: good furniture, fine wine and works of art are all indispensable; buying a home and spending on enjoyment happen at the same time, so your ability to save needs strengthening, otherwise it easily becomes “a very beautiful house and a very empty account”, meaning the house is beautiful but there is not much savings left.
In this Property palace, you receive the shelter of your ancestors.
The Property palace meeting Army Breaker: property is ruined first and made later.

For a man's chart: a person with the heroic star in the Temple position (Army Breaker falling in the Rat or Horse palace; the Temple position = this star in a strong position) has a imposing bearing and authority, and can achieve results in military posts such as the army or the police.

The Health palace with Seven Killings: the risk of accidents and injury is somewhat high. The “Complete Book” says of Seven Killings in the Health palace “many disasters in childhood, and in adulthood it governs haemorrhoids”, that is, in childhood there is much illness and misfortune, and in adulthood you need to watch for haemorrhoids. As for which organ is weak, the method is to look across the whole chart at which palace has the most concentrated and worst malefic stars, then match the organ by that palace's Earthly Branch (Rat gallbladder, Ox liver, Tiger lungs, Rabbit large intestine, Dragon stomach, Snake spleen, Horse heart, Goat small intestine, Monkey bladder, Rooster kidney, Dog pericardium, Pig triple burner); the style of reasoning that Seven Killings belongs to Metal and so judges the lungs is not used.

The Health palace with Army Breaker: the meaning of this star is “Loss”, that is, depletion: you easily overwork and drain your vital energy, and are also prone to external injuries and surgery. The “Complete Book” says of Army Breaker in the Health palace “in childhood boils, sores, pus and blood, thin and sallow”, and also says “in the Health palace it leads to a thin and weak constitution”, that is, many boils in childhood and a thin, frail body. (Matching organs must look at the whole chart: whichever palace has the most concentrated malefic stars, match by that palace's Earthly Branch; you cannot judge weak kidneys and reproductive organs just because Army Breaker belongs to Water.)

Self-made, late to flourish, able to surpass the previous generation; seek stability and do not speculate.
Self-made, late to flourish, money comes in and goes out, and you suit earning in lively places.
Self-made, money comes from lively places, and what you do is often not just one kind of work.
Self-made, money has to be earned in crowded, lively places; success comes through the mouth, and failure comes through the mouth too.
You look strong and decisive, but in fact you are hot-tempered, your emotions swing a lot, and when it is time to settle a matter you often change your mind.

To read Greedy Wolf, first look at which palace it falls in: falling in the Pig or Rat palace, the two palaces of Water, it is “Floating Water Peach Blossom”, meaning that by nature desire and passion are strongest; falling in the Horse palace it turns completely around, becoming a military-official star holding military power, a star of fiery nobility, with the power of life and death in hand, and in that case it should not be read as a Peach Blossom star.

To read health you must also look at the Life palace and the ten-year Decade you are passing through. When a ten-year Decade reaches the Health palace, health is the first thing to watch. In daily life live in moderation, eat until seven-tenths full, drink little alcohol, have regular health check-ups and follow your doctor's guidance.

What truly creates the gap is whether there are people at your side to help. The old books say “without the Left and Right Assistants accompanying, one is a lone ruler, and although the jade is fine it is not enough”, meaning that without the Left Assistant and Right Assistant it is like an emperor without ministers, and however good the jade, it does not become a precious object; it also says “if the Treasury, Minister, Left and Right Assistants, Literary Talent and Literary Arts, these benefic stars, gather, there is no one who is not noble”, meaning that when Treasury, Minister, Left Assistant, Right Assistant, Literary Talent and Literary Arts, these benefic stars, all gather, there is no one who is not eminent. So what the Emperor needs to practise is not suppressing a hot temper but whether you are willing to let others work alongside you: if you are willing to use people and can take in opposing opinions, the pattern can come down to earth as reality. The old books also say the emperor star brings blessings in whatever palace it is in, can suppress danger, can suppress the Fire Star and Bell Star, and turns Seven Killings into authority, so when trouble comes you can carry more than ordinary people, and are also easily pushed forward to arrange the situation.

If you really do go elsewhere, first settle the place where you plant your feet. Only when you live steadily can you get things done. In a long-distance relationship, do not rely on feeling alone to hold it up; when you see each other rarely, you must all the more discuss clearly how often you will meet and where you will eventually settle, and whether you can settle down is known by trying once. If you are married, before changing the city you work in, lay out the pros and cons and talk them over with your wife - you dislike speaking plainly, and whenever you fall silent the other person feels abandoned.
Army Breaker + Right Assistant means subordinates willing to take risks with you - a typical combination for a startup team.
Army Breaker + Earth Robbery means breaking and building is robbed: the fruits of your creation get picked by others (a patent contested, customers lured away, a brand imitated).

Army Breaker + Earth Void means breaking and building turns to emptiness: Army Breaker's nature is “break the old and build the new”, and with Earth Void added it instead becomes “break the old but not build the new”, so you need to actively set new goals.
Army Breaker + Heavenly Halberd means a female noble helper who helps you innovate: a female partner or female client may become the fulcrum of your reform.
Army Breaker + Heavenly Leader means a male noble helper who helps you innovate: often a male investor or a teacher who opens up a new world for you.
Army Breaker + Left Assistant turns Army Breaker's pioneering drive into the revolutionary power of a team - it suits leading a team on innovative business and opening up new markets.
Army Breaker + Literary Talent means pioneering + learning: a technical startup, research-style innovation and design-style reform are best.

Army Breaker + Literary Arts means pioneering + eloquence: you can clearly explain your own vision of “break the old and build the new”, and suit being a CEO, an evangelist, or a strategic-positioning kind of startup.

Army Breaker + Fire Star means fierce breaking and building: one violent transformation (quitting your job at once to start a business, jumping to another field), with big successes and also big failures.
Army Breaker + Bell Star, like the Fire Star, means fierce change, but more hidden - reform is nurtured over a long time and you strike only when the moment is ripe.

Army Breaker in the Temple or Prosperous position, its trait of reform and innovation is fully developed, its drive to act and to pioneer are both in the best state, and the pattern of “travelling all over the world” is fully displayed; the heroic star in the Temple, a man's chart is valiant and commanding.
Army Breaker in the Career palace is a military-official star, and breaking the old to build the new is its true colour.

A person with Army Breaker in the Life palace is rebellious, does not follow convention, loves freedom, has a faint bond with relatives, and has many setbacks in love. The temperament leans toward being solitary and self-reliant: you hear everyone out, then go home and still do as you please; you do not value profit too much, your frame is thin, and however you are fed you never put on weight. The “Complete Book” also says Army Breaker has a “body of the five short features, thick back, wide brows, slanted waist”, two views set side by side, and this base text takes the earlier statement as the main one; the body shape is a point where appearance is checked against the Life, and it must be checked directly.

A person with Army Breaker in the Life palace suits best relying on one skill to charge across the whole world; do not be old-fashioned, and actively embracing change is the proper path. The bond with relatives leans faint, and life holds many changes, but each change is a chance of “break first, then build”, meaning to tear down the old first and set up the new afterwards.
Army Breaker in the Life palace: a solitary nature, not valuing profit, a life of many changes, with an emphasis on breaking first and building after.
Army Breaker in the Wealth palace: money comes and goes fast, and whether you can keep it depends on the star sharing the palace.

Army Breaker in the Temple or Prosperous position in the Spouse palace or its trine palaces: your spouse has a personality of their own, the relationship is not smooth but full of passion, and the experience of pioneering together is instead the most precious asset in the marriage.

Army Breaker is the seventh star of the Northern Dipper, its transformed energy is “Loss”, meaning depletion, and it represents destruction, change, innovation and pioneering. A person with Army Breaker in the Life palace has a somewhat solitary temperament and does not value profit. The saying “carry a bowl of rice across the whole world” is tied to an example of a woman's chart with Army Breaker in the Wealth palace and Literary Arts carrying Fame: Army Breaker must wander outside, travel everywhere and make a living from technical expertise; this speaks of a professional strength in the Wealth palace, and not everyone with Army Breaker in the Life palace is like this.

Army Breaker's wisdom lies in “break first, then build”, meaning to break first and rebuild afterwards, creating a new pattern in the very act of breaking. Each change is a new beginning, and the key is whether you can rebuild quickly after the change.

Army Breaker in the Fallen position, its power of renewal decreases and its pioneering ability is reduced; act with even more caution in planning, and do not lightly abandon a stable situation to chase change; at this time solid accumulation matters more than a risky breakthrough.
Army Breaker suits going out into the world, and when its force is strong, charging forward outside opens a way.

Army Breaker: a star of loss, governing breaking the old and building the new, a solitary nature, not valuing profit; in the Fallen position and meeting malefic stars it governs leaving the ancestral home and parting from the clan.

Meeting the Fire Star or Bell Star forms the “Fire Star with Greedy Wolf” pattern or the “Bell Star with Greedy Wolf” pattern, meaning these two stars can set Greedy Wolf alight, and the career has a chance of a sudden burst.

Meeting the Fire Star or Bell Star forms the “Fire Star with Greedy Wolf” pattern or the “Bell Star with Greedy Wolf” pattern, meaning these two stars can set Greedy Wolf alight, and the career has a chance of a sudden burst. With Transformation to Power (holding power), your words carry real weight in your own field and you can stand on your own.
The ancestors' estate mostly cannot be kept, the home relies on buying it yourself, and you move often.

The ancestors' houses and land mostly cannot be kept, and you must rely on buying it yourself after middle age; the home favours enjoyment, and with the Fire Star and Bell Star you must guard against fire.
The ancestors' houses and land are hard to keep, and mostly you must rely on buying it yourself.
The ancestors' houses and land, you cannot keep.

The Fortune palace with Seven Killings: spiritual satisfaction comes from independence and self-direction and the sense of achievement that challenge brings, and a “fight monsters and level up” kind of life pleases you most; you do not like an ordinary, settled state, and “being unsettled in peaceful times” is a true portrait. The books divide Seven Killings in this palace into two paths, the original text being “Seven Killings in the Temple position enjoys blessings, in the Fallen position with the Ram, Hindrance, Fire and Bell, toils in heart and wears out strength”: with Seven Killings in the Temple position you may be busy, but the heart is at peace; with Seven Killings Fallen and meeting the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star, body and mind are tormented together. Volume one of the “Complete Book”, in its general discussion of Seven Killings, quotes the secret classic “Seven Killings dwelling in a Fallen place, in quiet brooding blessings are not born”, meaning that Seven Killings Fallen easily weighs and reconsiders, the heart is uneasy, and blessings cannot come out. Solitude is the base colour of this person's inner world, and living steadily even alone is the true colour of Seven Killings in the Fortune palace.
The Fortune palace with Harmony: a happy heart, with blessings and also a long life.

The Fortune palace with Treasury: the “Complete Book” says “Treasury, quiet and enjoying blessings”, meaning the blessings of this palace come from tranquillity; sharing the palace with Martial it is “harder at the start, peaceful, joyful and blessed in middle and later life”, meaning you are more tired when young and only enjoy it in middle age; once “the Ram, Hindrance, Fire, Bell, Void and Robbery, Loss and Taboo are added” it becomes “toiling through the days”, meaning the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery together with Great Loss and Transformation to Taboo press down together, and life is hard. The blessings of Treasury are exactly exchanged for the two words “tranquil quiet”: no show, an orderly routine, and something to lean on in the heart.

The Fortune palace with Strategist: the old books say “toil first, leisure later”, meaning that at the start you labour in heart and mind, and only in middle age are you at ease; this is the most important line for this palace. The inner world is rich and changeable, you like to think through all kinds of ideas and philosophy and enjoy the pleasure of thinking, but find it very hard to truly quiet the mind; the old books say a person with this life pattern often worships the Buddha and suits a quiet environment for pure practice, so has a strong interest in religion or fate studies. Sharing the palace with Heavenly Beam you enjoy pure blessings, and sharing with the Moon you live happily; if the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery are added, you run about all your life and cannot settle down. So what this palace needs to cultivate is a single word, “steadiness”, meaning to let the mind settle.
The Fortune palace with Heavenly Beam is serene and happy, able to enjoy blessings and also live long.

The Fortune palace with Heavenly Beam: in the “Complete Book”, each entry on the Fortune palace mostly writes of sharing the palace with Heavenly Beam “enjoys blessings”, “joyful”, “serene and joyful”, speaking of a leisurely and comfortable life that enjoys good fortune. This palace shows the true colour of Heavenly Beam most clearly: the heart is at ease, and when trouble comes you instead settle, mulling out the principle from the difficulty. You like philosophy, religion and the healing arts, things on the spiritual level.

The Fortune palace with Minister: the old books say “Minister, at ease and enjoying blessings, with long life”, meaning a comfortable life, blessings enjoyed and a long lifespan too; this is a rare seat of steady blessings among the twelve palaces. The spiritual enjoyment is very even, you pursue a practical, orderly life and do not chase excitement, satisfaction comes from reliability and stability, and “only a regular life brings peace of mind” is the core. The inner self is steady and not easily pulled off course by showy things, the kind of person who is “hardest to deceive”; the weakness is that the inner life is sometimes a little monotonous, so you can moderately cultivate some hobbies, and not let your days become a three-point straight line of “go to work - go home - sleep”. With the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added it is “the heart cannot be still”, meaning the blessings are still there but the heart cannot be at rest.

The Fortune palace with the Sun: the “Complete Book” says “the Sun, busy yet blessed”, meaning your blessings grow in busyness and in people coming and going, and whenever you have free time you feel unsteady. For a woman's chart: the Sun in a woman's chart is also the husband's star, the “Complete Book” says of the Sun “for a woman, it is the husband's star”, so the Sun also represents the husband, and the Sun in the Fortune palace of a woman's chart must be read together with the Spouse palace. For a woman's chart: the Sun entry for the Fortune palace in the “Complete Book” says “a woman who meets benefic stars brings in a worthy and wise husband and enjoys blessings; with the Ram, Hindrance, Fire, Bell, Void, Robbery, Taboo and Loss added, it is said her whole life is not beautiful”. Spiritual enjoyment comes from socialising, public activity and the feeling of being recognised by others; alone you easily feel empty and need a sense of presence from outside. In the Temple position (the Temple position = this star has strong force) the spirit is full, lively and optimistic; in the Fallen position (weak force) satisfaction is insufficient, and the feeling of giving a lot and receiving little affects your mood. For a woman's chart: in one example of a woman's chart, the Sun in the Fortune palace was very prosperous with Red Phoenix, and she married first; when the Decade reached the Fortune palace, the palace's heavenly stem was Yin Metal, making the star sharing the palace into Taboo, and as a result the couple has to this day only the name and not the substance.

The Fortune palace with the Sun: the “Complete Book” says “the Sun, busy yet blessed”, meaning your blessings grow in busyness and in people coming and going, and whenever you have free time you feel unsteady. Spiritual enjoyment comes from socialising, public activity and the feeling of being recognised by others; alone you easily feel empty and need a sense of presence from outside. In the Temple position (the Temple position = this star has strong force) the spirit is full, lively and optimistic; in the Fallen position (weak force) satisfaction is insufficient, and the feeling of giving a lot and receiving little affects your mood.

The Fortune palace with the Moon: spiritual enjoyment is rich and refined, you like a quiet, elegant and cultured way of life, the inner self is full of feeling, you have artistic taste and spiritual pursuits, and reading, sipping tea and being alone are all nourishment. The books say “the Moon in the Temple position enjoys blessings and joy”, meaning a person with the Moon in the Temple position (the Temple position = this star in a strong position) enjoys blessings and lives happily. In the Fallen position the spirit is prone to melancholy and sentimentality; with the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added you are now worried, now happy, and the heart cannot be still, and sharing the palace with Strategist you more easily think without end.

The Fortune palace is one of the most comfortable seats for Harmony. The books say “Harmony, joyful, with blessings and long life”, meaning a cheerful mood, with blessings and also a long life; sharing the palace with the Moon you enjoy blessings, sharing with Heavenly Beam you are serene and joyful, and sharing with Great Gate you worry much and enjoy little. The heart is quiet and not impatient, and you know how to be satisfied with small everyday things; this steady joy is exactly Harmony's strength.

The Fortune palace with Army Breaker: the books say “Army Breaker, toiling in heart and wearing out strength”, meaning the mind cannot stop and especially drains the spirit; with the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added it is “worried, not quiet”, meaning worries never end and you cannot settle, and volume one also says “in the Fortune palace, many misfortunes”, meaning troubles of the spirit are not few. Your inner self is free and unrestrained, your instinct resists being bound, and unchanging days will irritate you; the spirit finds its footing only in change. Sharing the palace with Emperor it is “peaceful and joyful”, meaning the heart is at ease and happy; sharing with Integrity it is toilsome, and sharing with Martial it is not very peaceful.

The Fortune palace with Emperor: spiritual enjoyment values quality, you like a lifestyle with style and have no interest in vulgar entertainment. Sharing the palace with Treasury or Minister, the “Complete Book” says of Emperor “Treasury and Minister in the same palace, auspicious for a whole lifetime”, and when sharing the palace with Treasury you must also look at whether the Left and Right Assistants are complete in the trine and opposite palaces, and this portion of blessing cannot be used to make up for marriage problems in the Spouse palace and the Fortune palace; sharing with Army Breaker, the Emperor entry says “Army Breaker in the same palace, toiling in heart, wearing out strength, uneasy”, while the Army Breaker entry says “Emperor in the same palace, peaceful and joyful”, two views set side by side. Self-respect is strong, you feel happy only when recognised by others, and this is the most central theme of this Emperor palace. The “Complete Book” says of Emperor in the Fortune palace “Emperor, thick blessings, enjoying blessings in peace and joy”, meaning the blessings are thick and life is peaceful and joyful. For a woman's chart: volume one of the “Complete Book” says Emperor in the Fortune palace “for a woman, is a temple of joy”.

The Fortune palace with Emperor: spiritual enjoyment values quality, you like a lifestyle with style and have no interest in vulgar entertainment. Sharing the palace with Treasury or Minister, the “Complete Book” says of Emperor “Treasury and Minister in the same palace, auspicious for a whole lifetime”, and when sharing the palace with Treasury you must also look at whether the Left and Right Assistants are complete in the trine and opposite palaces, and this portion of blessing cannot be used to make up for marriage problems in the Spouse palace and the Fortune palace; sharing with Army Breaker, the Emperor entry says “Army Breaker in the same palace, toiling in heart, wearing out strength, uneasy”, while the Army Breaker entry says “Emperor in the same palace, peaceful and joyful”, two views set side by side. Self-respect is strong, you feel happy only when recognised by others, and this is the most central theme of this Emperor palace. The “Complete Book” says of Emperor in the Fortune palace “Emperor, thick blessings, enjoying blessings in peace and joy”, meaning the blessings are thick and life is peaceful and joyful. For a man's chart: volume one of the “Complete Book” says of Emperor “for a man, the Fortune palace is a Fallen place”, which differs from the statement in volume two, two views set side by side.

The Fortune palace with Greedy Wolf: spiritual enjoyment is rich and varied, interests are broad, you want to get involved in every kind of food and fun, the craving for pleasure is very strong, and “never miss a joy in this world” is the basic attitude, meaning you do not want to miss out on anything fun. But the first line the “Complete Book” says about this palace is “Greedy Wolf, toiling in heart and uneasy”, meaning the heart is tired and cannot settle: the other side of liveliness is being unable to quiet the mind, when desire rises you cannot sit still, and the spiritual world is very rich but tends to float on the surface, losing depth in “trying everything”. If it shares the palace with Emperor it is “joyful in later years”, meaning blessings are enjoyed only in old age, the path of hardship first and ease later.

Be strict in managing work and gentle with people; these two must come together. Criticise only the task, then add a line of private concern. Each year, seriously mentoring one or two people is far more useful than making social-media friends everywhere. With friends of your own age, do not only meet them at work; take the initiative to arrange meals, ball games and mountain hikes. When someone helps you finish a job, remember to share the credit in front of everyone; you lose nothing, and you keep people's hearts.
A money-managing star sitting in a money-managing palace, the foundation in your hands is abundant.
A money-managing star paired with a general star: firm and decisive, you earn money in competition, but with toil and hardship.

Spiritually you pursue steadiness and security, like a life with guarantees, and find satisfaction in stable days and no lack of material things; you dislike risky excitement. You need to guard against the worry of being unable to hold on when malefic stars and the Taboo star press down together, as it wears away blessings.

Emperor + Right Assistant, like the Left Assistant, are both assisting stars, but lean more toward “soft power” - you do not need to confront head-on and yet people cooperate, persuading through temperament and the pull of your character. It suits best occasions that need “building consensus” (chairman of a board, head of an association, leader of an industry organisation).

Emperor + Earth Robbery means the throne is robbed: at a key moment in life you are prone to being “usurped” (framed at work, stabbed in the back by a partner). You should have a strong legal awareness and a strict sense of contracts.

Emperor + Earth Void means the throne loses its brightness + wealth is empty - a sign of a “lone ruler without salary”. A whole life of noble bearing but unstable fortunes of money, so you should concentrate on “rank” and not on “money”.

Emperor + Heavenly Halberd means support from a female noble helper. In your career there are often female leaders, female investors or female partners who prop you up at a key moment. You should actively cultivate a network of women, not just as social contact but as genuine bonds.

Emperor + Heavenly Leader means a noble helper who is an elder man supporting you. In life, at key moments there is always a man older than you and of higher standing who takes the initiative to point the way and give you opportunities. Grasp a few noble-helper opportunities after the age of 30, and you can leap several levels in one step.

Emperor + Left Assistant in the Friends palace is the standard pattern of “ruler and minister helping each other”: without assisting stars, the Emperor is a lone ruler who can hardly succeed. You are born knowing how to gather wealth and influence, subordinates are highly loyal, and at key moments noble helpers appear of their own accord. Your career should follow the path of a managing position + building a team; working alone instead suppresses your life pattern.

Emperor + Ram Blade is the classic pattern “Ram Blade clashing the Emperor's seat”: it means at least one major rise and fall in a whole life, and at least one major wrong decision. When young, especially avoid impulsive contract signing or investing.

Emperor + Literary Talent is the “literary nobility” pattern: you have not only the temperament of a leader but also learning and literary talent. It suits best the path of authoritative knowledge: a senior leader of the scholar type, a policy adviser, a leader in the cultural field. Writing, speeches and works can amplify your influence.

Emperor + Literary Arts leans more toward artistic skill and eloquence than Literary Talent does. You are good at expressing yourself in front of the public, at socialising and negotiating, and in a career that needs speeches, debate and diplomacy you are like a fish in water. Note that Literary Arts carries Peach Blossom, so a man with Emperor needs to guard against entanglements with the opposite sex.

Emperor + Fire Star: Emperor dislikes the Fire Star in the Health palace, and Fire overcomes Earth, which governs a hot stomach. This combination in the Friends palace governs a hot temper that angers easily, and the stomach and intestines often suffer from excess heat. In a career there is drive but you easily decide on impulse, and benefic stars in the trine palaces are needed to resolve this.
