Emperor + Bell Star means hidden anxiety: outwardly noble and composed, inwardly often tormented by self-doubt. After middle age there are easily heart and circulation problems, so managing your emotions deserves attention.

Emperor + Hindrance means delay + stubborn subjectivity: your good decisions are missed through hesitation. You should use the “seven-second decision rule”: any matter you are still weighing after seven seconds, just do it first and work out the rest afterwards.
Emperor and Seven Killings sitting together, the emperor star meeting a great general, the killing energy turns into authority; you dare to charge forward and are unwilling to live an ordinary life.

Emperor and Seven Killings sitting in the Life palace, the emperor star meeting a general star, the books say “meeting the Emperor, it makes authority”, meaning Seven Killings' killing energy is pressed down by the emperor star and turns into power of execution and decisiveness.

Emperor and Seven Killings sitting in the Spouse palace: your partner is strong, has opinions of their own, and neither of you is willing to yield. The books judge Emperor in the Spouse palace as “marry late and be harmonious to old age”, and Seven Killings as “or marry late and escape punishment”, both meaning that marrying a little later brings a marriage to white hair with less damage; founding a family too early easily hurts each other. Volume one also says Seven Killings in the Spouse palace is “a mandarin-duck quilt half cold”, meaning that even sharing a bed lacks warmth and the feeling leans faint. Your partner mostly works as a manager or runs their own business.

Emperor and Seven Killings sitting in the Career palace: heavy authority and rank, very good, meaning you hold real power in your hands, can settle matters, and are good at deciding under high pressure. The books say that when Seven Killings is in the Temple or Prosperous position (Temple or Prosperous = this star has strong force here) it is “a glorious military post with considerable power and rank, unsuited to scholars”, meaning that going into a military post you can stand out greatly with considerable standing, and it is not suited to being a pure scholar; it suits the military or police, surgery, financial investment, and real-power positions in a company. Emperor shares the palace with Seven Killings, and both of these stars also represent power.

Emperor and Seven Killings sitting in the Wealth palace: the books say “Seven Killings in the same palace with benefic stars added, a sudden windfall in the Wealth palace”, meaning that when benefic stars gather, a large sum can come in at once; if the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star or Earth Void and Earth Robbery are added, money cannot prosper and rises and falls unpredictably. Emperor with Seven Killings in the Wealth palace leans toward building your own career within a private company; if Power and Prosperity both arrive, you will not stay under others and will build a career yourself. Without Power and Prosperity meeting, it only means working in a private company. Seven Killings itself drains strength, money comes fast and goes fast, cannot be kept, and spending is decisive with little saved.

Emperor and Treasury sitting together in the Spouse palace: your partner mostly has a dignified appearance and a calm bearing, a temperament that leans hard, with a strong mind of their own. Volume two says Emperor in the Spouse palace is “marry late and be harmonious to old age, firm-natured”, and Treasury is “marry late and be harmonious to old age”, which in plain words means: these two stars say the same thing, marrying a little later brings a marriage to white hair, and your partner is firm-natured. Founding a family too early instead means a hard time wearing in to each other.

Emperor and Treasury sitting together in the Wealth palace is a life pattern of a master money manager. Treasury is a storehouse star, born knowing how to manage money and how to accumulate it. Volume two says “Emperor in the same palace, great accumulation”, meaning that with Emperor added the level of money is raised, the amount accumulated is very large, and income mostly follows rank and standing. A person with this life pattern spends in moderation, invests conservatively, with high long-term returns; and meeting the Left Assistant and Right Assistant is what the books call “an official who keeps the wealth”, a born role of managing money.
Emperor and Treasury sitting together, the emperor star and the storehouse star combined, a thick foundation for a whole life, with no lack of dignity.

Emperor and Treasury sitting in the Career palace is one of the strongest career patterns. Emperor governs power and standing, Treasury governs stability and accumulation. Volume one says “the Career palace meeting Emperor and Treasury, rich and also noble”, and volume two says “power, rank, fame and profit all complete”, meaning you have both money and standing, gaining both name and profit. A person with this life pattern works with planning and order, is good at overseeing the whole, can be trusted by those above and below, and suits the management level of a large organisation.
Emperor and Minister sitting together, a prime minister beside the emperor, a high position but the real power is not entirely in your own hands.

Emperor and Minister sitting in the Spouse palace: your partner is warm-hearted, modest and of good character; when looking for a partner, meeting Minister is best. The books say this combination reaches white hair together; your partner has a lovely appearance and a gentle, virtuous disposition, with a large age gap (the books say in one place that it suits finding someone younger, and in another that it suits finding someone older), and there are also examples of marrying within the circle of relatives. The marriage values order and moderation, stable but with little romance; with the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added, it turns into wearing each other down and hurting each other. The original text in the “Wives and Concubines” chapter of the “Complete Book”: Emperor “adding the Ram, Hindrance, Fire and Bell also brings punishment”, Minister “adding the Ram, Hindrance, Fire, Bell, Void and Robbery brings punishment and harm”; the original text does not say whether they share the palace or shine on it from the trine palaces.

Emperor and Minister sitting in the Career palace. The saying that Minister has high rank but no power refers to the case where the Life palace has Minister, or where a Decade or Yearly period reaches Minister, not to Minister in the Career palace; with Minister in the Career palace sitting together with Emperor, the Career entry in the “Complete Book” says “with Emperor, power and rank”, and the “Questions and Answers on Discussing the Stars” also says of Minister “in the Career palace, obtaining it brings glory; with it at the emperor's seat, there is a contest for power”. The books say that when Minister is in the Temple position (Temple position = this star has strong force here) it suits both civil and military posts, with generous income, and you need not be only a civil official; sitting with Emperor you mostly have high standing and act with integrity; in the Fallen position (Fallen = weak force) there are rises and falls, with successes and failures repeating. Meeting Literary Talent, Literary Arts, Left Assistant and Right Assistant, both power and fame can rise.

Emperor and Minister sitting in the Wealth palace: the books say Minister in the Wealth palace relies mainly on accumulation, while Emperor brings a fast inflow of money. The base is salary and income from a managing position, and occasionally there are times when inflows come fairly fast. Minister does not follow the path of outside money, and spending values quality and dignity. With the Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery added, money is easily lost and hard to keep, so do not put everything into speculation.
Emperor and Army Breaker sitting together, the emperor star holds back the destructive force, breaking first and building after, entirely with the help of benefic stars.

Emperor and Army Breaker sitting in the Life palace, the emperor star with the vanguard officer, is a life pattern of the “revolutionary”, which is to say constantly breaking up the old situation. This person is never content with the status quo for a whole life, always taking apart the old and opening up the new. Army Breaker's “destructive power” is taken in by Emperor and made into “the power of reform”, meaning that the momentum of demolition is led toward reform, and great things can be achieved amid change.

Emperor and Army Breaker sitting in the Spouse palace: your partner is hard-natured, acts against convention, and each has their own mind. Volume two says Emperor in the Spouse palace is “marry late”, meaning to marry a little later; sitting together with Army Breaker is “Army Breaker in the same palace, punishment and harm”, meaning the two of you easily hurt each other; the Army Breaker entry also says “both man and woman suffer harm, parting and gathering govern separation in life”, meaning that both men and women easily part and live apart for a long time; volume one says Army Breaker “in the Spouse palace is not straight, and governs a marriage of advance and retreat”, meaning the marriage is unstable, advancing and retreating again and again. A marriage made early is mostly repeated and the two rarely meet. Marrying late reduces the collisions, but the grinding-in remains.

Emperor and Army Breaker sitting in the Spouse palace: your partner is hard-natured, acts against convention, and each has their own mind. Volume two says Emperor in the Spouse palace is “marry late”, meaning to marry a little later; sitting together with Army Breaker is “Army Breaker in the same palace, punishment and harm”, meaning the two of you easily hurt each other; the Army Breaker entry also says “both man and woman suffer harm, parting and gathering govern separation in life”, meaning that both men and women easily part and live apart for a long time; volume one says Army Breaker “in the Spouse palace is not straight, and governs a marriage of advance and retreat”, meaning the marriage is unstable, advancing and retreating again and again. A marriage made early is mostly repeated and the two rarely meet. Marrying late reduces the collisions, but the grinding-in remains. For a man's chart, the books say “he should have an older wife”, meaning it suits marrying a wife older than himself.

Emperor and Army Breaker sitting in the Career palace: the career goes in the direction of pioneering and innovation, suits having a base where there are many people and much to do, and does not suit sitting at a quiet counter. The books say Army Breaker sharing the palace with Emperor has “a far-reaching reputation” and “peace of body amid noise”, meaning the name spreads widely and you stand firm in a lively place; in the Temple or Prosperous position (strong star force) it is “a glorious military post”, meaning that with a strong star the military path is especially outstanding, suiting technical work, the military or police, or positions that must make decisions. A whole life of many turning points, fame rises fast, but real benefit does not necessarily keep up.

Emperor and Army Breaker sitting in the Wealth palace: money comes and goes with a big hand. Army Breaker's transformed energy is Loss, speaking plainly it specialises in depletion; the “Complete Book” says Army Breaker “in the Wealth palace is like boiling water poured on snow”, meaning money is like boiling water poured over snow, entering the hand fast and melting just as fast, spending impulsively and without regret. Sitting together with Emperor it is “hard first, easy later”, meaning you are cramped when young, making do and patching together, and only after middle age gradually become well off. The Army Breaker entry in the “Complete Book” also says “in the same palace as Emperor, goes out first and is born after”, meaning money goes out first, and only afterwards is it born again.

Emperor and Greedy Wolf sit together only in the Rabbit and Rooster palaces, the emperor star standing beside the Peach Blossom star, a pattern of the “talented romantic”, meaning talented and fond of pleasure. This person has an eye-catching appearance, speaks well, is multi-talented, and quickly grasps the trades of the arts, entertainment, food and beauty.

Emperor and Greedy Wolf sitting in the Spouse palace: your partner is mostly lively in social settings, has a strong pull between people, and their looks and bearing are often admired by those around them; they may work in performance, food and drink, or beauty. Greedy Wolf is a Peach Blossom star, but there is one major principle: the true Peach Blossom lies in the Pig and Rat palaces, while in the Horse palace it is a military-official star; Emperor with Greedy Wolf sharing a palace occurs only in the Rabbit and Rooster palaces, not in the Pig and Rat palaces, so you cannot simply say that wherever you see Greedy Wolf, romance has many temptations. Before the marriage there may have been many acquaintances, and after marriage the two of you need to be more tolerant of each other.

Emperor and Greedy Wolf sitting in the Career palace: the path is mostly tied to dealing with people; sales, public relations, entertainment and food and drink all suit, and at work you are skilled at responding in every direction. The “Complete Book” says “Emperor in the same palace, a post both civil and military, power and rank not small”, meaning both the civil and military paths work, with considerable standing; in the Rabbit and Rooster palaces, meeting the Fire Star as well is even better, and volume one has the line “Greedy Wolf in the Rabbit and Rooster, meeting Fire makes a minister of state”, meaning Greedy Wolf in the Rabbit and Rooster palaces meeting the Fire Star can become a high official. Meeting the Ram Blade, Hindrance, or Earth Void and Earth Robbery as well, it stays at an ordinary level.

Emperor and Greedy Wolf sitting in the Wealth palace, the “Complete Book” says “Emperor guarding together, there is a ready-made estate, and the family livelihood grows more abundant later”, meaning that money leans toward keeping what is built, taking over a ready-made situation, and the older you get, the thicker the family foundation. Spending is fussy, you entertain guests generously, and pleasures of wine, lust, money and temper are where wealth leaks away. It also records “meeting the Fire Star, before thirty success and failure, after thirty a sudden windfall”, meaning ups and downs before thirty, after thirty you can gain a sum, and upheavals before middle age are hard to avoid.

Emperor in the Temple position, the dignity of the emperor star shows fully, and leadership ability and noble energy reach their peak. This is the state that shows the noble pattern of Emperor most clearly; on a high foundation it is like a fish in water, and fame and profit can both be complete.

The biggest test of Emperor sitting alone in the Life palace is what the “Complete Book” says: “without the Left and Right Assistants accompanying, one is a lone ruler, and although fine jade it is still not enough”, meaning that without the Left Assistant and Right Assistant it is like a king without ministers, and however good the material, it is not enough to use; this person is usually kind and generous, but deep inside leans toward solitude and does not much like dealing with people. A person with Emperor in the Life palace has strong self-respect, is subjective and stubborn, and loves the authority of leading; the Left Assistant and Right Assistant must serve as helpers for the pattern to stand firm. There is also one important point: the emperor star brings blessings in whatever palace it falls, can press down danger, can press down the Fire Star and Bell Star, and can also turn the clashing force of Seven Killings into authority; when meeting malefic stars, Emperor is the only star in the whole chart that can neutralise the malefic energy, and even without the Left Assistant and Right Assistant this ability to block disaster remains. As for appearance, the old books write a slightly purple complexion or white tinged with blue, a thick back and waist, a kind and mature person, modest and upright; the “Rhapsody on Form and Nature” says “Emperor is plump and full”, meaning the build is full and has weight.

Emperor and Treasury sitting together in the Life palace, the emperor star joined with the storehouse star, appear only in the Tiger and Monkey palaces, with Seven Killings in the opposite palace (the palace directly across), and form one of the most precious combinations in Zi Wei Dou Shu. A person with this life pattern has a calm and steady temperament, with both Emperor's leadership ability and Treasury's practical caution, works solidly and dislikes taking risks; the “Bone Marrow Rhapsody” says “Emperor and Treasury in the same palace, thick blessings for a whole life”, meaning the foundation is thick from the very start, and you do not have to wait until middle age for things to turn good.

Emperor and Minister sit together only in the Dragon and Dog palaces. The books say Minister's transformed energy is the Seal, that is the role of keeping the seal, a civil star governing rank and office, assisting the emperor; one view calls this a talented assisting star, like the prime minister of the heavenly court, suited to being an assistant, secretary or strategist. This life pattern has both the presence of the emperor star and the meticulousness of the seal star, and is born a core adviser, a deputy leader. There is also a view that Minister is in a high position without real power and often plays a supporting role. For a whole life you mostly hold a post in a large institution or unit.

A person with Emperor in the Career palace earns regular income, and accumulating gradually through rank and salary is the steadiest; starting a business is not impossible, but you must already have connections and resources, with helpers such as the Left Assistant and Right Assistant, because carrying it alone is hard to make succeed; this is exactly the taboo of “lone ruler without assistance” for Emperor falling in the career, meaning a king without ministers cannot hold up the estate alone.
Emperor in the Travel palace: when you go out you will meet noble helpers.
Emperor in the Life palace is naturally noble, and needs the Left Assistant and Right Assistant shining on it to become a general-king.
Emperor in the Children palace, your children carry a noble energy.

Emperor in the Temple or Prosperous position in the Spouse palace, the noble energy and power of your partner reach the highest level, the other person has fairly high standing in society, the marriage brings you a very large source of noble helpers, and it is a bond that others admire.
Emperor is a star of the official cap, and sitting in the Career palace is exactly where it belongs.

Emperor is the emperor star of the Dipper system, governing official rank and career. A person with Emperor in the Life palace is calm and grand on the outside, with enough presence to command a scene, and works in an orderly way. The main thread of a whole life is a single word, “nobility”, meaning social standing, official rank, voice and things of that kind.

Emperor in the Fallen position in the Spouse palace, the noble energy of your partner is reduced, their standing may not be as hoped, or the presence of the two sides is mismatched, the balance of energy in the relationship easily tilts, and more patience and tolerance are needed.

Emperor in the Fallen position in the Career palace, the noble energy in the career is only limitedly developed, there are many obstacles on the road to promotion, relying on connections is not as good as relying on real strength, and you should deepen your professional skills and exchange real achievements for standing.

Emperor in the Fallen position, the dignity of the emperor star is suppressed, noble energy is insufficient, and standing is hard to show fully. Between giving and receiving, balance is easily lost; you should replace strong display with practical modesty, and it is better to borrow the foundation of others to develop.

Emperor: the emperor star, governing nobility and rank, with the presence of a leader, suited to politics and large companies, following the path of regular income; subjective and stubborn; it needs the Left Assistant and Right Assistant shining on it to become a general-king.
Doing purely civil posts is not lasting; positions in practical affairs and technical work suit best.

Before marriage, if there is a chance to go on a long business trip, study abroad or work in another city, go decisively. This time of charging forward alone will be a source of your confidence later. If you are already married, do not put your whole self on your husband's path; keep a stretch of work that belongs to you alone, even if it is done remotely; there is nothing shameful in running back and forth between two places, while total dependence easily causes trouble. When you arrive somewhere new, take the initiative to get acquainted, invite people to a meal, and build a circle of support for yourself outside.

After marriage, when staying with your husband's sisters-in-law, both the elder brothers' wives and the younger brothers' wives, you need to take a little more care. Your natural presence easily makes others feel overshadowed. At family gatherings be more discreet, ask about their affairs a lot and tell stories of your own prestige little; lower your stance and trouble is halved. As for partnerships, what you most need to avoid is going into business alone with someone of the opposite sex; when feelings and interests are mixed, you lose on both sides in the end; if you really do partner, bring in a third person to be present and keep the accounts separate and clear.

You should marry a little later. Marry early and neither of you has yet rounded off your edges, and wearing in to each other is very tiring. The step of choosing a person is especially important for you; how the other person spends money and how they handle accounts should be talked through clearly while you are dating. Both of you are hard-natured, and in quarrels neither gives way; you can step back half a step first, and saying aloud what is unhappy works better than a cold face. Take the initiative to arrange the romantic atmosphere and rituals, and write anniversaries and small gifts into the calendar.

Before marriage, buy a small home in your own name. This is the most important advice, and even a small one must be had. It is not preparation for a divorce, but leaving yourself a support that no one else holds. After the wedding, even if you live near your parents-in-law, definitely live separately. Before buying the home, go over each point with your husband: whose name the ownership papers carry, who manages the household money, who you will live with later, and then write it down on paper.

Find yourself a hobby that has nothing at all to do with your status. Writing calligraphy, growing flowers, cycling, fishing, photography all work; in it you are no one's superior, just an ordinary enthusiast, and this outlet is more precious to you than any title. Spend half an hour a day without handling anyone's affairs. After middle age, if you cannot be happy for a long time, try sitting meditation, quieting the mind, or finding a professional to talk with, slowly moving your source of peace from other people's judgments back to yourself.

Give yourself a stretch of time of “not being the grown-up”. Allow yourself to be weak, allow others to take care of you, allow a few hours with no decisions to make. Find something unrelated to your status to do; writing calligraphy, growing flowers and photography all work.

At work you easily hold a stance. You quietly compete in strength with your peers, and press subordinates too tightly. I suggest you lower your stance by half a notch: be a little stricter in managing work and a little softer in treating people; keeping an important person matters more than winning over a person. Regularly find a subordinate who dares to contradict you to talk with, and ask where you are not right. When the company has a chance for a transfer you should seize it; such milestones are often the steps by which you rise; people older than you and in higher positions easily become a help, and are worth approaching actively.

Strong self-respect, but more outward-looking than Emperor, with more attention to how others see you and how society judges. In the heart there is warmth, a wish to help people, a liking for stepping in to assist, sometimes so enthusiastic that you do not look after your own interests. The “Complete Book” says of the Sun in the Life palace “a loyal, generous and upright person, who does not argue over right and wrong”, and also says this kind of person is “kind-hearted” and “likes to help”, meaning loyal and straightforward, not counting right and wrong, soft-hearted, glad to rescue people; so the Sun person hides no scheming, and joy and anger both show on the face.

In the Rabbit palace, the Sun is just rising and Heavenly Beam is in the Temple position (a star with strength), the highest pattern; in the Rooster palace, the Sun has already declined toward the west, with standing but not conspicuous, and Heavenly Beam's strength is still fair. The “Complete Book” says this is “the pattern of wealth and office for those born in a Yin Wood, Yang Water or Yin Metal year”, meaning that people born in a Yin Wood year, a Yang Water year or a Yin Metal year easily have money and rank, and you must also look at the heavenly stem of the birth year. Meeting Literary Talent and the Wealth Keeper forms “Heavenly Beam, Sun, Literary Talent and Prosperity meeting”, meaning that when these four stars gather, exams and career fame come easily. This life pattern suits best the judiciary, government affairs, education and public welfare.

In the Tiger or Monkey palace it is the pattern of wealth and office, with no worries about food and clothing, and a dignified and steady appearance. You are upright and keep your word, mostly manage yourself well, work in an orderly way, dislike risky speculation, and in a stable system you show your management talent even more; if Literary Talent and Literary Arts meet, there is added cleverness and skilful hands.

You need to actively create interest in life, and not let the relationship drift into a glass of plain water. Your partner is reliable in daily life, steady and dependable, giving you a sense of security. Meeting the star Minister when looking for a marriage partner is the most ideal: a loyal and trustworthy partner, a stable marriage; stability and blandness are two sides of one coin, and passion must be nurtured by both of you together.

If you want to go into partnership, first look for people in law, medicine, education and culture. They suit you best. Before starting, write down the division of duties: who manages the money, who manages the work, who decides; black and white on paper is more reliable than goodwill. The fault you are most prone to is managing everything, and by the end none of it is done; draw a boundary first and do not accept anything beyond it. With your siblings, do not contact them only when there is trouble; in ordinary days a meal or a phone call, because affection is something that is fed into existence.

If you want to go into partnership, find a practical partner who gets things done. You make the judgments and they take care of execution; first write down the capital contribution, the division of duties and the sharing of money in black and white, and do not rely on goodwill. With people of a hard presence, do not confront them hard; talk privately with each other, using your strength of reading people. When the women in the family fall out, living separately, each living their own life, is more comfortable than meeting face to face every day.

Note this: volume three of the Complete Book says “Emperor and Treasury owe everything to the Assistants”, with the comment “when Emperor and Treasury have both Assistants with them, and the trine palaces gather in harmony, there is wealth and rank for life”. Only when both Left Assistant and Right Assistant are present does the book speak of lifelong wealth and rank; it says nothing about whether a single Assistant star counts, so it cannot be taken as satisfied. Volume three also says “when Emperor and Treasury share a palace with no malefic stars intruding, a person born in a Yang Wood year enjoys good fortune all life”; there must be no malefic stars intruding and the person must be born in a Yang Wood year for this line to apply. Remember too that forming a pattern only describes the foundation of a whole life; when the Decade or Yearly period is poor, the storms that are due still arrive.

You need to practise managing your emotions steadily and not let impulsiveness cause mishaps. It is advisable to buy an accident insurance plan, take care when travelling, and cut back on high-risk activities. Seven Killings is hot-tempered and prone to external injuries, so the focus of looking after your health is keeping your emotions steady, living in a regular way and slowing your pace, while also having regular check-ups and following your doctor's guidance when you feel unwell.

Guard against impulsive investing that leads to heavy losses, and work out the risks clearly before you act. Seven Killings money comes from taking daring chances, but that is exactly why you must learn to hold on to it: the key to managing money in this palace is being bold together with enough reason.

With Seven Killings in the Wealth palace, you earn money through effort plus a little risk-taking, you have to put a great deal of strength into earning, and your fortunes in money also swing widely. Seven Killings and Army Breaker lean toward loss and toil; in everyday words, a lot of spending and a lot of hardship: busy running about, often working flat out alone with your head down, money comes in but cannot be kept, and that is the base colour of the Seven Killings palace. Not fearing hardship or tiredness is your greatest advantage, and both big gains and big losses can happen.

With Harmony in the Wealth palace, the book says “Harmony makes wealth from empty hands, late to flourish”, meaning your ancestors cannot help you, you mostly earn money yourself bit by bit, and it flourishes rather late, becoming clear only after middle age; sharing the palace with Heavenly Beam brings very strong wealth fortune, while sharing it with Great Gate makes money come and go unsteadily. If the four malefic stars Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star are added, plus Earth Void and Earth Robbery, you mostly build a livelihood with a craft or specialist technical skill.
With Harmony in the Wealth palace, you earn money yourself from empty hands, and it flourishes rather late.

With Treasury in the Wealth palace, this is one of the most comfortable positions for Treasury. The Wealth section of volume two in the Complete Book says “Treasury brings ample riches; meeting Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery brings success and failure”, which in plain words means: Treasury seated in Wealth keeps your hands always well supplied; meeting Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void or Earth Robbery brings success and failure, with unpredictable ups and downs.

With Strategist in the Wealth palace, the old books put it very truthfully: “Strategist earns by wearing out heart and strength”, meaning you earn money by using your brain, and it is not earned easily; sharing the palace with Heavenly Beam, you use clever tricks to earn extra beyond your main career; sharing it with Moon in the Fallen position (weak star strength), income swings widely; if Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery are added, your whole life has success and failure, money comes and goes, and it is hard to accumulate and keep over the long term.

With Heavenly Beam in the Wealth palace, money mostly comes from learning or from serving others, and the Complete Book calls Heavenly Beam in the Wealth palace “ample riches”. Invest steadily and do not take risks; earning through specialist skills, service or learning suits you best.

With Minister in the Wealth palace, the old books say “Minister brings ample riches”, meaning food, clothing and spending are never lacking; sharing the palace with Emperor, “wealth arrives unexpectedly”, meaning a large sum can come in all at once; sharing it with Integrity, “wealth is made through trade”, meaning money mostly comes from buying and selling; sharing it with Martial and adding Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star, “a hundred trades produce wealth”, earning money by craft. Minister's money mostly comes out of relationships and position, built up gradually on trust rather than gambling on risk. Income is stable, mainly thanks to a steady salary and long-term saving, and working for a salary suits you more than opening your own business.

Sun in the Wealth palace is windfall wealth: running your own business, being the boss, you cannot know in advance how much you will earn next month; Emperor and Strategist are regular wealth, meaning you work for others and draw a fixed salary, which is called regular wealth. To truly be your own boss, you must also see whether Power and Prosperity meet in the Wealth palace (Wealth Keeper also counts as Prosperity): when Power and Prosperity meet, you will certainly enter Wealth, go into a career and be the boss. The old books say “Sun in Temple is abundant and sufficient, in a Fallen palace it is toilsome and not as wished”, meaning that when it enters Temple (Temple = the star has strength) the road to money is bright and your hands are generous, while in the Fallen position (weak) money comes and goes and you work half a day for little harvest. Volume one says that when Sun is in the Wealth palace in a prosperous position and helped by benefic stars, “it need not fear Great Gate's entanglement, and wealth and rank last long”, meaning it does not fear Great Gate coming to tangle things and wealth and rank can be sustained for a long time; when it shares the palace with Great Gate, the Sun section says “sharing a palace with Great Gate, success and failure at the start, not yet comfortable in mid-life”, meaning there is success and failure early on and by middle age your hands are still not generous; the Great Gate section in turn says “sharing a palace with Sun in Temple, you keep the family estate”, meaning that with Sun in Temple sharing the palace you can keep and build a family fortune, and both views exist side by side.

With Moon in the Wealth palace, the book says that when it enters Temple (= strength, Fallen = weak) the storehouse is full and the cabinets are solid, making it one of the stars best at gathering wealth; sharing the palace with Wealth Keeper and adding Left Assistant and Right Assistant makes great wealth even easier; sharing it with Harmony, wealth is strong and you are well looked after; sharing it with Strategist, you make wealth from empty hands and found a household. Moon also governs the Property palace, so money mostly comes from real estate or steady saving; in the Fallen position there is success and failure, arriving fast and leaving just as fast.

With Army Breaker in the Wealth palace, money coming and going is a common thing. The meaning of the Army Breaker star is loss and breakage, like Seven Killings, both costly and toilsome, with money moving in and out fast and hard to keep. But you must distinguish Temple from Fallen (Temple = strength, Fallen = weak): the book says “Army Breaker in the Rat or Horse palace mostly stores up much gold, silver and jewels”, meaning that when it falls in the Rat or Horse palace you can keep gold, silver and wealth, and the Dragon and Dog positions are Prosperous so wealth fortune is also strong; only when Fallen does it “break the ancestors and fail to gather”, meaning the ancestral estate cannot be kept. Volume one speaks generally of Army Breaker “in Wealth like boiling water poured on snow”, without distinguishing Temple from Fallen, meaning money is like hot water on snow, gone in a moment; this differs from volume two's “mostly stores up gold, silver and jewels” for the Rat and Horse palaces, and both views exist side by side; for this foundation, read it by volume two, which divides by palace position.

With Emperor in the Wealth palace, the old books use the four words “abundant and well-stocked storehouses”, meaning the storehouse is brimming and money and grain are never short, so it is not a case of having status but no money; sharing the palace with Minister, money is kept; sharing it with Army Breaker, hard first and easy afterwards. The essential point is the nature of how you earn: Emperor takes the regular wealth road, working for others and drawing a fixed salary, with income rising along with rank and position, so a promotion improves your wealth fortune better than speculation.

With Greedy Wolf in the Wealth palace, desires are strong, spending is heavy, and money comes in unevenly in both timing and amount. The old books say of this palace “Temple or Prosperous brings sudden fortune, the Fallen position brings poverty”, meaning that when Greedy Wolf is in Temple (the star has strength in this position) you easily get a sudden sum, while in the Fallen position (weak) your hands are tight; the old books also point out “meeting Fire Star, thirty years of success and failure first, then thirty years of sudden fortune”, meaning that a person who meets Fire Star will often see profit one moment and loss the next before thirty, and money truly comes in after thirty.
Wealth is one of the most comfortable positions for Treasury, with your hands always well supplied all life; meeting Wealth Keeper and Martial makes great wealth even more likely.
The star with the heaviest wealth energy, resolute and decisive, but somewhat solitary by nature, and it is happiest meeting Wealth Keeper.

The road to money generally rises, but if it meets Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star or Earth Void and Earth Robbery, the book says “there is success and failure”, meaning there are ups and downs along the way and it is not smooth all the way through. The best way to earn is through advancing in your career and raising income by leading people, not through risky speculation. With Emperor and Treasury seated in Wealth, you mostly join a private company as a manager, and the company does not necessarily belong to you: managing money, holding power and owning a business yourself are three different matters.
The road to money must be judged by the stars sharing the palace.

Wealth fortune swings widely; do not be too conservative, because taking the initiative will bring you more. When Fire Star and Bell Star are met, volume three of the Complete Book says “Army Breaker with Fire Star and Bell Star means running about and toiling”, so money has to be earned by running around and working hard. Power alone cannot yet be called being your own boss; only when Power and Prosperity meet (Wealth Keeper also counts as Prosperity) do you run your own career and be the boss.
Greedy Wolf + Right Assistant: governs subordinates cooperating + Peach Blossom being strong, best suited to work that leans on relationships and needs a team to fight together.
Greedy Wolf + Earth Robbery: governs desires being robbed, what you want is always one step short, and you need to cultivate the wisdom of “letting go”.
Greedy Wolf + Earth Void: is the “Greedy Wolf broken pattern”, where desire is emptied and turns refined and noble; devoting yourself to study or art can accomplish great things.
Greedy Wolf + Heavenly Halberd: governs a female noble helper who helps you expand, and through relationships with women you open up a new world.
Greedy Wolf + Heavenly Leader: governs a male noble helper who opens up Peach Blossom or career for you, possibly a male teacher who brings you into some circle of relationships.
Greedy Wolf + Left Assistant: governs Peach Blossom + wide relationships, with a very strong social ability, and receiving guests, public relations and sales are best.
Greedy Wolf + Literary Talent, governs artistic skill + learning — the arts, performing, design and creative fields are best.

Greedy Wolf + Literary Arts: governs artistic skill + eloquence, and the performing world, hosts, training instructors and KOLs are best. Note that Greedy Wolf + Literary Arts carries very heavy Peach Blossom, so you need a steady love life.

Greedy Wolf + Fire Star = **Fire Star with Greedy Wolf pattern**! This is the classic sudden-wealth pattern, governing big money arriving abruptly. But beware of “rising fast and falling fast”, and lock in profits in good time.

Greedy Wolf + Bell Star = **Bell Star with Greedy Wolf pattern**! In the same class of sudden-wealth patterns as Fire Star with Greedy Wolf, but its energy is more hidden and lasting. It suits long-term investment planning.

Greedy Wolf transforming to Power in the Wealth palace or its trine and opposite palaces turns desire into the power to grip and make wealth, able to organise your social circle, relationships and talents into a real business map; it is the inborn pattern of an entertainment-industry boss, the founder of a food brand, or a sales director. You need self-discipline in spending, otherwise the more you earn the more you will spend.

Greedy Wolf transforming to Power in the Life palace upgrades desire and the wish to control together, giving a very strong sense of leading in your career; in business or the arts you can take charge of a whole side on your own, with a strong urge to start your own venture.

Greedy Wolf transforming to Power: governs the Peach Blossom star (true Peach Blossom lies only in Pig and Rat; in Horse it counts as a military official star, so do not casually read it as Peach Blossom), with many talents and social skill, empty show early and achievement in old age, and when it meets Fire Star and Bell Star it flourishes unexpectedly through natural talent.
Greedy Wolf in the Career palace counts as a military official star and is not read as the Peach Blossom star.

With Greedy Wolf in the Health palace, the old books say that if it meets Ram Blade, Hindrance, Great Gate or malefic stars, there is illness from drink and sex; which organ needs attention is found by looking at the earthly branch of the palace where malefic stars gather most in the whole chart.

With Greedy Wolf seated in the Life palace, you are multi-talented with strong desires, and how Peach Blossom is read depends on the stars sharing the palace and shining on it. The Complete Book says Greedy Wolf “only prospers when meeting Fire Star and Bell Star”; meeting Fire Star and Bell Star is read separately for making wealth.
With Greedy Wolf seated in the Wealth palace, money comes unevenly.

Greedy Wolf in Temple or Prosperous (the Tomb palaces Ox and Goat) holding the Wealth palace opens up both talent and social wealth fortune fully, and when it meets Fire Star or Bell Star sharing the palace it forms the “Fire Star with Greedy Wolf pattern” or “Bell Star with Greedy Wolf pattern”, among the patterns with the strongest natural burst of power of all 14 main stars, with a clearly higher chance of an unexpected windfall than other stars.

Greedy Wolf in Temple or Prosperous (the Ox and Goat palaces) brings Peach Blossom and talent to their peak, but Greedy Wolf in the Horse palace turns into a military official star (Fire noble), and it is worth noting that Greedy Wolf in the Horse palace should not be casually read as Peach Blossom, and suits the political and military path better; Greedy Wolf in the Rat palace (Pig) is the true pattern of the Peach Blossom drifting on water life.

Greedy Wolf is the Northern Dipper's star of relieving disaster, also called the “true Peach Blossom, the star of desire”, meaning the most typical Peach Blossom star (governing romantic ties) and the star with the strongest desires, governing desire, talent, social life, and wine, sex, money, temper and gambling. Put bluntly, all five of wine, sex, money, temper and gambling fall within Greedy Wolf's range: a person with Greedy Wolf in the Life palace is born with attraction and many-sided talent, but easily indulges in pleasure and finds it hard to concentrate on one thing. The temperament leans toward hardness, and the old books say “hard in nature, fierce and awe-inspiring, deep in mind and far in planning”, meaning a firm temperament, a deep heart and long-range thinking; likes and dislikes both come quickly, and once a view is set you easily act on feeling.

Greedy Wolf: governs the Peach Blossom star (true Peach Blossom lies only in Pig and Rat; in Horse it counts as a military official star, so do not casually read it as Peach Blossom), with many talents and social skill, empty show early and achievement in old age, and when it meets Fire Star and Bell Star it flourishes unexpectedly through natural talent.
You spend heart and strength earning money, use clever tricks to earn extra on the side, and change course several times before building a livelihood.
You earn money through fighting and competing, with big swings in and out and no peace.

When going into partnership with others, the thing to fear most is mixing up the ledger of feelings with the ledger of interests. If you truly work together, divide it by project, one ledger per matter, with capital, division of work and sharing of money written down clearly beforehand, and when you discuss money put sisterly feeling aside, and the work will last longer. When people come to pour out their troubles, set yourself a time limit, listening for half an hour is fine, and do not carry other people's affairs as worries in your own heart. When you fall out with the women in your family, each living their own life is easier than meeting every day.

On how to get along with people, the old books have a very true line: “the deeply close grow faint, the faint grow deep again”, meaning a warm relationship at the start easily cools, while someone cold at first becomes a lasting friend. When young, energy scatters easily and sinks into pleasure and romance; after middle age you gradually focus, and your talent begins to turn into practical results. Curiosity is strong and you always have enthusiasm for new things, and you are born suited to being an artist or a founder who builds on relationships. The biggest lesson of growing up is “restraining desire”, put plainly managing the force of your own wanting: Greedy Wolf energy is in itself neither good nor bad, the key is where you channel it; used for a career it is the drive to start a venture, used for romance it is overflowing Peach Blossom, and used for pleasure it is drinking and playing and not coming home.

With your siblings, you can take the initiative to lower yourself half a step. Do not rush to decide family matters for everyone; first ask “how would you all like to do it”. If you want to go into partnership, set firm rules before shaking hands: how money is split, whose word decides, how to withdraw, all written out in black and white, because relying on a verbal understanding is burying a mine. The least troublesome division of work is for you to set the direction and the other person to handle execution, and do not let two people stare at the same area of work.

When going into partnership with brothers or friends, you are advised to bring the accounts and the division of work into the light. Write down in black and white who puts in money, who puts in effort, and how it is split. People like you should most avoid small moves behind the back and dealings under the table, which cannot be hidden and will sooner or later be exposed. The smoothest way to cooperate is for you to front it and them to carry it out, appearing together to the outside while each manages one area inside.

With female friends, draw clear boundaries. Your sensitivity, when the other person falls into a low emotional moment, is easily read as ambiguity, and the distance that needs keeping must be kept. If you are already married, you should all the more act openly: when you arrange to meet, invite others along, tell your wife beforehand, which is less trouble than explaining afterwards. If someone drags you in as a go-between, you may listen, but do not step in to take a stand; deciding for other people in the end leaves both sides unhappy with you.

With family, you can take the initiative to yield a little face. Do not rush to decide for everyone; first ask “how would you all like to do it”. When working in partnership, choose people all the more carefully: with Emperor in the Siblings palace, your partners mostly have a strong presence, each with their own ideas, quietly competing in strength, and in the end often cannot even stay friends. Give priority to finding people who complement each other, with you setting strategy and the other handling execution; a combination in which both want to hold the helm will sooner or later run into trouble.

With male friends, you are advised to bring your boundaries into the light. Have a third person present at meetings, make no private arrangements in the evening, and keep your dealings undisguised. With female friends, consciously lower your posture, stand up to support them many times and correct them little; choosing two or three close friends who also have ambition to build something is more useful than knowing a hundred social acquaintances.

The Dragon and Dog palaces are called the Heavenly Net and Earthly Net, positions of restraint. The book says Emperor here has just enough strength to use but not the strongest, and Minister in the Dragon and Dog palaces is in a leisure palace (ordinary strength), able to get things done but with constraints; the book also says that in the Dragon and Dog palaces, when Emperor has enough strength and sits together with Minister, a person born in a Yin Wood, Yin Earth, Yang Wood, Yang Metal or Yin Water year counts as the wealth-and-office pattern, with support for both money and status. The book also has a general saying: when Literary Talent, Literary Arts, Left Assistant and Right Assistant gather, you can rise to a high level.

With Seven Killings in the Travel palace, you can take charge of a whole side when you go out, and suit charging ahead in fiercely competitive fields such as the military police, finance, sales and starting a business. The book says of Seven Killings “few days at home, many days outside”, meaning far more time is spent outside than at home; sharing the palace with Martial is “fortunate in movement”, meaning things go smoothly once you get moving; sharing it with Integrity is “wealth made outside”, meaning money is earned elsewhere; sharing it with Emperor is “often fulfilling ambition outside”, meaning that going out makes it easier to realise your aspirations. These lines all say the same thing: stepping outside goes smoothly. In other places you stand your ground on decisiveness and real ability. If the Life palace is precisely Emperor and Treasury sharing the palace in the Tiger palace or the Monkey palace (the Travel palace being Seven Killings), it is called Emperor and Treasury seated in the garden and is read as being near the emperor and assisting a superior; this pattern and the pattern of Seven Killings seated in the Life palace with Emperor and Treasury in the Travel palace, namely “Seven Killings facing the Dipper”, are two ends and must be viewed separately, and both must fall at an age fitting one's station before they are spoken of this way; the Complete Book and the Bone Marrow Rhapsody record side by side “Seven Killings facing the Dipper, rank and salary flourish; Emperor and Treasury sharing a palace, lifelong deep blessing”. Conversely, adding Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery makes “worry and unrest, or drifting to the ends of the earth”, meaning unsettled running around outside, inner unease and plenty of gossip and disputes.
With Harmony in the Travel palace, you easily meet noble helpers who lift you up when you go out.

With Harmony in the Travel palace, you often meet noble helpers when you go out, the environment is mild, and there are few great storms; the book says that sharing the palace with Heavenly Beam brings the affection of noble helpers and deep blessing, sharing it with Great Gate brings worry, and sharing it with Moon brings toil; the Moon section alone says otherwise, that when Moon and Harmony share a palace in a Temple or Prosperous place, you can earn money from empty hands outside, build a career and found a family, and both views exist side by side. If Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery are added, you will find it hard to be satisfied outside, running back and forth with limited returns.

For Treasury in the Travel palace, the Complete Book opens with “Treasury meets noble helpers when going out”, meaning you easily meet people to help you when you go out; it then says that sharing the palace with Integrity or Martial earns money in lively, crowded places and can do big business. So going out is not only steady but you easily meet people willing to give you a hand, and do not read Treasury as only able to guard the family estate. You suit growing in solid fields such as finance, government and banking, and your wealth outside is secure too. In volume one, the section “On whether a person has an art skill” has a poem: “Strategist and Minister in the Life and Body palaces, the emperor's decree and wealth star entering the tomb, if Treasury is in the Travel palace, all life you will surely follow an unusual trade.” Besides Treasury in the Travel palace, both layers, “Strategist and Minister in the Life and Body palaces” and “the emperor's decree and wealth star entering the tomb”, must be present before you speak of an unusual trade; with only Treasury in the Travel palace, you do not judge by this line. Meeting Earth Void and Earth Robbery, you easily lose wealth when going out; meeting Left Assistant and Right Assistant, you rise step by step.

With Strategist in the Travel palace, the old books are very clear: you easily meet noble helpers who guide you when you go out, while at home there is more gossip and dispute, so jobs that often involve business trips and running about suit you. Outside, your ability to adapt is strong and you adjust very quickly when the environment changes; sharing the palace with Heavenly Beam, going out goes as you wish, and sharing it with Moon, you still make a gain amid the busyness. But if Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star are added, there are many disputes outside and you are not at peace, so you must arrange everything fully before you leave. Meeting Earth Void and Earth Robbery, the trip is made in vain with nothing gained, and going too far does not suit you.

With Heavenly Beam in the Travel palace, the Complete Book says plainly “Heavenly Beam going out is near noble helpers, and noble helpers bring completion”, meaning you easily get close to noble helpers when you go out, things succeed through them, and at the crucial moment someone always catches you; sharing the palace with Harmony brings deep blessing, and sharing it with Strategist takes the path of craft and technical skill. It suits building careers elsewhere that rest on virtue and specialist knowledge, such as medicine, law, education and religion.

With Minister in the Travel palace, the old books say “going out, noble helpers lift you up”, meaning that outside there are naturally people who give you a pull and point you the way. When Minister in the Travel palace is in the Fallen position and shares the palace with Ram Blade in the Fallen position, there is a chart read this way: the person going to a foreign place is on the road to death, that is, danger outside and good fortune in the home town. Progress goes smoothly in large institutions or official settings; outside, you are good at assisting, suited to administrative, legal and compliance work and being sent out, taking the road of the “strategist stationed outside”. It is best to choose an environment with an organisation backing you, and not to be alone, since Minister is not good at starting from zero. When Integrity and Minister share the palace and Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star are added, you easily stir up disputes outside, meet petty people, and have no help. Meeting Earth Void and Earth Robbery, paperwork goes wrong outside, and contracts and seals must be guarded closely.

With Sun in the Travel palace, the old books say “it is best to go out and develop blessings, and you cannot bear to sit still and guard”, meaning blessings come from going out, while sitting still and not moving ties yourself down; volume one also says of this palace “hard to receive the ancestral estate, moving the root and changing the leaf, leaving the clan to set up a home”, meaning the ancestors' livelihood does not reach your hands and you must leave your old home to set up your own household. You have noble helpers outside, and a name made elsewhere is easy to build, suiting public affairs or fields with constant social contact. If Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery are added, the old books say “outside, neither body nor heart is at leisure”, meaning a person who is outside with neither body nor heart free.

With Moon in the Travel palace, the book says that when Moon enters Temple (Temple = the star has strength, Fallen = weak) you meet noble helpers when you go out and also make wealth, and you suit going out to develop in the lines of culture, art, finance and real estate, with buying property elsewhere a common pattern; sharing the palace with Harmony in a position of Temple or Prosperous, you easily build a career from empty hands and found a home abroad. When you go out you are often supported by female noble helpers. In the Fallen position, you easily stir up disputes outside, life among people is rather unsettled, and the environment is hard to adapt to. Sun and Moon both Fallen is Sun and Moon Reversed; in general, a life with Sun and Moon placed back to back in this way mostly keeps far from the ancestors and leaves home to develop elsewhere; the same example also says a person with Sun and Moon Reversed will have matters that make the parents worry and fret on their behalf, so the two layers, living far from home and your parents, must be viewed together.

For Army Breaker in the Travel palace, the rhapsody says “Seven Killings and Army Breaker should go out”, meaning both stars should go outside. Volume three has the same line as “Seven Killings and Army Breaker should go out, and the handicrafts cannot be refined”; the Army Breaker in the Travel palace entry of volume two must add Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star before it says “running about with a skilled trade on the road”. But the book also records the price clearly: “Army Breaker going out wears out the heart and brings no peace”, put plainly running about outside, the heart cannot be still, and this toil cannot be avoided; volume one also says Army Breaker “in the Travel palace runs back and forth without strength”, running to and fro without being able to use your strength, easily busy for nothing. Adding Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star and Bell Star gives “running about with a skilled trade on the road”, meaning making a living by craft on the road, with even fiercer instability.

With Emperor in the Travel palace, you will meet noble helpers when you go out. The old books specially note the phrase “together with the Left and Right”, meaning that only with Left Assistant and Right Assistant beside it is this support truly there; volume one also says the Travel palace is by nature a strong palace but still needs helpers; when benefic stars shine on the Life palace, this noble energy is brought to you by other people. When Emperor gathers both Left Assistant and Right Assistant, leaving home for another place you more easily meet people willing to support you than in your own region, and rising outside also goes smoothly. If Ram Blade, Hindrance, Fire Star, Bell Star, Earth Void and Earth Robbery are added, you have no peace outside, with plenty of gossip and disputes and a lot of running about. When Emperor and Treasury sit together in the Travel palace in the Tiger or Monkey palace with Seven Killings in the Life palace, it is called Seven Killings facing the Dipper, read as going out and guarding the frontier, which is only spoken of this way when it falls at an age fitting one's station; the Complete Book and the Bone Marrow Rhapsody also have the line “Seven Killings facing the Dipper, rank and salary flourish”.

With Greedy Wolf in the Travel palace, the old books say “alone outside, toiling; in the noisy place, windfall wealth”, meaning that far from home you run about with great hardship, but money is often earned unexpectedly in lively places: banquets, receiving guests and social exchanges are the road to money. Peach Blossom is also plentiful outside, romantic chances mostly appear on the road and in other places; talent and relationships spread wider elsewhere, which belongs to the life pattern of “trouble starts the moment you leave the door”, meaning that leaving home brings opportunities.

The thing most worth putting effort into in this life is keeping your emotional foundation steady. Give yourself a corner that belongs only to you, a study, a balcony or a fixed chair will all do, and when you are in a poor state go and stay there, without needing to find someone to vent to. Put money in places you can see and hold, such as property, and touch little of what comes fast and leaves just as fast. When choosing a partner, look at one thing only: whether that person can hold your emotions, does not find you troublesome, and does not force you with reasoning, which matters far more than their conditions.

This is the most important reminder when Moon falls in a man's Spouse palace. Family relationships need particular care, so take the initiative to harmonise how your mother and your wife live together.

A person with this life pattern speaks well and is very good at expressing themselves, but learns widely without refining deeply, suits lines of work that live on communication, but talking a lot easily brings gossip and disputes. The book also says that Harmony and Great Gate in the Ox and Goat palaces, if the person is born in a Yin Wood, Yang Water, Yang Wood, Yin Metal or Yang Metal year, forms the wealth-and-office pattern after all; high or low depends on the birth year and the good or bad of the trine and opposite palaces (the palaces shining in from other palaces), so it cannot be said as a whole.

The biggest turning point of this life is whether there are people beside you willing to help. You are advised to treat criticism as information to be stored, not as provocation: whenever there is a major decision, first find two people who dare to tell the truth and ask them. On work, it is enough for you to handle direction, and leave details and execution to people you can trust. Lower yourself a little, bring people in to work with you, and your big-picture vision will turn into real results.

Marrying far away needs careful thought. Leaving the support circle you have had since childhood, your emotional anchor will wobble; if you really marry far away, equip yourself with a new set: a fixed call home every month, and within the first half year after arriving make two or three friends locally you can speak your heart to. In a long-distance relationship, do not rely only on feeling to hold it up, since romance at a distance and living day to day are two different things; arrange to meet early and settle firmly where you will make a home later. If a low mood goes on for a long time, do not carry it alone, and find a professional to talk with.
Suits paths of real authority such as the military, police and law; a purely civil post is hard to make the most of.
Suits real-authority positions such as the military police and not civil posts; when the star's strength is strong you can hold sway over a region, but the glory does not last long.
Suits movement and not holding still; money is easy to earn in lively places; when meeting malefic stars, you stir up disputes outside.
Suits fields that help people, such as medicine, education, religion and public welfare.
Suits work that upholds fairness, such as the judiciary, government affairs and education.
Suits drawing a fixed salary in a state body or school; do not take risks.
Suits sitting in a position that handles money and approvals, where both the civil and military roads open up and income is not thin either.
Suits marrying late; the two of you are often apart more than together, and your partner has a hard temperament.

Suits service fields, artistic creation, education, medicine and things involving children, and also suits working in partnership with others; good relationships are Harmony's greatest capital. Harmony is one of the great noble stars able to relieve disaster: only great noble stars have the function of relieving disaster, such as Sun and Martial, and Harmony belongs to this kind too. The Complete Book also says Harmony “does not mind being invaded by Seven Killings and does not fear the malefic stars sharing its seat”; but Harmony belongs to the Southern Dipper, and the Northern Dipper is usually stronger than the Southern Dipper, so you cannot rely on it completely.

Suits fields needing both talent and capability, such as law, creative work, the arts and military-police politics; Integrity seated in the Life or Career palace is read as a “military official belt”, meaning the road of leading troops into battle, often running off to distant regions. Integrity alone in the Life palace in the Tiger or Monkey palace is called the “Heroic Star Facing the Source” pattern, said to be able to reach a very high position; as for being your own boss in business, the Wealth palace needs Prosperity, and you must watch that you will lose wealth because of Peach Blossom. Volume three of the Complete Book writes “Integrity in the Monkey or Goat palace, without malefic stars brings wealth and rank and a far-ringing name”, with the note “with malefic stars added, it is ordinary”.

Suits fields that value public credibility and virtue, such as law, medicine, education, religion and supervision. An old formula says “Heavenly Beam in the Horse seat, a clear and eminent official career”, meaning Heavenly Beam seated in the Horse palace gives a clean and upright road in office, with high standing as well; entering Temple (strength) and meeting Literary Talent, Literary Arts, Left Assistant and Right Assistant, you can go out as a general and come in as a minister. The Complete Book says Heavenly Beam “must enter Temple to be wealthy and noble; in a Fallen place meeting Fire Star and Ram Blade that break the pattern, it is lowly, solitary, widowed and short-lived”, and only when Fallen and meeting Fire Star and Ram Blade that break the pattern is it judged this way, so not everyone is solitary.
Suits positions that handle money, and taking the real-authority road such as the military police is fine too.
Suits the real-authority road such as the military police and the judiciary, opening up a situation between breaking and building.
Suits work that lives on public speech and reputation.

Your partner is multi-talented and attractive; the Complete Book says of this palace “men and women both find it hard to be fully satisfied”, and with Greedy Wolf in Temple it is all the more advisable to marry late.
A partner somewhat older suits you better; the two of you often have distance and quarrel, so beware of living apart for long.
Your partner is very attractive; marrying a little late is better, while marrying early easily brings repeated setbacks.
Your partner is loyal, kind and mild, mostly found among relatives; meeting Minister is best when marrying.
Your partner is best older than you, with an easy-on-the-eye appearance; sharing the palace with Harmony brings harmony and a good married couple.
Your partner is gentle and pleasant to look at; marrying a little late makes it last longer, and a husband older than the wife suits.
Your partner is gentle and refined and values romantic feeling.
Your partner is gentle and refined and values romantic feeling. For a woman's chart, you yourself do not get along with your mother-in-law.
Your partner is gentle and intelligent, and in marriage you value spiritual exchange.
Your partner is calm and good at looking after the home; being straightforward, you in turn avoid conflict, and you can grow old together.

Your partner is calm and dependable, values family responsibility, is often very good at managing money, and is the steady pillar of the family, but expresses feelings rather privately. The weak point is leaning toward conservatism, with little romance or surprise; if you do not want life to be bland, the two of you must take the initiative to create a sense of freshness.
Your partner is dignified and calm, with a temperament leaning toward hardness; marrying a little late makes it easier to last.
Your partner is modest, mild and kind, with a beautiful appearance; when the star's strength is strong, feelings are not hurt.
Money goes east and west, first none and then some, and even when it comes into your hands it cannot be kept.
Money comes out of competition, so what you earn is hard-won money, but it can be accumulated.
Money is like boiling water poured on snow, big coming in and big going out, hard first and easy afterwards.
Money is little first and much later, little coming in at the start of life, and only later does it grow.
Money is hard first and easy afterwards, arriving fast and scattering just as fast.
Money is plentiful, along the road of a proper salary.
Money arrives by the proper road, earned through a proper career.
Money is earned by taking chances and daring to risk, with big swings; before acting you must weigh the risks.
Money is built up gradually on steady income, a small stream running long.

The appearance leans toward square and round, with a ruddy complexion, white teeth, and a mild, upright temperament, giving an impression of steadiness and reliability. But note that a person with Treasury looks gentle and kindly on the surface yet in fact has no small amount of scheming, and is not necessarily a good person. More important is the question of shielding against disaster, where the book and practical reading differ: volume two of the Complete Book says Treasury can “relieve all calamities”, while volume one says Treasury “dislikes the four malefic stars clashing and breaking it”; by practical reading, however, the line in the book is not right, and if malefic stars sit with Treasury then even though the book says Treasury relieves and neutralises calamity, in practice it has no effect and disaster happens as usual; Treasury must meet Three Terraces and Eight Seats before it has the power to relieve and neutralise calamity, and a lone Treasury star does not have that power. This foundation reads the chart in that way: a lone Treasury star is not to be used as a star that shields against disaster.
Having no free time is common; only in Temple does it enjoy its blessings in peace.

Close female friends are the core of your circle of friends. The number and depth of your female friends far exceed your male friends, and that is where you are most at ease. The women around you often treat you as the one to pour out their hearts to: when a romance ends they come to you to cry, when they divorce they come to you for a hug, when their child rebels they come to you for a plan, and if you take on too much you end up collapsing yourself.
You rely on eloquence and reputation to build a career from empty hands, with ups and downs at the start and still no comfort in middle age.
You eat by the brain, suited to internal affairs in a state body, planning and scheming, and not suited to taking risks on your own.
You earn money by the brain, but you earn it with effort; a fixed salary is the root.
